y37wz.description: The Walther MPK is a German submachine gun developed by Walther. It is good for concealed carry.
y37wz.description_zh: 瓦尔特MPK是一款由瓦尔特公司开发的德国冲锋枪。适合隐蔽携带。

969ky.description: A sawed-off version of the regular hunting shotgun with a horizontal barrel configuration, this weapon is much lighter and more compact than a regular double-barreled shotgun. It is one of the most widely used weapons among bandits, since it is easy to conceal and is highly effective at close range.
969ky.description_zh: 这是普通水平双管猎枪的锯短版本，比普通双管霰弹枪更轻、更紧凑。它是匪徒中最广泛使用的武器之一，因为它易于隐藏且在近距离非常有效。

lyl7j.description:
The first production variant of the M16, featuring a chrome-lined barrel and chamber, an improved buffer spring, and a forward assist. These upgrades eliminated most of the original M16s shortcomings and made the rifle suitable for reliable service.

It can still occasionally be found in the Zone, though more often as a collectors piece than a practical weapon.
lyl7j.description_zh:
M16的第一个量产型号，配备镀铬枪管和弹膛、改进的缓冲弹簧以及辅助推机柄。这些升级消除了原版M16的大部分缺陷，使步枪适合可靠服役。

在区域中偶尔仍能找到它的身影，不过更多是作为收藏品而非实用武器。

1rj7r.description: A general military bayonet knife adopted by the USSRs Armed Forces for use with the AK-74 and AKM assault rifles.
1rj7r.description_zh: 苏联武装力量为AK-74和AKM突击步枪列装的通用刺刀。

zz22k.description: A revolver developed in 1991 for use by specific categories of private security personnel and detective agencies. The revolver has small dimensions and a low weight, making it convenient for carrying at all times.
zz22k.description_zh: 1991年为特定类别的私人安保人员和侦探机构开发的转轮手枪。该转轮手枪尺寸小、重量轻，便于随时携带。

5ldwg.description: A shortened version of the AK-74 that was developed in the late 1970s and early 1980s for armed crews of combat vehicles, airborne infantry, gun crews and paratroopers. It was also used by the Ministry of Internal Affairs and security forces, thanks to its compact size.
5ldwg.description_zh: AK-74的缩短版本，于1970年代末至1980年代初为战车武装乘员、空降步兵、火炮乘员和伞兵开发。由于其紧凑的尺寸，也被内政部和安全部队使用。

969mq.description: A pistol developed in the second half of the 20th century, was based on the PM pistol. It was intended for use by reconnaissance teams and special forces personnel. This model is considered obsolete, but in skilled hands, it is still an extremely effective weapon. Comes with a silencer, unattached by default.
969mq.description_zh: 这款手枪于20世纪下半叶开发，基于PM手枪。旨在供侦察队和特种部队人员使用。该型号被认为已经过时，但在熟练者手中，它仍然是一种极其有效的武器。它作为一套出售，配有消音器，默认情况下是拆下的。

1r7dr.description: The most widely used pistol in the Zone, the PM is a vestige of the Soviet era and one of the finest compact self-defense weapons ever made. It stands out for its small dimensions, superb reliability, simplicity of use, and ease of maintenance. Among its downsides are low range and accuracy, limited bullet effectiveness, and—compared to other modern pistols in the same class—relatively poor magazine capacity and excess weight.
1r7dr.description_zh: 特异区中使用最广泛的手枪，PM是苏联时代的遗物。它是紧凑型自卫武器类别中最好的例子之一。它以其小巧的尺寸、卓越的可靠性、使用简单和维护方便而脱颖而出。其缺点包括射程和精度有限，子弹效果有限，以及（与同类其他现代手枪相比）相对较大的重量和较差的弹匣容量。

1r7rg.description:
A shortened version of the Mosins rifle. This carbine was intended for use by various branches of the military, in particular artillery, sappers, cavalry, liaison units, and logistical support operatives such as transport drivers, who needed a light, easy-to-use weapon, primarily for self-defense.
Additional properties
1r7rg.description_zh: 莫辛步枪的缩短版本。这款卡宾枪旨在供各种军兵种使用，特别是炮兵、工兵、骑兵、通信部队以及后勤支持人员（如运输车司机），他们需要一种主要用于自卫的轻便、易于使用的武器。

okv2o.description:
A unique submachine gun project from the 1990s. The Gepard is an experimental amphibious submachine gun.

The weapon was developed using the AKS-74U as its foundation, borrowing approximately 65% of its components. The Gepards design allowed it to use multiple bolt assemblies depending on the type of ammunition, and it could also be equipped with a balanced recoil system based on the opposing movement of two inertial masses, significantly improving accuracy.

A unique product of domestic firearms engineering, now manufactured from the original blueprints under special order for the inhabitants of the CEZ.
okv2o.description_zh:
一款来自20世纪90年代的独特冲锋枪项目。Gepard是一款实验性两栖冲锋枪。

该武器以AKS-74U为基础开发，借用了约65%的部件。Gepard的设计允许其根据弹药类型使用多种枪机组件，还可以配备基于两个惯性质量反向运动的平衡后坐系统，显著提高了精度。

国内枪械工程的独特产品，现在根据原始部件按特殊订单为禁区的居民制造。

m0vmk.description: A small hatchet for cutting wood and engaging in close combat.
m0vmk.description_zh: 用于砍柴和近战的小斧头。

zz23y.description:
An American bolt-action rifle introduced in 1936. Its impressive effectiveness and low cost made it popular among many shooters, and, as a result, it was widely distributed all over the world. The rail added by a gunsmith isnt particularly aesthetically pleasing, but it doesnt interfere with the sighting line, allowing the use of open sights.
Additional properties

wj67z.description: A hunters dagger produced by the Dagestani company Kizlyar. The blade is made from 65x13 steel with an antireflective coating, while the handle is leather.
wj67z.description_zh: 达吉斯坦公司Kizlyar生产的猎刀。刀刃由带防反射涂层的65x13钢制成，刀柄为皮革。

6wrqj.description: A K2 assault rifle covered in chips, cracks, and scratches. Rougher-looking than the standard model, but still perfectly serviceable in combat.
6wrqj.description_zh: 一把布满缺口、裂纹和划痕的K2突击步枪。比标准型号看起来更粗糙，但在战斗中仍然完全可用。

g4m2p.description:
A 7.62 mm (three-line) rifle from 1891. This magazine-fed rifle was adopted by the Russian Imperial Army of the Russian armed forces in 1891.
Additional properties
g4m2p.description_zh: 1891年的7.62毫米（三线口径）步枪。这款弹匣供弹步枪于1891年被俄罗斯帝国陆军列入俄罗斯武装力量的服役。

96mj0.description: A submachine gun developed by Yevgeny Dragunov in the early 1990s on orders from the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the USSR. It was based on the earlier SMG-71, also designed by Dragunov. The first 40 preproduction prototypes were made in 1992 at the Izhevsk Mechanical Plant. Mass production began in 1993 at the Zlatoust Machine-Building Plant.
96mj0.description_zh: PP-91 KEDR（由叶夫根尼·德拉贡诺夫设计）是1990年代初根据苏联内政部的命令开发的冲锋枪。它基于更早的SMG-71（同样由德拉贡诺夫设计）研制。首批40支预生产原型于1992年在伊热夫斯克机械制造厂制造。大规模生产始于1993年，在兹拉托乌斯特机械制造厂进行。

dmvvg.description: This light, easy-to-use knife has changed owners on more than one occasion.
dmvvg.description_zh: 这把轻便易用的刀已经多次易主。

rwzzz.description: The civilian version of the 6x9 Ratnik army combat knife.
rwzzz.description_zh: 6x9 Ratnik军队战斗刀的民用版本。

g4m0n.description: The USSRs first self-loading military pistol. It was developed in 1930 by the Soviet designer Fedor Vasilievich Tokarev. It stands out due to its simple construction and, consequently, by its low production cost and ease of maintenance.
g4m0n.description_zh: 苏联第一把军用半自动手枪。由苏联设计师Fedor Vasilievich Tokarev于1930年开发。以其结构简单、因此生产成本低和维护方便而脱颖而出。

5ln0q.description: A shortened version of the widely used pump-action shotgun. It is equipped with a folding tactical grip.
5ln0q.description_zh: 广泛使用的泵动式霰弹枪的缩短版本。它配备了折叠战术握把。

vjr1n.description: The legendary 1974 assault rifle chambered in 5.45 mm, featuring polymer furniture and a side-mounted dovetail rail. Renowned for its reliability, solid accuracy, and ease of use, its a dependable choice for nearly any stalker.
vjr1n.description_zh: 这款传奇的1974年突击步枪使用5.45毫米口径弹药，配备聚合物枪身和侧面燕尾槽导轨。以其可靠性、良好的精准度和易于操作而闻名，是几乎所有潜行者的可靠选择。

ok9m5.description: This tool is for hammering nails, but it can be used for other things too.
ok9m5.description_zh: 这个工具是用来钉钉子的，但也可以用于其他事情。

zz2om.description:
The Mossberg 500 is an American pump-action shotgun that has become one of the best-selling firearms in history.

Its classic pump-action design makes it an exceptionally reliable weapon, perfectly suited to the harsh conditions of the CEZ. Clearing out mutant camps, breaching doors, or hunting your next meal—this shotgun can handle it all.
zz2om.description_zh:
Mossberg 500是一款美国泵动式霰弹枪，已成为历史上最畅销的枪械之一。

其经典的泵动式设计使其成为一款极其可靠的武器，非常适合禁区的严酷条件。清理变异兽营地、破门或狩猎下一餐——这把霰弹枪都能胜任。

knl70.description: A 5.45 mm caliber AK Kalashnikov assault rifle developed in 1970 using Mikhail Kalashnikovs design, and first used by the armed forces of the USSR in 1974. This model is a further development of the AKM. It was developed as a result of the changeover to new, low-impulse 5.45x39 mm rounds.

j5lk7.description: An American 5.56 mm assault rifle developed and put into operational service in the 1960s.
j5lk7.description_zh: 一款美国5.56毫米突击步枪，于1960年代开发并投入使用。

5lngo.description: A German self-loading pistol developed in 1895. The Mauser company produced many different models of pistol for the police, the military, and for the civilian market, but none of them enjoy quite the popularity of the C96. Thus, the phrase "Mauser pistol" is almost invariably understood to mean this model.
5lngo.description_zh: 德国于1895年开发的半自动手枪。毛瑟公司为警察、军队和民用市场生产了许多不同型号的手枪，但没有一款能像C96那样受欢迎。因此，“毛瑟手枪”这个短语几乎总是指这款型号。

okv0o.description: An American 5.56 mm assault rifle developed and put into operational service in the 1960s. It lacks a fully automatic firing mode.
okv0o.description_zh: 一款美国5.56毫米突击步枪，于1960年代开发并投入使用。缺少全自动射击模式，但护木和弹匣已更换为M16A1的部件以降低成本。

1rjjr.description: A blade used for harvesting crops. As a weapon, its not great; the curved shape of the blade lets it down, but it can nonetheless deal serious puncture wounds when it strikes.
1rjjr.description_zh: 用于收割作物的刀刃。作为武器，它并不出色；刀刃的弯曲形状使其表现不佳，但尽管如此，它在攻击时仍可造成严重的刺伤。

g4m46.description: A Soviet self-loading carbine designed by Sergey Simonov, adopted in 1949.
g4m46.description_zh: 这款由Sergey Simonov设计的苏联半自动卡宾枪于1949年列装。

96wwq.description: You can sometimes find useful stuff in a junkyard.
96wwq.description_zh: 有时你可以在垃圾场找到有用的东西。

ok995.description: A diversionary knife designed for special operations use.

g40d0.description: One of the most famous submachine guns of the modern era. Cheap to produce and reliable.
g40d0.description_zh: 现代最著名的冲锋枪之一。生产成本低且可靠。

1r742.description: A hunting weapon with a horizontal barrel configuration. One of the most widely used types of weapon in the Zone.
1r742.description_zh: 一种水平双管配置的狩猎武器。是特异区中最广泛使用的武器类型之一。

y32y3.description:
A Soviet classic, refined by a Zone craftsman.

Reliable when an opponent unexpectedly jumps out of the bushes. Two close-range shots will leave a lasting impression.
y32y3.description_zh:
经Zone的工匠改制的苏联经典武器。



它能帮你迅速搞定突然从灌木丛中跳出的对手。两发近距离射击，足以让你们的相遇留下难以磨灭的印象。

1r79g.description:
A semi-automatic carbine developed from the SVT-40 in the same year as the rifle itself.

Although the carbine is a rarity even on the Mainland, years of the Zones existence have seen countless relics and surplus firearms brought beyond the Perimeter by the first generation of stalkers, allowing examples of this weapon to find their way into the Exclusion Zone.
1r79g.description_zh: 一款与SVT-40步枪同年研制、以其为基础开发的半自动卡宾枪。

1rd56.description: A 5.45 mm caliber AK Kalashnikov assault rifle developed in 1970 using Mikhail Kalashnikovs design, and first used by the armed forces of the USSR in 1974. This model is a further development of the AKM. It was developed as a result of the changeover to new, low-impulse 5.45x39 mm rounds.
1rd56.description_zh: 一款5.45毫米口径的AK卡拉什尼科夫突击步枪，由米哈伊尔·卡拉什尼科夫于1970年设计研制，并于1974年首次被苏联武装部队使用。此型号是AKM的进一步发展。它是由于转向使用新型低冲量5.45x39毫米弹药而开发的。

m02dj.description: The Vz.68 Scorpion is a Czechoslovak submachine gun developed in 1968 and chambered in 9×19 mm. Development never progressed beyond the prototype stage following the death of its designer, but the surviving prototypes eventually found their way into the Zone, where they performed surprisingly well.
m02dj.description_zh: Vz.68 Scorpion是一款捷克斯洛伐克冲锋枪，于1968年开发，使用9×19毫米弹药。在其设计师去世后，研发从未超出原型阶段，但幸存的原型最终流入了区域，在那里它们表现出奇地好。

g4mn6.description:
An American bolt-action rifle introduced in 1936. Its impressive effectiveness and low cost made it popular among many shooters, and, as a result, it was widely distributed all over the world. The rail added by a gunsmith isnt particularly aesthetically pleasing, but it doesnt interfere with the sighting line, allowing the use of open sights.
Additional properties
g4mn6.description_zh: 一款1936年推出的美国步枪，采用纵向滑动枪机。其令人印象深刻的效力以及低成本使其在许多枪手中流行，因此，它在世界各地广泛分布。修理匠添加的导轨看起来并不特别美观，但也不干扰瞄准线，允许其使用机械瞄具瞄准。

5lnp0.description: A self-loading rifled carbine developed based on the RPK machine gun in 1995. It was intended for commercial and amateur hunting of medium-sized and large animals.
5lnp0.description_zh: 基于RPK机枪于1995年开发的自装填线膛卡宾枪。旨在用于商业和业余狩猎中型和大型动物。

g4mqp.description: This 9 mm Stechkin automatic pistol was developed at the end of the 1940s and the start of the 1950s by I. Ya. Stechkin and was adopted by the USSRs Armed Forces in 1951, at the same time as the Makarov pistol. The APS is intended for use by officers who directly take part in combat, as well as for soldiers and sergeants of some special subdivisions.
g4mqp.description_zh: 这款9毫米斯捷奇金自动手枪由I. Ya. 斯捷奇金于1940年代末至1950年代初开发，并于1951年与马卡洛夫手枪同时被苏联武装部队投入使用。APS旨在供直接参与战斗的军官以及某些特种部队的士兵和士官使用。

rwzmv.description: This widely available modification of the P99 pistol, which is popular in the Zone, allows it to fire in fully automatic mode. It is cheap, easy to use, effective, and sometimes makes a "pop" sound while being fired—isnt that all you need for a perfect weapon?
rwzmv.description_zh: 这款在特异区流行的P99手枪的广泛可用改装允许其以全自动模式射击。它便宜、易用、有效，有时在射击时会发出“噗”的声音——这不就是完美武器所需要的一切吗？

rwz2z.description: This bayonet can be attached to Berdan and Mosin rifles. Using it as a standalone weapon is extremely awkward, so it was fitted with a small wooden handle—a debatable upgrade, but one that allows for reasonably accurate strikes.
rwz2z.description_zh: 这把刺刀可以安装在伯丹和莫辛步枪上。单独使用这把刀刃极其笨拙，因此配备了小木柄，这可能用处不大，但仍允许它进行或多或少的准确打击。

y32po.description: A compact automatic pistol developed in the USA.
y32po.description_zh: 一款在美国开发的紧凑型自动手枪。

zz2pn.description: An upgraded PM with increased magazine and improved reliability. The elevated maximum barrel pressure improves stopping power. Disadvantages include: short range, low accuracy, recoil exceeding that of the standard PM, and heightened magazine spring tension, which can cause the spring to lose elasticity and result in feeding delays while firing.
zz2pn.description_zh: 这款升级版PM在增加弹匣容量和提高可靠性方面有所不同。手枪枪管内的最大压力增加了，这提高了其停止力。其缺点包括射程短、精度低，以及与PM相比后坐力增大，以及弹匣中弹簧张力增加，这可能导致弹簧失去弹性并在射击时造成延迟。

zz7y2.description: A compact assault rifle developed in the USA based on the M16A2. It was originally intended for combat vehicle crews and operators of technical equipment. In time, however, as mechanized infantry and auxiliary troops came to make up the majority of the armed forces, the M4A1 was adopted almost universally by the US Army, the carbines convenience far outweighing its modest drop in stats compared to a full-length rifle.
zz7y2.description_zh: 一款基于M16A2在美国开发的突击步枪，最初旨在供战车武装乘员和技术人员使用。目前，整个美国军队正在转向使用M4A1。在现代条件下，当军队主要由机械化步兵、战车乘员和辅助部队组成时，短卡宾枪的易用性提高，足以弥补与常规步枪相比相当微不足道的性能下降。

g4mmn.description: An excellent Western-made pistol distinguished by its high reliability, large magazine capacity, good accuracy, and best-in-class ergonomics. Since arriving in the Zone, it has become one of the most widely used pistols among professionals and newbies with the means to afford it.
g4mmn.description_zh: 西方制造的优秀手枪。以其高可靠性、大弹匣容量、良好精度以及可以说是其类别中最佳的人体工程学而脱颖而出。当它进入特异区时，成为最广泛使用的手枪之一，既受专业人士也受那些买得起的新手欢迎。

zz2lk.description: A modified version of a pistol from the first half of the 20th century. Despite its venerable age, this model remains as popular as ever all over the world.
zz2lk.description_zh: 20世纪上半叶一款手枪的改进型。尽管年代久远，这款型号在世界各地仍然像以往一样受欢迎。

0rqkk.description: This knuckleduster used to belong to the Frost Fighters leader, nicknamed Horilka. Obtained for saving him and the whole Zone from the Anomalous Blizzard.
0rqkk.description_zh: 这把指虎曾属于寒霜战士的领袖，绰号Horilka。因拯救他以及整个特异区免受异常暴风雪侵袭而获得。

g4vmn.description: A small pry bar that people call a "crowbar" or "jemmy." Can easily smash an enemys skull.
g4vmn.description_zh: 人们称为“撬棍”或“铁橇”的小型撬棍。可以轻易砸碎敌人的头骨。

5lgno.description: An Austrian infantry knife with a shock-resistant polymer handle and a spring steel blade with antireflective coating.
5lgno.description_zh: 奥地利步兵刀，刀柄由抗冲击聚合物制成，刀刃由带防反射涂层的弹簧钢制成。

1rj9g.description: There are rumors going around in the Zone about a newbie who couldnt even make it from the Swamps to the Roadside. He was armed only with a PM, unable to afford anything better. Eventually, he talked one of the stalkers into getting him a better weapon, offering his PM and a bit of cash as payment. The stalker found the request amusing and simply took the pistol to a mechanic, who made some modifications to it that proved to be quite successful: an improved bullet feeding mechanism increased the rate of fire and a reshaped magazine increased its capacity. In all other respects, the pistol was the same as it was originally. No one knows what became of the newbie, but this version of the pistol went into mass production, and now anyone can get their hands on one.
1rj9g.description_zh: 特异区流传着关于一个新手的谣言，他甚至没能从沼泽地走到路边。他只装备了一把马卡洛夫手枪，买不起更好的。最终，他说服一位潜行者给他一把更好的武器，并提出用他的马卡洛夫手枪和少量现金作为报酬。这位潜行者很有幽默感：他只是把手枪拿到机械师那里进行了改装。事实证明，改装相当成功。改进的供弹机制提高了手枪的射速，弹匣形状的改变增加了其容弹量。在其他所有方面，手枪都与原来没什么不同。没人知道这个新手后来怎么样了，但这类改装变得流行起来。如今，任何人都可以弄到一把。

j5l77.description: The SA80 (SA-80—Small Arms for the 1980s) is a British family of firearms developed in the mid-1980s. It comprises the L85 assault rifle, the L86 LMG, the L22 carbine and the L98 cadet rifle. The set is used as the service weapons of the British Army.

1r77r.description: A Ukrainian-made pistol primarily intended for law enforcement agencies and security forces. It has better accuracy, ergonomics, and magazine capacity than the PM. It mainly enters the Zone through widely sold factory rejects, but remains in demand among stalkers for its solid combat performance.
1r77r.description_zh: 乌克兰制造的手枪，主要供执法机构和安全部队使用。与PM相比，它具有更好的精度、易用性和弹匣容量。它主要随着这里广泛进行的召回活动进入特异区，但由于其相当令人钦佩的战斗性能，在潜行者中仍有良好的需求。

zz29n.description: An American smoothbore, single-shot shotgun. It has never enjoyed widespread use, but thanks to its simple construction, it is now often made by hand in the Zone as a cheap and reliable "boomstick."
zz29n.description_zh: 一款美国滑膛单发霰弹枪。从未得到广泛使用，但由于其结构简单，现在经常在区域手工制作，作为一种廉价可靠的“轰击棍”。

zz742.description: A submachine gun developed in the mid-1990s by members of the Special Design Bureau at the Kovrov Mechanical Plant. The Austrian Steyr MPi-69 was used as a model, but after releasing a test run of AEK-919s, some flaws were discovered that led to changes to the base design. The updated model was given the index AEK-919K.
zz742.description_zh: 一款冲锋枪，由科弗罗夫机械制造厂特别设计局的成员在1990年代中期开发。奥地利斯太尔MPi-69被用作模型，但在发布了一批AEK-919测试产品后，发现了一些缺陷，导致对基础设计进行了更改。更新后的型号被赋予索引AEK-919K。

qjg24.description: A wearable trench tool intended for digging a single trench while under enemy fire. It does a pretty decent job in close combat, too.
qjg24.description_zh: 一种便携式战壕工具，用于在敌方火力下挖掘单人战壕。在近战中也表现得相当不错。

qjvo6.description: An Italian submachine gun developed in the mid-1980s, known for its solid accuracy and high-capacity magazine.
qjvo6.description_zh: 一款意大利冲锋枪，于1980年代中期开发。因其良好的散布和大弹匣容量而突出。

p6rm6.description: A Soviet submachine gun designed by G. S. Shpagin, it entered into service with the Red Army in 1940. For ease of use in the Zone, a conversion was made for a more common caliber.
p6rm6.description_zh: 一款苏联冲锋枪，由G. S. 什帕金设计，并于1940年被红军投入使用。为便于在区域使用，已转换为更常见的口径。

p611d.description: A wooden club with bones, claws, and teeth from the undead on Boral.
p611d.description_zh: 一根带有Boral不死族骨头、爪子和牙齿的木棍。

96w1y.description: Intended for dealing damage using the VOG-25 and VOG-25Ps fragmentation rounds with flat-trajectory and high-angle fire to personnel that are in the open, in foxholes or trenches, or on reverse slopes or to unarmored targets that are inaccessible to gunfire.
96w1y.description_zh: 旨在使用VOG-25和VOG-25P的破片弹，通过平射和曲射火力对暴露在开阔地、散兵坑或战壕中，或位于反斜面的人员，或枪支无法射击的无装甲目标造成伤害。

969vz.description: The HK UMP ("Universale Maschinenpistole" in German, meaning "universal submachine gun") is a submachine gun that was developed by the German company Heckler & Koch in the 1990s as an addition to the HK MP5 range of submachine guns.
969vz.description_zh: HK UMP（德语“Universale Maschinenpistole”，意为“通用冲锋枪”）是一款冲锋枪，由德国公司Heckler & Koch于1990年代开发，作为HK MP5系列冲锋枪的补充。

969r0.description: An upgraded PP-91 KEDR. Thanks to its improved ammo feeding system and lighter breech mechanism, it has a higher firing rate and greater close-range stopping power, but it is less effective at range.
969r0.description_zh: 升级版PP-91 KEDR。得益于改进的供弹系统和更轻的枪机机构，它具有更高的射速和近距离停止力，但在远距离效果较差。

zz2rn.description: The AK-105 is a modification of the AK-101, AK-103, and the AK-74M, with a barrel that has been shortened to 101 mm in length. The intermediate barrel length (between that of the AK-74M and the AK-74U) allowed the size of the weapon to be reduced, while leaving the gas chamber in the same place in relation to the face of the breech, as in the AK-74M, and not moving it backward (as with the AKS-74U). This further unified the entire "AK-10x" family of rifles.
zz2rn.description_zh: AK-105是AK-101、AK-103和AK-74M的改进型号，枪管长度缩短至101毫米。中等枪管长度（介于AK-74M和AK-74U之间）使得武器尺寸减小，同时气体调节器相对于枪机镜面的位置与AK-74M相同，而没有向后移动（如AKS-74U）。这进一步统一了整个“AK-10x”系列步枪。

5lnv0.description: A compact modification of the MP5 with a shortened barrel. The stock and handguard have been removed, and it has been equipped with an additional handle for holding the weapon.
5lnv0.description_zh: MP5的紧凑型改进型号，枪管缩短。枪托和护木已移除，并配备了额外的握持武器的握把。

n42m9.description: A thoughtful design combining several tools for a variety of field tasks into one object. The sturdy blade, mounted on an ergonomic wooden handle, can serve as an axe, saw, screwdriver, or pry bar.
n42m9.description_zh: 这款武器拥有经过深思熟虑的设计，将用于各种工作领域的几种工具组合成一个物体。固定在符合人体工程学的木柄上的坚固刀刃，可用作斧头、锯子、螺丝刀或杠杆。

g4vvn.description: For shoveling snowdrifts. Decent in close combat, too.
g4vvn.description_zh: 一种便携式战壕工具，用于在敌方火力下挖掘单人战壕。在近战中也表现得相当不错。

m023j.description: A representative of a new family of assault rifles. Thanks to its high reliability, accuracy, and ease of handling, it is one of the best examples of a weapon in its class. It is not frequently encountered in the Zone, and it costs a pretty penny. It is usually seasoned stalkers who order one of these specially for themselves.

96w9q.description: A knife forged from 95x18 steel with a fine hardwood handle.
96w9q.description_zh: 一把由95x18钢锻造的刀，刀柄由名贵木材制成。

g4mgp.description: An Israeli compact automatic pistol, which represents a further modernization of the Uzi (following the Mini-Uzi).
g4mgp.description_zh: 一款以色列紧凑型自动手枪，代表了乌兹（继迷你乌兹之后）的进一步现代化。

okv7o.description: A modern assault rifle developed to replace the aging AK-74. One of its main features is the ability to fire bursts of two shots with high accuracy (at a range of 100 meters, both bullets hit the same point). This substantially increases the chances of taking down a target thanks to the combined penetrative and stopping power of the bullets.
okv7o.description_zh: 一款现代突击步枪，旨在取代当时老化的AK-74。其主要特点之一是能够以高精度进行两发点射（在100米距离内，两颗子弹命中同一点）。这显著提高了击倒目标的机会，这要归功于子弹的综合穿透力和停止力。

7l5n9.description: A huge cleaver covered in rust and... ketchup?
7l5n9.description_zh: 一把覆盖着锈迹和……番茄酱的巨大切肉刀？

1r7v1.description: A modification of the Uzi submachine gun. It has reduced weight due to its lighter bolt, shortened barrel, and shorter recoil spring.
1r7v1.description_zh: 乌兹冲锋枪的改进型号。由于更轻的枪机、缩短的枪管和更短的复进簧，重量减轻。

dmvjg.description: A telescopic, two-section baton. It is a means of self-defense in dangerous and unforeseen circumstances. It consists of two parts that are folded into the handle. In its extended configuration, it is 50 cm in length.
dmvjg.description_zh: 伸缩式两节警棍。是危险和意外情况下的自卫手段。由折叠入手柄的两部分组成。伸展状态下长度为50厘米。

m0vvk.description: A combat knife used by Soviet and Russian special security units since 1943.
m0vvk.description_zh: 自1943年以来在苏联和俄罗斯特种安全部队服役的战斗刀。

1r731.description: Just one look at this tells you that Poland is strong.
1r731.description_zh: 只需看一眼，你就知道波兰很强大。

wj732.description: A self-loading rifle developed in 1940 using the Tokarev system, designed as a replacement for the Simonov assault rifle and subsequently adopted by the Red Army. Due to various shortcomings, particularly low reliability, it saw limited use after the war. Nonetheless, a substantial number can be found with merchants—this rifles low price makes it popular among novice stalkers.
wj732.description_zh: 这款1940年型的采用托卡列夫系统的半自动步枪，旨在替换西蒙诺夫突击步枪，随后在红军中列装。由于其各种缺点，特别是可靠性低，战后并未特别广泛使用。尽管如此，在商人那里可以找到相当多的例子——这款步枪的低价使其在新手潜行者中流行。

1rdnq.description: LMG developed by V. A. Degtyarev. The DP was one of the first examples of a Soviet-made firearm.
1rdnq.description_zh: V. A. Degtyarev开发的轻机枪。DP是苏联制造的首批枪支之一。

4q0lp.description: A Russian 9 mm submachine gun developed by a team of designers from the KBP Instrument Design Bureau.
4q0lp.description_zh: 一款俄罗斯9毫米冲锋枪，由KBP仪器设计局的设计师团队开发。

knl43.description_zh:
L86A1是一款英国轻机枪，在SA80计划下作为班组步兵支援武器开发。它基于L85A1步枪，保留了无托布局，并与标准制式步枪保持着高度的零件通用性。尽管被归类为机枪，但L86A1在支援角色上几乎毫无用处：由于缺乏快速更换枪管且依赖盒式弹匣，它根本无法维持长时间的压制火力。

英国军方最终采购了其他机枪，而L86A1则流落到了那些几乎什么都有人买的地方——比如切尔诺贝利禁区。

rwzqz.description: Hatchet with a grip made from the bone of an unknown being. It is covered in runes.
rwzqz.description_zh: 握柄由未知生物骨头制成的斧头。上面覆盖着符文。

y32lo.description: The FN SCAR (Special Operations Forces Combat Assault Rifle) is a weapons system developed by the American subdivision of Belgian company@FN Herstal.
y32lo.description_zh: FN SCAR（来自短语“特种作战部队战斗突击步枪”）是一个武器系统，由比利时公司FN赫斯塔尔的美国分部开发。

5lnjq.description:
A smoothbore pump-action shotgun.

Developed in the 1990s, it became a prototype for subsequent models. It is known for exceptional reliability, making it a natural fit and one of the Zones most popular choices.
5lnjq.description_zh:
采用泵动装填机制的滑膛霰弹枪。



研发于1990年代，是后续型号的原型。以其极高的可靠性著称。非常适合在Zone中使用，因此广受欢迎。

4qnnj.description:
Once upon a time, weapons like this were carried by special-ops fighters and old-school mercenaries. 
This particular specimen has survived profiteers, grime, disposal, and repeated repairs. 
Reinforced mechanics, a furious rate of fire, and reliability that many local guns would envy. 
Take care of it, and it’ll serve you for a long time. Neglect it, and... the Zone will quickly remind you who’s in charge here, 
while the unusually shaped “foreign” guest will soon start changing hands.
4qnnj.description_zh: 曾几何时，特种作战战士和老派佣兵都携带这种武器。

qj2yj.description:
This is not a factory-produced model, but a comprehensive modernization of the iconic Simonov carbine.

In the Zone, where reliability and the widespread availability of 7.62×39 ammunition are highly valued but modern ergonomics are sorely lacking, skilled gunsmiths took the old SKS and dressed it in a modern polymer chassis.

Of the old grandfathers carbine, only the proven barrel and gas system remain. Everything else has been replaced with more practical modern components.
qj2yj.description_zh:
这不是工厂生产型号，而是对标志性的西蒙诺夫卡宾枪的全面现代化改装。

在区域中，可靠性和7.62×39弹药广泛可用的特性备受重视，但现代人体工程学却严重匮乏，因此熟练的枪匠将旧SKS装入了现代聚合物底盘。

老式卡宾枪只保留了经过验证的枪管和导气系统，其余部件均被更实用的现代组件所取代。

zz2nm.description: One of the most widely used pump-action shotguns. It was first manufactured in 1962 and is now produced in various versions that are intended for hunting, as well as for the police, security personnel, and for self-defense.
zz2nm.description_zh: 最广泛使用的泵动式霰弹枪之一。它于1962年首次制造，现在生产各种版本，用于狩猎、警察、安保人员以及自卫。

g4mz5.description: A widely used hunting rifle with a vertical barrel configuration. Its decent accuracy and stopping power make it more reliable against mutants than a pistol. Cheap and widely available compared to most weapons, its a common choice among newbies and bandits on the periphery of the Zone.
g4mz5.description_zh: 一种广泛使用的垂直双管配置狩猎步枪。凭借其不错的精度和良好的停止力，它能提供比手枪更可靠的对抗变异体的保护。与大多数武器相比，它非常便宜且容易获得，因此被特异区外围的新手和匪徒广泛使用。

knm6y.description:
A German magazine-fed rifle officially adopted in 1935.
Additional properties
knm6y.description_zh: 德国弹匣供弹步枪，于1935年正式列装。

4qnkr.description:
An Austrian sniper rifle produced by the Steyr company. It belongs to a special class of multi-purpose scout rifles that are intended both for hunting and for self-defense and combat.
Additional properties
4qnkr.description_zh: 一款由斯泰尔公司生产的奥地利狙击步枪。它属于一种特殊的多用途侦察步枪，既可用于狩猎，也可用于自卫和战斗。

5ldkg.description: An assault rifle adopted in 1959 as an improvement upon the AK. It is distinguished by its powerful rounds and excellent reliability, and is equipped with a "dovetail" rail.
5ldkg.description_zh: 一款于1959年首次使用的突击步枪，取代了AK并是其进一步发展。其特点是使用大口径弹药和出色的可靠性。带有“燕尾槽”导轨。

knm0v.description:
A Russian magazine-fed sniper rifle created in 1998–2000 by a team of designers under the leadership of Vladimir Stronsky and mass-produced by the Izhmash company.
Additional properties
knm0v.description_zh: 一款俄罗斯弹匣供弹狙击步枪，由弗拉基米尔·斯特龙斯基领导的设计师团队于1998–2000年创建，并由伊兹马什公司大规模生产。

lylqq.description: A German machine gun adopted before World War II. It was distinguished by its high rate of fire and versatility, and was used by infantry, vehicle crews, and gun teams.
lylqq.description_zh: 一种二战前采用的德国机枪。它以高射速和多功能性著称，被步兵、载具乘员和炮组使用。

0r3or.description: Germanys first mass-produced assault rifle of World War II, the forerunner of modern assault weapons.
0r3or.description_zh: 德国第一种二战期间量产的突击步枪，现代突击武器的先驱。

zz24n.description: A sniper variant of the SIG SG 550 assault rifle.
zz24n.description_zh: SIG SG 550突击步枪的狙击变体。

g4vj5.description: A handheld revolver-type grenade launcher. It has a range of 55 meters.
g4vj5.description_zh: 手持转轮式榴弹发射器。射程55米。

5ld1g.description: A combined assault rifle and grenade launcher having 70% parts compatibility with AK-74-type rifles (the main differences being the 9x39 mm caliber, the bullpup configuration, and greater possibilities for modernization), developed as a weapon for rapid response units. Its highly valued by the military and stalkers for its ability to eliminate opponents in body armor or behind cover.
5ld1g.description_zh: 突击步枪和榴弹发射器的结合，70%基于AK-74型突击步枪（主要区别在于9x39毫米口径、无托结构以及更大的现代化可能性）。它是为快速反应部队的武器装备而开发的。由于它能够可靠地消灭穿着护甲的对手，即使在掩体后也是如此，因此受到潜行者和军方的高度重视。

5lno1.description: A modernized version of the SVD sniper rifle in a bullpup layout, redesigned to reduce its dimensions. It offers a higher rate of fire and lower weight than its predecessor, with comparable accuracy at short and medium range. Nowadays, it enjoys well-deserved popularity both in the military and among stalkers.
5lno1.description_zh: SVD狙击步枪的更现代版本，采用无托布局以减少尺寸。与其前身相比，它具有更高的射速和更低的重量，在短距离和中距离，其精度大致相同。如今，它在军队和潜行者中都享有当之无愧的广泛流行。

okm20.description: The HK PSG1 sniper rifle was developed at the start of the 1980s by the German company Heckler & Koch in collaboration with various anti-terrorist organizations, including the German GSG9 and the British SAS. The rifle was created based on the regular Bundeswehr HK G3 assault rifle and was intended primarily for use by the police.
okm20.description_zh: HK PSG1狙击步枪由德国公司Heckler & Koch在1980年代初与多个反恐组织（包括德国GSG9和英国SAS）合作开发。该步枪基于联邦国防军常规的HK G3突击步枪制造，主要供警察使用。

7lrz3.description:
The AK-103 was developed as part of the AK platform unification program and became the final creation of the legendary Mikhail Timofeyevich.

This rifle offers even greater reliability than other Kalashnikov variants—some examples have fired well over 100,000 rounds without requiring cleaning or suffering malfunctions. This version features a receiver cover equipped with a Picatinny rail for increased modularity.
7lrz3.description_zh: AK-103是作为AK平台统一计划的一部分开发的，并成为传奇人物米哈伊尔·季莫费耶维奇的最后作品。这款步枪比其它卡拉什尼科夫变种具有更高的可靠性——有些例子已经发射了超过10万发子弹而无需清洁或出现故障。此版本配备了带有皮卡汀尼导轨的机匣盖，以增加模块化。

1rdk6.description: Based on the proven AKM design, adapted for 9x39mm rounds. Its non-removable silencer and compatibility with OTs-14 Groza magazines make it an ideal choice for experienced fighters who appreciate the combination of stealth and firepower.
1rdk6.description_zh: 基于经过验证的AKM设计，适配9x39毫米弹药。不可拆卸的消音器和与OTs-14 Groza弹匣的兼容性使其成为重视潜行和火力结合的资深战士的理想选择。

knlo3.description:
The SIG 516 was developed from the HK416 platform, but features simplified components to maintain compatibility with the AR-15. Another premium short-stroke gas piston rifle, it allows the use of a shortened barrel and/or a suppressor without causing excessive wear to its internal components. 

Widely used by special operations units around the world, it has also proven itself exceptionally effective within the Exclusion Zone.
knlo3.description_zh:
SIG 516是在HK416平台基础上开发的，但采用了简化部件以保持与AR-15的兼容性。另一款优质短行程导气活塞式步枪，允许使用缩短的枪管和/或消音器而不会对其内部部件造成过度磨损。

被世界各地的特种作战单位广泛使用，在隔离区内也证明了其极为有效的性能。

p6r26.description:
A Belgian bullpup assault rifle. The F2000 was one of the first rifles designed from the ground up as a modular platform, featuring an integrated removable optical sight, Picatinny rails for additional accessories, and a unique forward-ejection system. Its futuristic appearance quickly earned it the nickname "the rifle of the soldiers of the future."

Within the Zone, the FN F2000 is a prestige weapon favored by certain mercenaries. Its compact dimensions and impressive firepower have made it highly desirable throughout the CEZ.
p6r26.description_zh:
一款比利时无托结构突击步枪。F2000是最早从头开始设计为模块化平台的步枪之一，配备集成可拆卸光学瞄具、用于额外附件的皮卡汀尼导轨以及独特的前抛壳系统。其未来主义外观很快为其赢得了“未来士兵之步枪”的绰号。

在区域内，FN F2000是一款受某些雇佣兵青睐的高端武器。其紧凑的尺寸和强大的火力使其在整个禁区内备受追捧。

0rq2k.description: A tool used by mountain climbers for breaking ice when climbing mountain peaks. Its great for breaking other materials too, not just ice.
0rq2k.description_zh: 登山者用于攀登山峰时破冰的工具。它也很适合打破其他材料，不仅仅是冰。

3gr6z.description:
The R6 is the sixth iteration of high-quality rifles from a relatively new player in the firearms industry.

This model combines the best of both worlds—the modularity and ergonomics of the AR-15 platform with a short-stroke gas piston operating system. This approach makes the assault rifle both exceptionally reliable in the harsh conditions of the CEZ and comfortable to operate.
3gr6z.description_zh:
R6是这家枪械行业相对较新的厂商所推出的第六代高品质步枪。

该型号融合了两方面的优点——AR-15平台的模块化和人机工程学，以及短行程导气活塞式操作系统。这种方法使得这把突击步枪在禁区的严酷条件下极为可靠，同时操作起来也十分舒适。

wj7qo.description: A Soviet LMG based on the AKM assault rifle. When it was first adopted, and indeed for a long time afterward, it was the lightest machine gun in the world and established itself as a highly effective weapon—compact, simple, and convenient to use.
wj7qo.description_zh: 一款基于AKM突击步枪的苏联轻机枪。在投入使用后很长一段时间里，它都是世界上最轻的机枪，并确立了其作为紧凑、简单、使用方便的高效武器的地位。

0rqqk.description: "The knife of the Soviet Spetsnaz," this multi-function portable tool has many possible uses.
0rqqk.description_zh: “苏联特种部队的刀”，这种多功能便携工具具有多种可能用途。

j5vol.description: Although this knife vaguely resembles a karambit, it isnt actually one. The length of the blade and its shape speak volumes about this weapons true nature.
j5vol.description_zh: 虽然这把刀有点像鹰爪刀，但实际上并不是。刀刃的长度和形状充分说明了这款武器的真实本质。

g4vk6.description: An upgraded trigger, larger magazine capacity, and more reliable parts have made this already-great pistol into a dream weapon for every more or less experienced stalker.
g4vk6.description_zh: 升级的扳机、更大的弹匣容量和更可靠的部件使这把已经很棒的手枪成为每位多少有点经验的潜行者的梦想武器。

zz2wy.description: A modification of the M1A self-loading rifle with automatic fire. It is in demand among stalkers due to its availability, high accuracy, and substantial stopping power.
zz2wy.description_zh: M1A半自动步枪的改进型，具有自动射击功能。由于可用性高、精度高且停止力大，它在潜行者中很受欢迎。

3grdz.description: A compact Russian rifle based on the silent AS Val
3grdz.description_zh: 紧凑型俄罗斯步枪，基于消音的AS“巨浪”步枪开发。

96my0.description: An assault rifle with a block of rotating barrels.
96my0.description_zh: 一款带有旋转枪管组的突击步枪。

6wr0j.description: A modification of the AEK-971, adapted for 7.62x39mm rounds. The change of caliber increases damage, while slightly sacrificing the rate of fire.
6wr0j.description_zh: AEK-971的改型，适配7.62x39毫米弹药。口径的改变增加了伤害，同时略微牺牲了射速。

y375z.description: This weapon is based on the VSS sniper rifle, designed as a silenced firearm for special operations. It allows the shooter to engage armored targets effectively without revealing their position. Its defining features are an integrated silencer and subsonic 9x39 mm rounds.
y375z.description_zh: 这款武器是在特种VSS狙击步枪的基础上创建的，作为特种部队士兵的消音武器。它使射手能够有效射击受护甲保护的对手，而不暴露自己的位置。其主要特点之一是使用集成消音器和带有重型子弹的9x39毫米口径弹药。

dmjwn.description: A German assault rifle made by Heckler & Koch. Despite its visual similarity to the M4 carbine, its mechanism is closer to the German H&K G36 than to American AR-type rifles. Originally intended as a conversion module for installation on any lower receiver from the M4 carbine or M16, though complete rifles later appeared as well.
dmjwn.description_zh: 一款德国突击步枪，由Heckler & Koch制造。尽管其外观与M4卡宾枪相似，但这款突击步枪的机制实际上更接近德国H&K G36，而不是美国AR型步枪。最初，这款新武器是作为安装在M4或M16卡宾枪机匣下半部分的替换模块而设计的。然而，它后来本身成为了一款完整的突击步枪。

1r7g1.description: The Steyr AUG (which stands for "Armee Universal Gewehr," meaning "universal army rifle") is a range of small arms that was launched in 1977 by the Austrian company Steyr-Daimler-Puch. In this particular rifle, a bullpup layout has been used, whereby the magazine and breech are located behind the firing hand grip and the trigger. There are two firing modes: single-shot and full-automatic.
1r7g1.description_zh: 斯太尔AUG（代表“Armee Universal Gewehr”，意为“通用陆军步枪”）是由奥地利公司Steyr-Daimler-Puch于1977年推出的一系列轻武器。在这款特定步枪中，采用了无托结构，即弹匣和枪机位于射击握把和扳机后方。有两种射击模式：单发和全自动。

7lrj3.description: Created in the 1990s for Russian special forces, its silencer and easy reloading with magazines from the OTs-14 Groza make it a simple but effective tool for all kinds of combat missions.
7lrj3.description_zh: 它在1990年代为特种部队而创建。消音器和使用OTs-14 Groza弹匣的便捷重新装填使其成为在各种条件下执行战斗任务的简单而有效的工具。

7lrm3.description: The right arm of the free world. A weapon that has seen many world conflicts but is always ready to bring peace, democracy, and freedom.
7lrm3.description_zh: 自由世界的右手。一件见证了许多世界冲突但始终准备带来和平、民主和自由的武器。

969jz.description: The Steyr AUG (which stands for "Armee Universal Gewehr," meaning "universal army rifle") is a range of small arms that was launched in 1977 by the Austrian company Steyr-Daimler-Puch. In this particular rifle, a bullpup layout has been used, whereby the magazine and breech are located behind the firing hand grip and the trigger. There are two firing modes: single-shot and full-automatic.
969jz.description_zh: 斯太尔AUG（代表“Armee Universal Gewehr”，意为“通用陆军步枪”）是由奥地利公司Steyr-Daimler-Puch于1977年推出的一系列轻武器。在这款特定步枪中，采用了无托结构，即弹匣和枪机位于射击握把和扳机后方。有两种射击模式：单发和全自动。

96mn0.description: An elite rifle intended only for experienced fighters. Fires in burst mode only, with enhanced accuracy and almost imperceptible recoil.
96mn0.description_zh: 仅适用于经验丰富战士的精英步枪。只进行点射，具有更高的精度和几乎察觉不到的后坐力。

dmqg5.description: A modified AKM equipped with polymer furniture and a sound and flash suppressor. Perfectly suited for ambushes and nighttime operations.
dmqg5.description_zh: 一把配备聚合物枪身和消音/消焰器的改进型AKM。非常适合伏击和夜间行动。

g4060.description: The SA80 (SA-80—Small Arms for the 1980s) is a British family of firearms developed in the mid-1980s. It comprises the L85 assault rifle, the L86 LMG, the L22 carbine and the L98 cadet rifle. The set is used as the service weapons of the British Army.
g4060.description_zh: SA80（SA-80——1980年代轻武器）是英国于1980年代中期开发的一系列枪支。它包括L85突击步枪、L86轻机枪、L22卡宾枪和L98学员步枪。该系列作为英国军队的制式武器使用。

g4mdp.description: The AK-12 Kalashnikov assault rifle is a promising personal firearm used by the Russian army and other security forces. It provides even greater combat effectiveness and universal applicability, as well as boasting better accuracy and grouping.
g4mdp.description_zh: AK-12卡拉什尼科夫突击步枪是俄罗斯军队和其他安全部队使用的有前途的个人枪支。它提供了更高的战斗效能和通用适用性，并拥有更好的精度和弹着散布。

j5l37.description: The AEK-971 is an assault rifle that was developed in 1978 at the Degtyarev factory in Kovrov.
j5l37.description_zh: AEK-971是一款突击步枪，于1978年在科弗罗夫的杰格佳廖夫工厂开发。

2onjv.description: Tec-DC9 is a compact 9 mm caliber submachine gun. Developed in the USA as a cheap clone of the Swedish MP-9, it operates with a blowback action and looks like something welded together in a garage—but it works. It became a symbol of inexpensive, yet brutally dangerous weaponry. It was banned in the USA and is now primarily distributed through the Black Market.
2onjv.description_zh: Tec-DC9是一款紧凑型9毫米口径冲锋枪。在美国作为瑞典MP-9的廉价仿制品开发，采用自由枪机式原理，看起来像是在车库里焊接出来的——但它能用。它成为了廉价但危险有效武器的象征。它在美国被禁止，现在主要通过黑市流通。

knlq0.description: A Russian submachine gun designed as an antipersonnel close-quarters weapon for use against opponents wearing personal protective equipment.
knlq0.description_zh: SR-2M“维列斯克”是一款俄罗斯冲锋枪，旨在作为近战反人员武器，用于对抗使用个人防护装备的对手。

m0m7j.description: A modification of the base PP-91 KEDR. It uses a special type of flechette rounds.
m0m7j.description_zh: 基础PP-91 KEDR的改型。它使用一种特殊的箭形弹。

n4p76.description:
A simple blowback-operated submachine gun that fires from a closed bolt for improved accuracy.

Its common caliber, comfortable handling, and renowned build quality have made it popular throughout the Zone. The only real drawback is its relatively small magazine capacity.
n4p76.description_zh:
一款采用自由枪机式操作、闭膛待击以提高精度的冲锋枪。

其常见口径、舒适的手感以及著名的制造质量使其在整个区域广受欢迎。唯一真正的缺点是其相对较小的弹匣容量。

2onz6.description: A Russian 5.45x39 mm caliber LMG. This machine gun is being developed as a potential replacement for the RPK-74 Kalashnikov LMG, both for regular troops and for special ops units.
2onz6.description_zh: 一款俄罗斯5.45x39毫米口径轻机枪。这款机枪正在开发中，作为卡拉什尼科夫RPK-74轻机枪的潜在替代品，供常规部队和特种部队使用。

4q0rl.description: A Russian general-purpose machine gun, based on the PKM. It was intended for attacking enemy personnel, gun batteries, transport, and airborne targets.

m0v5k.description: An adept ceremonial knife that can pierce any armor.
m0v5k.description_zh: 能够刺穿任何护甲的行家仪式刀

rwrng.description: A modern assault rifle developed to replace the aging AK-74. One of its main features is the ability to fire bursts of two shots with high accuracy (at a range of 100 meters, both bullets hit the same point). This substantially increases the chances of taking down a target thanks to the combined penetrative and stopping power of the bullets. The modified version has an increased rate of fire.
rwrng.description_zh: 一款现代突击步枪，旨在取代当时老化的AK-74。其主要特点之一是能够以高精度进行两发点射（在100米距离内，两颗子弹命中同一点）。这显著提高了击倒目标的机会，这要归功于子弹的综合穿透力和停止力。改装版本具有更高的射速。

lyljj.description: A variation on the M4 carbine with an extended barrel, which increases its effectiveness at long range.
lyljj.description_zh: M4卡宾枪的一个变体，带有加长枪管，提高了其远程有效性。

p63g2.description: The Steyr AUG (which stands for "Armee Universal Gewehr," meaning "universal army rifle") is a range of small arms that was launched in 1977 by the Austrian company Steyr-Daimler-Puch. In this particular rifle, a bullpup layout has been used, whereby the magazine and breech are located behind the firing hand grip and the trigger. There are two firing modes: single-shot and full-automatic.
p63g2.description_zh: 斯太尔AUG（代表“Armee Universal Gewehr”，意为“通用陆军步枪”）是由奥地利公司Steyr-Daimler-Puch于1977年推出的一系列轻武器。在这款特定步枪中，采用了无托结构，即弹匣和枪机位于射击握把和扳机后方。有两种射击模式：单发和全自动。

rw27g.description: A modification of the AKS-74 that allows the shooter to engage at longer distances. Meticulous work on the weapons barrel, breech, and gas tube has increased its accuracy and muzzle velocity. However, a decision was made to limit its rate of fire in order to maintain its durability.
rw27g.description_zh: AKS-74的改型，允许射手在更远距离交战。对武器枪管、枪机和气体导管的细致工作提高了其精度和初速。然而，为了保持其耐用性，决定限制其射速。

96mr0.description:
The standard South Korean service rifle. A dependable weapon trusted by several generations of Republic of Korea servicemen. Nothing excessive—just practicality, durability, and straightforward military simplicity.

The rifle found its way into the Zone shortly after the expansion of the JSSF, quickly making its way into the hands of stalkers through the well-established channels of equipment traders.
96mr0.description_zh:
标准的韩国现役步枪。几代韩国军人信赖的可靠武器。没有多余的东西——只有实用性、耐用性和直截了当的军事简洁性。

该步枪在JSSF扩张后不久进入了区域，通过装备商人的成熟渠道迅速落入潜行者手中。

0r2my.description:
A Soviet "vertical" that became very popular among enthusiasts of target shooting.

The practice of "shooting at plates"—quickly hitting a moving target—will always be useful in the Zone. Taking down a charging mutant swiftly can mean the difference between life and death. It also comes with the classic reliability and simplicity characteristic of all Soviet TOZs.
0r2my.description_zh:
这款苏联"立双"在靶射击爱好者中非常受欢迎。


"飞碟射击"——快速命中移动目标的练习——在Zone中总是很有用：迅速击倒冲过来的变异体对生存至关重要。此外，它继承了所有苏联TOZ枪械典型的可靠性和简单性。

rw2yy.description:
A double-barreled shotgun with vertically arranged barrels.

Its distinguished by its rifled barrels, earning it the nickname "stutzen." Reliable, accurate, aesthetic, and timeless, its a classic example of Soviet-era commercial firearms.
rw2yy.description_zh:
双管霰弹枪，枪管为垂直排列。


显著特点是采用了线膛枪管，因此也可称为"短步枪"。可靠、精准、美观且永恒，是苏联时代民用枪械的经典之作。

wjogp.description: A representative of a new family of assault rifles. Thanks to its high reliability, accuracy, and ease of handling, it is one of the best examples of a weapon in its class. It is not frequently encountered in the Zone, and it costs a pretty penny. It is usually seasoned stalkers who order one of these specially for themselves.
wjogp.description_zh: 新一代突击步枪家族的代表。凭借其高可靠性、精度和易操作性，它是同类武器中的最佳范例之一。在区域并不常见，且价格不菲。通常是老练的潜行者专门为自己订购。

g407g.description: The SA80 (SA-80—Small Arms for the 1980s) is a British family of firearms developed in the mid-1980s. It comprises the L85 assault rifle, the L86 LMG, the L22 carbine and the L98 cadet rifle. The set is used as the service weapons of the British Army.
g407g.description_zh: SA80（SA-80——1980年代轻武器）是英国在1980年代中期开发的枪支系列。它包括L85突击步枪、L86轻机枪、L22卡宾枪和L98学员步枪。该系列被用作英国陆军的制式武器。

zz7m9.description: A Soviet LMG developed in 1944 to use 7.62 mm rounds.
zz7m9.description_zh: 苏联于1944年开发的7.62毫米轻机枪。

zz2vm.description: Franchi SPAS-12 (Special Purpose Automatic Shotgun), an Italian shotgun developed in the late 1970s
zz2vm.description_zh: Franchi SPAS-12（特种用途自动霰弹枪）——一款意大利霰弹枪，于1970年代末开发。

rw255.description: A handheld, American-made, 5.56 caliber US army LMG (manufactured by the local branch of the Belgian company FN Herstal). Mass production of this weapon began in the 1980s.
rw255.description_zh: 一款手持式美国制造的5.56口径美国陆军轻机枪（由比利时公司FN赫斯塔尔的当地分部制造）。该武器的大规模生产始于1980年代。

2odq0.description:
The AK-203 is a modernized version of the AK-103, with the number 203 denoting its export designation. It combines the time-tested reliability of the classic Kalashnikov with modern ergonomics: Picatinny rails on the receiver and handguard for mounting optics, flashlights, and lasers, a telescoping adjustable stock, and an ergonomic pistol grip.

Within the Zone, it is a rare weapon obtained primarily through smuggling.
2odq0.description_zh:
AK-203是AK-103的现代化版本，编号203代表其出口代号。它将经典卡拉什尼科夫步枪久经考验的可靠性与现代人体工程学相结合：机匣和护木上配有皮卡汀尼导轨，用于安装光学瞄具、手电筒和激光指示器，配备伸缩式可调节枪托以及符合人体工程学的手枪握把。

在区域内，这是一种稀有武器，主要通过走私途径获得。

2ody0.description: A compact 7.62x39mm caliber assault rifle that, despite being a modification of the OTs-14 Groza, is compatible exclusively with AKM magazines.
2ody0.description_zh: 这是一款紧凑的7.62x39毫米口径突击步枪。尽管它是OTs-14 Groza的改型，但它只兼容AKM弹匣。

zz7j2.description: The epitome of new trends in Western automatic weapons: the mechanism is now no longer based on a semi-free slide, but on a short-action gas plunger. It must be said that these changes resulted in a clear improvement: this assault rifle is a first-class example of a modern weapon—light, reliable, and ergonomic.
zz7j2.description_zh: 西方自动武器新趋势的缩影：机制现在不再基于半自由枪机，而是基于短行程气动活塞。必须说，这些改变带来了明显的改进：这款突击步枪是现代武器的典范——轻便、可靠且符合人体工程学。

3gn5g.description: A Stechkin-designed assault rifle built in a bullpup layout. Uses a balanced automatic recoil system with a fixed magazine via two-step feeding from the magazine into the chamber. Equipped with a rail mount for installing various types of sights.
3gn5g.description_zh: 一款由斯捷奇金设计的突击步枪，采用无托结构。它使用带固定弹匣的平衡自动后坐系统，采用从弹匣到弹膛的两步供弹。配备用于安装各种瞄准镜的导轨座。

3grwz.description: A rifle designed for aimed fire in all conditions. The rifle shoots only in burst mode, which makes it more accurate and lowers recoil.
3grwz.description_zh: 一款设计用于在各种条件下进行瞄准射击的步枪。该步枪只以点射模式射击，这使其更精准并降低了后坐力。

4qnwn.description: A modification of the Groza with an integrated grenade launcher. It has been converted to take 5.45 mm rounds. It is unknown who produced these modifications, but the sheer number of these weapons that can be seen around would suggest that they were mass-produced.
4qnwn.description_zh: 带有集成榴弹发射器的“雷暴”改进型号。已转换为使用5.45毫米弹药。未知是谁生产了这些改装，但该武器在周围可见的数量表明它们是批量生产的。

0r2zd.description: Thanks to several modifications, muzzle rise has been reduced. In addition, many parts have been replaced with lighter equivalents, which has substantially reduced the weight of the weapon, allowing for more accurate firing while on the move.
0r2zd.description_zh: 得益于几项改装，枪口上跳有所减少。此外，许多部件已被更轻的等效部件替换，这大大减轻了武器重量，允许在移动中进行更精确的射击。

0r3nd.description: An assault rifle that entered into service in the Federal Republic of Germany in 1959.

0r2g1.description: A compact assault rifle developed by the Tulsky Instrument Design Bureau in 1992 as a more technologically advanced alternative to (and competitor for) the SR-3 Vikhr assault rifle.
0r2g1.description_zh: 一款紧凑型突击步枪，由图拉仪器设计局于1992年制造，作为SR-3“旋风”突击步枪的更技术化替代品（和竞争对手）。

1rjvr.description: This blade, in fact, is quite different from the Roman gladius, but that didnt stop Max Crow from calling it that—it has a ring to it! Despite this "crime against history," the blade can still be as effective as a real gladius.
1rjvr.description_zh: 实际上，这把刀与罗马短剑（gladius）有很大不同，尽管被如此称呼。然而，这并没有阻止Max Crow这样叫它——因为听起来很不寻常！尽管这是“对历史的犯罪”，但这把刀仍然可以像真正的短剑一样有效。

3g9n1.description: A classic baseball bat. Its possible uses are not limited to sport, however.
3g9n1.description_zh: 经典棒球棒。然而，其可能的用途不仅限于运动。

6wz1n.description: They say this knife is made from the very "flesh of the Inside Out." In any case, it does a good job at cutting human flesh.
6wz1n.description_zh: 据说这把刀是由“里外的肉体”制成的。无论如何，它在切割人肉方面做得很好。

6wz6n.description: Designed for rescue operations and wilderness survival.
6wz6n.description_zh: 为救援行动和野外生存设计。

4q09p.description: An assault rifle that entered into service in the Federal Republic of Germany in 1959.
4q09p.description_zh: 一款德国突击步枪，于1959年被德意志联邦共和国投入使用。

6wzzn.description: A saw covered in a substance from zombies in Boral
6wzzn.description_zh: 一把覆盖着Boral僵尸物质的锯子

7l5g9.description: This imposing weapon is filled with anomalous energy from the Inside Out. Rumor has it that anyone killed with this blade is reborn as a ghost in the Inside Out.
7l5g9.description_zh: 这把令人生畏的武器充满了来自里外的异常能量。传言称，任何被此刃杀死的人都会在里外重生为鬼魂。

g405g.description: LMG developed to replace the 7.62x39 mm RPK machine gun in the military within the framework of the firearm system that used intermediate 5.45x39 mm rounds. It was adopted in 1974 along with the AK-74.
g405g.description_zh: 为在军队中用使用中间型5.45x39毫米弹药的武器系统替换7.62x39毫米RPK机枪而开发的轻机枪。于1974年与AK-74一同列装。

knvvj.description: Covered in ice, this Kukri is used by Frost Hunters.
knvvj.description_zh: 覆盖着冰霜，这把廓尔喀刀被寒霜猎人使用。

lyv42.description: The ZIVCAS Zeus-77 is the latest in the Zeus electric baton line, representing the pinnacle of technology and efficiency. Lightning-fast strikes guaranteed!
lyv42.description_zh: ZIVCAS Zeus-77 - Zeus系列中最新型号的电击棍，代表了技术和效率的巅峰。保证闪电般的打击！

vj427.description: This tactical tomahawk is made of stainless steel. It is quite light and easy to handle.
vj427.description_zh: 这把战术印第安战斧由不锈钢制成。相当轻便，易于操作。

zzl2k.description: A knife designed for special units of the MIAs internal troops. It is characterized by its aggressive, contemporary design. This blade deals substantial stab damage, although slashing strikes are less effective.
zzl2k.description_zh: 为内务部内卫部队特种部队设计的刀。其侵略性的现代设计使其脱颖而出。这款刀刃可以造成严重的刺伤，尽管劈砍攻击效果较差。

5ln9o.description: Developed by Glock for the Austrian army, this pistol was the companys first. The resulting design proved well-executed and easy to use, earning it a place in the military. Its combat performance and reliability also made it a widely favored choice for civilian self-defense.
5ln9o.description_zh: 奥地利手枪，由格洛克为军队开发。这是该公司开发的第一款武器。由此产生的例子被证明相当成功且易于使用，因此被奥地利陆军采用。由于其战斗能力和可靠性，它被广泛用作民用自卫手段。

j5ovl.description: A six-shot .357 caliber Magnum revolver. It is built according to an I-frame design and boasts a smooth trigger and high accuracy.

knmgj.description: A six-shot .357 caliber Magnum revolver. It is built according to an I-frame design and boasts a smooth trigger and high accuracy.
knmgj.description_zh: .357 Magnum口径六发转轮手枪。采用I型框架结构设计，具有平滑的扳机和高精度。

zz25k.description: An improved model of the M1911, this pistol became a true classic of automatic firearms and endured all military conflicts of the 20th century with flying colors. Both the original and the modified versions are still produced today by dozens, if not hundreds, of manufacturers. Its only notable shortcoming is the limited magazine capacity, though this is offset to some extent by its powerful rounds.
zz25k.description_zh: M1911的改进型号，这款手枪成为经典的自动武器，并在20世纪的所有军事冲突中表现出色。与其前身一样，这款改进型号至今仍在数十甚至数百地生产。其有限的弹匣容量可能被视为其唯一的缺点，但这在一定程度上被其威力大的子弹所抵消。

y32j0.description: An Italian automatic pistol that was developed by the Beretta company based on the self-loading Beretta 92 pistol in the 1970s for law enforcement agencies and the military.
y32j0.description_zh: 意大利自动手枪，由伯莱塔公司在1970年代基于伯莱塔92半自动手枪为执法机构和军队开发。

qjgr4.description: In memory of the campaigns when brave bogatyrs stood up against the lizards, the battle axe became a symbol of resilience and brotherhood among warriors united with a single purpose—to protect the sacred waters of Baikal from the lizard menace.
qjgr4.description_zh: 为了纪念勇猛壮士对抗蜥蜴的战役，战斧成为了战士们坚韧和兄弟情谊的象征，他们团结一致，只有一个目的——保护贝加尔湖神圣的水域免受蜥蜴威胁。

ly2v2.description: A true pocket cannon, this weapon is large and heavy and possesses extremely high stopping power. It was developed as a specialized weapon for hunting medium-sized and large animals, and also for shooting sports using silhouette targets at a range of over 50 meters. Due to its price, weight, and huge dimensions, it has never been widely used in the Zone.

j5o9g.description: This revolver is a further development of the MTs-255 single-barrel revolver shotgun.
j5o9g.description_zh: 这款转轮手枪是MTs-255单管转轮霰弹枪的下一代。

m0mz2.description: The MAC 1014 has been used by troops across the world for almost twenty years. It was popularized in the Zone by the Dead Mans Marathon: many contestants found it handy for blasting hordes of zombies.
m0mz2.description_zh: M1014已被世界各地的部队使用了近二十年。它在区域因“死人马拉松”而普及：许多参赛者发现它对于轰击成群的丧尸很方便。

m0mvk.description: Modification of the legendary SW1911, chambered for the 9x39 mm round. The Smesson is the choice of fighters who trust their aim: the pistols firepower is increased by reducing the rate of fire and magazine capacity.
m0mvk.description_zh: 传奇的SW1911的改型，适配9x39毫米弹药。Smesson是那些对自己的准确性有信心的战士的选择：手枪的火力通过降低射速和弹匣容量而增强。

n4m93.description: A Russian-made revolver that uses .357 Smith & Wesson Magnum round (9x33 mm). It was developed at the Izhevsk Mechanical Plant at the end of the 1990s.
n4m93.description_zh: 一款俄罗斯制造的左轮手枪，使用.357史密斯·韦森马格南弹药（9x33毫米）。于1990年代末在伊热夫斯克机械制造厂开发。

rw2zz.description: Gyurza for 10 mm cartridge... It turned out to be a strange thing.
rw2zz.description_zh: 用于10毫米子弹的毒蛇...结果是件奇怪的东西。

0r211.description: The SIX12 smoothbore revolver-type shotgun was developed by the American company Crye Precision and was first revealed to the general public at the start of 2014. It was designed with a revolver-type bullpup configuration.
0r211.description_zh: SIX12滑膛转轮式霰弹枪由美国Crye Precision公司开发，并于2014年初首次向公众展示。它采用了转轮式无托结构设计。

ly2m1.description: The Benelli M4 Super 90, better known as the M1014, is a smoothbore, self-loading, magazine-fed shotgun that was developed by the Italian firm Benelli Armi S. p. A.
ly2m1.description_zh: 贝内利M4 Super 90，更广为人知的名字是M1014，是一款滑膛、半自动、弹匣供弹霰弹枪，由意大利公司Benelli Armi S. p. A. 开发。

wj7v3.description: The hunting version of the combat pump-action shotgun. It was developed in 1993 for special units of Russias law-enforcement agencies.
wj7v3.description_zh: 战斗泵动式霰弹枪的狩猎版本。它于1993年为俄罗斯执法机构的特种部队开发。

y32o3.description: A Russian smoothbore self-loading shotgun of the so-called "Murka" type used for various types of hunting, shooting sports, and self-defense, as well as by law-enforcement and security personnel.
y32o3.description_zh: 一种俄罗斯滑膛自装填霰弹枪，属于所谓的“Murka”类型，用于各种类型的狩猎、射击运动和自卫，以及执法和安保人员使用。

y32v3.description: A Russian smoothbore pump-action shotgun used for various types of hunting, shooting sports, and self-defense, as well as by security personnel.
y32v3.description_zh: 一种俄罗斯滑膛泵动式霰弹枪，用于各种类型的狩猎、射击运动和自卫，以及安保人员使用。

5lny1.description:
The M40 is an American sniper rifle based on the Remington 40XB.
Additional properties
5lny1.description_zh: M40是一款美国狙击步枪，基于雷明顿40XB构建。

g4mk6.description: This sniper rifle has been on the arms market for a good half a century, establishing itself as an extremely reliable and easy-to-use weapon. In the military, it is used mainly to engage targets at distances beyond the effective range of an assault rifle. However, stalkers value the SVD primarily for its ability to penetrate even the thickest mutant skin or the toughest body armor.
g4mk6.description_zh: 这款狙击步枪在武器市场上已经存在了半个世纪，在那段时间里，它以极其可靠和易于使用而闻名。在军队中，它主要用于攻击突击步枪无法击中的远距离目标。然而，潜行者看重SVD主要是因为它射出的子弹可以穿透最厚的变异体皮肤或最坚硬的护甲。

j5oq0.description: As rumor has it, a shipment of German rifles from the Second World War was intercepted and ended up in the Zone in the hands of a group of foreign mercenaries. The rifles have been modified: the weapons have been updated for the more common 7.62 rounds, and the baseline rate of fire has been reduced for improved control. A key feature is now its capability for short bursts of fire at double firing rate, causing colossal damage over a set period of time.
j5oq0.description_zh: 据传闻，一批二战时期的德国步枪被截获并落入了一群外国雇佣兵手中，进入了特异区。这些步枪经过了改装：武器更新为使用更常见的7.62弹药，并且为了改善操控性，基础射速有所降低。现在的一个关键特点是能够以双倍射速进行短点射，在设定时间内造成巨大伤害。

g4mvn.description: Pistols in this series are renowned worldwide for being reliable, albeit bulky. They are used by military and police units across many countries, and are equally popular among criminals for their powerful rounds and large magazines. It is generally the older versions of this weapon that find their way into the Zone.
g4mvn.description_zh: 该系列手枪在世界各地享有可靠但笨重的声誉。它在许多国家的军队和警察部队中服役。这把枪在犯罪分子中也同样流行，因为其威力大的子弹和大容量弹匣。一般来说，进入特异区的是该武器的旧版本。

rw2ky.description: A beautiful and formidable weapon. Armed with it, a talented shooter will feel perfectly confident anywhere, whether in the middle of the Zones wilderness or in a fierce Arena battle.
rw2ky.description_zh: 一件美丽而令人生畏的武器。装备它，一位有才华的射手将在任何地方都感到无比自信，无论是在特异区荒野的中心还是在激烈的竞技场战斗中。

j5ly4.description: A British light machine gun from World War II, supplied to the Red Army under Lend-Lease.
j5ly4.description_zh: 一种二战时期的英国轻机枪，通过租借法案供应给红军。

knm5y.description: M1A self-loading rifle, valued by stalkers for its availability, accuracy, and stopping power.
knm5y.description_zh: M1A半自动步枪。由于可用性高、精度高且停止力大，它在潜行者中很受欢迎。

knmpy.description: This 9 mm special sniper rifle (a VSS that was developed under the title Vintorez, a name that has remained in use) is a silenced sniper rifle. It was created in the Tochmash Central Scientific Research Institute for Precision Machine Engineering in Klimovsk at the start of the 1980s under the leadership of Pyotr Ivanovich Serdyukov. It was intended for use by special ops units.

ly2rk.description:
A large-caliber MTs-558 carbine with manual reloading in the bullpup configuration, based on the VSSK Vykhlop (meaning "Exhaust") silenced rifle.
Additional properties
ly2rk.description_zh: 大口径MTs-558卡宾枪是一款无托布局的手动装填狩猎步枪。它基于特种“Vykhlop”（意为“排气”）VSSK消音步枪的结构。

6w64y.description: A magazine-fed repeating shotgun. This model was intended as a means of self-defense, as well as for hunting. The magazine compartment accommodates five 12 gauge rounds.
6w64y.description_zh: 一款弹匣供弹泵动霰弹枪。该型号旨在作为自卫手段，也用于狩猎。弹匣室可容纳五发12号口径弹药。

1r756.description: A custom model assembled from an HK UMP, an MP5, and something else... indeterminate. Combines good stopping power, excellent ergonomics, and a roomy magazine.
1r756.description_zh: 由HK UMP、MP5和一些其他……不确定的东西组装而成的样品。结合了良好的停止力、出色的人体工程学和大容量弹匣。

1rdg6.description: This submachine gun is extremely popular thanks to its reliability, ease of use and high firing accuracy. The military and police departments of many countries are armed with this gun, which eventually appeared on the Black Market and made it to the Zone.
1rdg6.description_zh: 这款冲锋枪因其可靠性、易用性和高射击精度而极为流行。许多国家的军队和警察部门都装备了这款枪，它最终出现在黑市并进入了区域。

5ldrg.description: The FN P90 is a Belgian submachine gun developed in 1986–1987 by FN Herstal. The 5.7x28 mm round was designed specifically for the P90 and offers high penetration. However, due to the rounds low popularity, P90s that reach the Zone are converted to 9 mm. This submachine gun is fairly popular among well-to-do stalkers and thrill-seekers on tour.
5ldrg.description_zh: FN P90是一款比利时冲锋枪，由FN赫斯塔尔于1986–1987年开发。5.7x28毫米弹药类型专为P90开发，具有高穿透力。然而，由于弹药的低普及度，进入区域的P90已被转换为使用9毫米弹药。这款冲锋枪在富有的潜行者和寻求刺激的游客中变得相当受欢迎。

okm10.description: The Steyr AUG 9mm submachine gun, also known as the AUG Para, was created based on the construction and design of the well-known Austrian assault rifle, the Steyr AUG 5.56mm caliber. The main difference from the AUG assault rifle is that the Steyr AUG 9mm uses pistol rounds.
okm10.description_zh: 斯太尔AUG 9毫米冲锋枪，也称为AUG Para，是基于著名的奥地利突击步枪——5.56毫米口径斯太尔AUG的结构和设计创建的。与AUG突击步枪的主要区别在于斯太尔AUG 9毫米使用手枪弹药。

p6r76.description:
Also known as the PP-19, this submachine gun was originally developed for the Vityaz special unit, from which it takes its name.

Based on the AK platform, it operates using a simple blowback system and is equipped with Picatinny rails for optics and other accessories. Straightforward and exceptionally reliable, it can be used effectively by anyone with even minimal firearms experience.
p6r76.description_zh:
也被称为PP-19，这款冲锋枪最初是为Vityaz特种部队开发的，并因此得名。

基于AK平台，它采用简单的自由枪机式系统，并配备皮卡汀尼导轨用于安装光学瞄具和其他附件。简单且极其可靠，即使只有最基础枪械经验的人也能有效使用。

zz7d2.description: A 19 model submachine gun developed in 1993 by Viktor Kalashnikov (son of Mikhail Kalashnikov) and Aleksey Dragunov (son of Yevgeny Dragunov) at the request of the Russian Ministry of Internal Affairs.
zz7d2.description_zh: 一款1993年型号的冲锋枪，由维克托·卡拉什尼科夫（米哈伊尔·卡拉什尼科夫之子）和阿列克谢·德拉贡诺夫（叶夫根尼·德拉贡诺夫之子）应俄罗斯内政部的要求开发。

zz7q2.description: The AUG A3 9mm XS is a compact submachine gun based on the Steyr AUG, originally created for law enforcement and special forces. How it made its way into the Zone is unclear, but its popularity among the locals speaks for itself.
zz7q2.description_zh: AUG A3 9mm XS是一款基于斯太尔AUG的紧凑型冲锋枪，最初为执法部门和特种部队创建。它如何进入区域尚不清楚，但其在当地人中的受欢迎程度不言而喻。

y37dz.description: A Russian submachine gun developed in 2004 by Izhmash. Used by members of the Russian Ministry of Internal Affairs and the Russian police force. A further development of the PP-19 Bizon.
y37dz.description_zh: 一款俄罗斯冲锋枪，由伊兹马什于2004年开发。供俄罗斯内政部成员和俄罗斯警察部队使用。是PP-19“野牛”的进一步发展。

rw2vv.description:
A modification of the classic SVD developed for airborne troops and special operations units.

It features a folding stock, polymer furniture, and a shortened, heavier-profile barrel. Widely regarded as one of the finest SVD variants, it combines compact dimensions with excellent accuracy at medium and long ranges (up to 800 meters).

A true workhorse that easily withstands the harsh conditions of the Zone and will serve as a reliable companion to any fortunate owner.
rw2vv.description_zh:
SVD的一款改进型号，专为空降部队和特种作战单位开发。

它配备折叠枪托、聚合物枪身配件，以及缩短且加粗的枪管。被广泛认为是最优秀的SVD变体之一，结合了紧凑的尺寸和中远程（最远800米）的出色精度。

一把真正的多面手，能轻松承受区域的严酷条件，将成为任何有幸拥有它的人的可靠伙伴。

wj72d.description: This assault rifle looks exactly the same as the SVT-40, with just a small alteration to the trigger mechanism. In terms of its weight and size, the AVT-40 is indistinguishable from the SVT-40. Due to some structural flaws, it wears out quickly, as continuous automatic fire can deform the receiver.
wj72d.description_zh: 这款突击步枪看起来与SVT-40完全相同，只是对扳机机构进行了小幅改动。就其重量和尺寸而言，AVT-40与SVT-40没有区别。由于一些结构缺陷，它磨损很快，因为持续的自动射击会使机匣变形。

vjr7n.description:
The Beretta Mx4 Storm is an Italian submachine gun developed for military and law enforcement use. It is the combat version of the civilian Cx4 Storm carbine, distinguished by its fully automatic firing capability. The weapon features a futuristic design created by a renowned automotive designer.

Within the Zone, it is the weapon of choice for professionals who value mobility and a high rate of fire. Its compact size and low weight make it indispensable in cramped underground tunnels, abandoned bunkers, and urban environments.
vjr7n.description_zh:
贝雷塔Mx4 Storm是一款为军事和执法用途开发的意大利冲锋枪。它是民用型Cx4 Storm卡宾枪的战斗版本，区别在于具备全自动射击能力。该武器由一位知名汽车设计师操刀，采用未来主义设计。

在区域内，它是重视机动性和高射速的专业人士的首选武器。其紧凑的尺寸和轻量化使其在狭窄的地下隧道、废弃掩体和城市环境中不可或缺。

n4229.description: A karambit made from a mutants claw. It can penetrate any protection.
n4229.description_zh: 由变异体爪子制成的鹰爪刀。可以穿透任何防护。

p613d.description: An American bayonet knife adopted by the US Armed Forces.
p613d.description_zh: 美国陆军列装的美式刺刀。

0r2qk.description: Modified Hi-Power pistol, adapted for 9x39mm round. Increased damage is achieved by slightly reducing the rate of fire and magazine capacity.
0r2qk.description_zh: 改装的高威力手枪，适配9x39毫米弹药。通过略微降低射速和弹匣容量来实现更高的伤害。

j5or6.description: An Austrian automatic pistol. It was intended for use by special units of the army and police. On the whole, the Glock 18 inherited all the benefits of the Glock 17 pistol and was very similar to the latter in terms of its design, however it differed in that it had the ability to fire full auto.
j5or6.description_zh: 一款奥地利自动手枪。旨在供军队和警察的特种部队使用。总的来说，格洛克18继承了格洛克17手枪的所有优点，并且在设计上与其非常相似，然而它的不同之处在于能够全自动射击。

4qn2o.description_zh: 一款12号口径滑膛转轮式战斗霰弹枪。

wj792.description:
The Unique Alpine TPG-1 is an Austrian sniper rifle. When firing, rounds are fed from a detachable box magazine that holds five rounds.
Additional properties
wj792.description_zh: 独特的Alpine TPG-1是奥地利狙击步枪。射击时，子弹从一个可拆卸的盒式弹匣供弹，弹匣容量为5发。

y32gk.description:
The M40 is an American sniper rifle based on the Remington 40XB.
Additional properties

7lnk7.description:
A Russian magazine-fed sniper rifle designed based on the single-shot MTs-116 sports rifle.
Additional properties
7lnk7.description_zh: 一款俄罗斯弹匣供弹狙击步枪，基于单发MTs-116运动步枪设计。

j5vvl.description: A knife intended for use by military stalkers. It stands out due to its aggressive, contemporary design. Allows for quick slashing attacks.
j5vvl.description_zh: 为军方潜行者设计的刀。其侵略性的现代设计使其脱颖而出。允许快速劈砍攻击。

qjgg4.description: Covered in ice, this ice pick is used by Frost Hunters.
qjgg4.description_zh: 覆盖着冰霜，这把冰镐被寒霜猎人使用。

wj71z.description: The Serdyukov self-loading pistol was developed for special forces as part of the Rook R&D program, designed for higher-performance ammunition.
wj71z.description_zh: 谢尔久科夫半自动手枪，作为使用更有效弹药的Rook研发计划的一部分，为特种部队开发。

5ln7q.description: A self-loading shotgun developed at the Izhevsk Machine-Building Plant based on the Kalashnikov assault rifle. It was intended for commercial and amateur hunting of small and medium-sized animals and birds in regions with any climatic conditions. The Saiga inherited the general configuration and structure of the AK, with a gas dissipation mechanism and rotating bolt.
5ln7q.description_zh: 一款基于卡拉什尼科夫突击步枪在伊热夫斯克机械制造厂开发的自装填霰弹枪。它旨在用于任何气候条件下商业和业余狩猎中小型动物和鸟类。Saiga继承了AK的总体配置和结构，带有气体消散机制和旋转枪机。

qj253.description: An Italian-made triple-barrel, break-action shotgun. The barrels are arranged in a triangular configuration, with one at the top, and two underneath.
qj253.description_zh: 一款意大利制造的三管撅把式霰弹枪。枪管呈三角形排列，一个在上面，两个在下面。

lyv22.description: A machete with a strong steel blade and wooden grip scales, designed for hunting and hiking. Full metal construction ensures high durability.
lyv22.description_zh: 这把砍刀，具有坚固的钢刃和附着的木质刀柄，旨在用于狩猎和旅游。全金属结构确保了高耐用性。

vj297.description:
The Glock 18X is, in essence, a modern reinterpretation of the legendary Austrian Glock pistol.

Its defining feature compared to civilian models is its ability to fire in fully automatic mode. For this very reason, the Glock 18 was equipped with proprietary 33-round extended magazines, commonly nicknamed "happy sticks."

An extremely popular sidearm throughout the CEZ, though obtaining one is far from easy.
vj297.description_zh:
格洛克18X本质上是对传奇奥地利格洛克手枪的现代重新诠释。

与民用型号相比，它的决定性特征是能够以全自动模式射击。正因为如此，格洛克18配备了专用的33发加长弹匣，通常被戏称为“快乐棒”。

在整个禁区内是一种极受欢迎的手枪，不过要获得一把绝非易事。

g4v16.description: Weapon upgraded in the Arsenal Workshop

dmjdn.description: The AK-308 Kalashnikov assault rifle was developed by the Kalashnikov Concern at the request of foreign clients who had need of a powerful and reliable handheld automatic weapon that used the 7.62x51 NATO round.
dmjdn.description_zh: AK-308卡拉什尼科夫突击步枪由卡拉什尼科夫公司应国外客户要求开发，这些客户需要一款使用7.62x51 NATO弹的威力大且可靠的手持自动武器。

5ln40.description: A new stage of development in this well-known series of weapons. In reality, the alterations only affected the upper receiver, the barrel, the gas port, and the bolt system. The result is a more ergonomic and reliable rifle with reduced weight.
5ln40.description_zh: 这一著名系列武器发展的新阶段。实际上，改动仅涉及机匣上半部分，包括枪管、导气装置和枪机，从而改善了武器的工效学和可靠性，而其重量反而减轻。

zzl6m.description: A reusable Soviet handheld anti-tank grenade launcher. It is intended for dealing with tanks, self-propelled artillery, and other armored vehicles. It can be used to eliminate personnel behind cover and also counter low-flying, low-speed airborne targets.
zzl6m.description_zh: 可重复使用的苏联手持反坦克榴弹发射器。旨在对付坦克、自行火炮和其他装甲车辆。可用于消灭掩体后的人员，也可对抗低空低速空中目标。

lylnq.description:
The HK MP7A2 is the second iteration of the renowned German submachine gun.

Originally intended as the standard personal defense weapon for armored vehicle crews, fate had other plans—instead of tank crews, it was adopted by special operations forces around the world.

The HK MP7 combines compact dimensions, a high rate of fire, impressive stopping power, and excellent build quality, making it an outstanding choice for clearing confined spaces or mutant nests. Its armor penetration leaves enemy personnel with little chance of survival at short and even medium ranges. However, it comes at a premium price, making it a rare sight in the Zone.
lylnq.description_zh:
HK MP7A2是著名的德国冲锋枪的第二代型号。

它最初被设计为装甲车乘员的标准个人防卫武器，但命运另有安排——它没有被坦克兵采用，而是被世界各地的特种作战部队所装备。

HK MP7兼具紧凑的尺寸、高射速、可观的停止作用力和出色的制造质量，使其成为清理密闭空间或变异兽巢穴的绝佳选择。它的穿甲能力让敌方人员在短程甚至中距离内几乎没有生还机会。然而，它的价格不菲，因此在区域中颇为罕见。

5lgvo.description: If the undead wont leave you alone, just cut off their legs!
5lgvo.description_zh: 如果亡灵不放过你，就砍掉他们的腿！

ly2z2.description: The RSh-12 revolver has an integral metal frame and barrel for five rounds that ejects to the left.
ly2z2.description_zh: RSh-12转轮手枪具有一体式金属框架和向左弹出的五发弹巢。

m0m5k.description: A modular semi-automatic pistol from the American branch of SIG Sauer, Inc.
m0m5k.description_zh: 来自SIG Sauer美国分部的模块化半自动手枪。

2olgl.description:
The spiritual successor to the world-famous M200.

This highly accurate sniper rifle combines the precision and long-range performance of its predecessor while replacing the signature carry-handle chassis with a lightweight polymer handguard, making it significantly lighter and more compact.

This 7.62 mm variant is supplied in limited numbers to the finest mercenary snipers. Due to its design, a suppressor cannot be fitted—but dont worry, your target is unlikely to hear the shot anyway.
Additional properties

p63w4.description:
A Turkish AR-15-style shotgun popular among civilians and law enforcement alike thanks to its affordability and reliability.

Equipped with the proprietary BufferBolt system, which significantly reduces recoil. A rare but highly sought-after shotgun in the Zone, leaving enemies with little chance of survival at close range.
p63w4.description_zh:
一款土耳其制造的AR-15风格霰弹枪，凭借其价格亲民和可靠性，在平民和执法部门中都很受欢迎。

配备了专有的BufferBolt系统，可显著减少后坐力。在区域中虽属罕见但备受追捧的霰弹枪，能让敌人在近距离内几乎没有生还机会。

okmym.description: The owner of this weapon helped pave the way to the Northern locations for other Zone inhabitants with sweat and blood. If you were killed by this shotgun, you can be sure you were fortunate enough to meet a respected player.
okmym.description_zh: 这把武器的所有者曾用汗水和鲜血为其他区域居民通往北部地区铺平了道路。如果你被这把霰弹枪杀死，可以肯定你非常幸运地遇到了一位受人尊敬的玩家。

6w61n.description:
A folding submachine gun popular among Baron’s personal security detail. It was purchased in bulk, and Baron is willing to pass the surplus on to a lucky chosen few.

Folded up, it doesn’t draw unwanted attention. But the moment things get out of hand, that unassuming case turns into a serious close-quarters weapon in a matter of seconds. A weapon with taste: incredibly expensive, exclusive, and brutally effective.
6w61n.description_zh:
折叠式冲锋枪，在巴伦的私人卫队中广受欢迎。巴伦大批采购，并愿意将多余的部分转交给被选中的幸运儿。

折叠时不会引起多余注意。但只要局势失控——不起眼的箱子便能在几秒内变成强大的近战武器。有品位的武器：非常昂贵、独一无二、极其致命。

ok9p6.description: A modification of the Desert Eagle pistol. Like its predecessor, it remains the best weapon for those who require high lethality in critical situations. Adapted for the 9x39 mm round, which significantly increases its firepower.
ok9p6.description_zh: 沙漠之鹰手枪的改装。作为其前身，它仍然是那些在危急情况下需要高致命性的最佳武器。适配9x39毫米弹药，显著增加了火力。

969kl.description:
A “pfft” that costs a life. A weapon capable of building up monstrous pneumatic pressure for a couple of precise shots that leave no chance of survival. 
Though hand-crafted, this specimen is so well made that, with a full tank, the movement of air is completely silent. Unlike its CO2 counterparts on the Mainland, it uses a regular air mixture, which prevents the air-line gaskets from wearing out.
Additional properties
969kl.description_zh:
“噗”的一声，价值一条命。这种武器能够积蓄可怕的气动潜力，用于几次毫无逃生可能的精准射击。
虽然是手工制作，但品质极高，满罐时听不到空气流动的声音。与大陆上使用二氧化碳的同类不同，它使用普通空气混合气体，因此气路垫圈不会磨损。

m0v1y.description: Weapon upgraded in the Arsenal Workshop

5lnw0.description: A NATO firearm produced by the Belgian company FN Herstal. Its one of the best known and most widely used automatic rifles in the world.
5lnw0.description_zh: FN FAL是一款由比利时公司FN赫斯塔尔生产的北约枪支。它是最著名和广泛使用的自动步枪之一。

rwz0z.description: Created for ZIVCAS officers, this dagger combines classic design and modern technology. It becomes a reliable companion in any trials, symbolizing the unyielding will and valor of its owner. ZIVCAS Valor is more than a weapon; it is a symbol of resilience and loyalty.
rwz0z.description_zh: 为ZIVCAS军官创建的匕首，结合了经典设计和现代技术。它成为任何考验中可靠的伙伴，象征着其主人不屈的意志和勇气。ZIVCAS Valor不仅仅是一件武器；它是坚韧和忠诚的象征。

qj2zk.description: The AA-12 (Auto Assault-12) is an automatic shotgun that was created by Maxwell Atchisson, based on the prior development of the Atchisson Assault Shotgun.
qj2zk.description_zh: AA-12（自动突击-12）是一款自动霰弹枪，由马克斯韦尔·阿奇森基于阿奇森突击霰弹枪的先前开发成果创建。

n42g1.description: Weapon upgraded in the Arsenal Workshop

y32z0.description: A true pocket cannon, this weapon is large and heavy and possesses extremely high stopping power. It was developed as a specialized weapon for hunting medium-sized and large animals, and also for shooting sports using silhouette targets at a range of over 50 meters. Due to its price, weight, and huge dimensions, it has never been widely used in the Zone.
y32z0.description_zh: 真正的口袋大炮，这款武器又大又重，具有极高的停止力。它作为狩猎中型和大型动物以及使用超过50米距离的轮廓靶进行射击运动的专用武器而开发。由于其价格、重量和巨大尺寸，它在特异区从未被广泛使用。

dmj6j.description: A semi-automatic sniper rifle developed by a world-renowned firearms manufacturer. Its design reflects modern ergonomic standards for precision rifles, allowing it to accommodate individual shooter preferences as well as a wide range of combat equipment.
dmj6j.description_zh: 一款由知名武器公司开发的自装填狙击步枪。该步枪的设计考虑了对该类武器的现代人机工程学要求，适应了射手个人的特点和他们使用广泛战斗装备的能力。

dmv6j.description: Weapon upgraded in the Arsenal Workshop

3gnzl.description: A Chinese sniper rifle supplied to the SSPP in a 5.45 caliber modification. While the rifle has proven to be effective in combat, some fighters in the Special Security Perimeter Protection still prefer "time-tested" weapons and sell their issued gear through contrabandists.
3gnzl.description_zh: 一款供应给SSPP的中国狙击步枪，改装为5.45口径。尽管该步枪在战斗中被证明是有效的，但一些特种安全边界防护部队的战斗人员仍然偏爱“经过时间考验”的武器，并通过走私者出售配发的装备。

wjo4p.description: A modification of the AEK-971 assault rifle, distinguished primarily by a different receiver design (removable cover on the AEK-971), which allows the installation of a Picatinny rail for various sights. There are also rails on the foregrip for installing additional attachments.
wjo4p.description_zh: AEK-971突击步枪的改装版本，主要区别在于不同的机匣设计（AEK-971上的可拆卸盖板），允许安装皮卡汀尼导轨以安装各种瞄准镜。护木上还有导轨可安装附加配件。

vj40r.description: Weapon upgraded in the Arsenal Workshop

zz2ky.description: This 9 mm special sniper rifle (a VSS that was developed under the title Vintorez, a name that has remained in use) is a silenced sniper rifle. It was created in the Tochmash Central Scientific Research Institute for Precision Machine Engineering in Klimovsk at the start of the 1980s under the leadership of Pyotr Ivanovich Serdyukov. It was intended for use by special ops units.
zz2ky.description_zh: 这款9毫米特种狙击步枪（一款以Vintorez为名开发的VSS，这个名称一直沿用）是一款消音狙击步枪。它由Klimovsk的Tochmash中央精密机械工程研究所在1980年代初在Pyotr Ivanovich Serdyukov的领导下创建。旨在供特种作战部队使用。

qjg3j.description: Weapon upgraded in the Arsenal Workshop

2ongl.description:
The spiritual successor to the world-famous M200.

This highly accurate sniper rifle combines the precision and long-range performance of its predecessor while replacing the signature carry-handle chassis with a lightweight polymer handguard, making it significantly lighter and more compact.

This 7.62 mm variant is supplied in limited numbers to the finest mercenary snipers. Due to its design, a suppressor cannot be fitted—but dont worry, your target is unlikely to hear the shot anyway.
Additional properties
2ongl.description_zh:
世界著名M200的精神继承者。

这款高精度狙击步枪结合了前代的精准度和远程性能，同时将标志性的提手式底盘替换为轻量化聚合物护木，使其显著更轻更紧凑。

这款7.62毫米型号限量供应给最优秀的雇佣兵狙击手。由于设计原因，无法安装消音器——但别担心，你的目标不太可能听到枪声。

5lgo1.description: Weapon upgraded in the Arsenal Workshop

rwz6v.description: Weapon upgraded in the Arsenal Workshop

n42q9.description:
A light and elegant butterfly knife taken from a fallen Murmur fighter.
The blades steel is laced with artifact materials, keeping it razor-sharp at all times.
n42q9.description_zh:
从倒下的Murmur战士身上获得的一把轻便优雅的蝴蝶刀。
刀刃钢中含有神器材料夹杂物，确保其锋利度始终如剃刀一般。

5ldz4.description: A modification of the A-545 for 7.62x39 mm caliber. The reduced rate of fire is compensated by increased firepower.
5ldz4.description_zh: A-545针对7.62x39毫米口径的改型。降低的射速由增强的火力补偿。

y3j20.description: A tactical tomahawk developed for use by rescue services, law enforcement, and the military. The effective combination of an axe, hammer, and crowbar in one tool allows it to be used when conducting a wide variety of operations.
y3j20.description_zh: 为救援服务、执法部门和军队使用的战术印第安战斧。斧、锤和撬棍的有效组合使其可用于执行各种行动。

ok9w5.description: A dagger with a diamond-shaped blade. In the Medieval Ages, these weapons were used to kill wounded enemies and for piercing in-between the plates of their armor. That doesnt mean it cant be used to do the same thing now...
ok9w5.description_zh: 一把菱形刀刃的匕首。在中世纪，这些武器被用来杀死受伤的敌人，并刺穿他们的板甲间隙。这并不意味着现在不能用来做同样的事情...

vj20r.description:
An updated version of the SVD, developed to improve accuracy and ergonomics while preserving the reliability of the original.

A new gas regulator, reinforced receiver, folding adjustable stock, Picatinny rail, and removable muzzle brake-compensator - in short, the complete gentlemans package for a modernized take on a 1963 classic.

Its combination of ergonomics, modularity, and time-tested reliability has made this rifle system extremely popular throughout the CEZ.
vj20r.description_zh:
SVD的升级版本，旨在提升精度和人机工程学，同时保留原版的可靠性。

新型导气调节器、强化机匣、折叠可调枪托、皮卡汀尼导轨以及可拆卸的枪口制退补偿器——简而言之，这是一套为1963年经典款现代化改造而准备的全方位升级方案。

其人机工程学、模块化设计以及久经考验的可靠性的结合，使这款步枪系统在整个禁区内极其受欢迎。

1r762.description:
A self-loading shotgun with a magazine feed, based on the Kalashnikov automatic rifle but adapted for commercial use. Like its "older brother," it boasts excellent reliability.

This model is equipped with rails for sights and other accessories. An extremely successful model, highly valued by many inhabitants of the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone.
1r762.description_zh:
弹匣供弹的自装填霰弹枪。卡拉什尼科夫自动步枪的民用改型。继承了其"老大哥"的主要特点——出色的可靠性。


该型号配备了用于瞄准镜和其他附件的导轨。一个极其成功的型号，受到切尔诺贝利禁区许多居民的青睐。

6w620.description:
A "premium" example from the Soviet hunting rifle family.
