The receiver is machined, and the components of the trigger mechanism are made from high-quality alloy steel, with an additional safety mechanism.

Production ceased due to the collapse of the Soviet Union, but individual examples still make their way into the Zone and are highly valued for their quality and reliability.
6w620.description_zh:
苏联猎枪家族中的"高级"样本。


机匣经过机械加工，扳机组零件采用优质合金钢制造。额外配备了保险装置。



因苏联解体而停产，但个别样品流入Zone，并因其质量和可靠性而备受珍视。

9692y.description:
A new generation of hunting rifles.

Lightweight thanks to its aluminum alloy construction, it features ambidextrous operation, rails for optics, and other attributes of modern firearms. Familiar classics in a modern rendition.
9692y.description_zh:
新一代猎枪。


因采用铝合金而重量轻。具备左撇子射手适配能力、瞄准装置导轨以及其他当代枪械的特征。换言之，是现代演绎下的经典之作。

rw23l.description: A modification of the SVU with a restored automatic fire feature. Known among stalkers as Wave. Due to the jury-rigged nature of the modification, the weapons accuracy and muzzle velocity have decreased.
rw23l.description_zh: 恢复了自动射击功能的SVU改型。在潜行者中被称为波浪。由于改装是临时性质的，武器的精度和初速有所下降。

y32nk.description: The WA2000 is a bullpup sniper rifle that was developed@by the weapons company Walther.
y32nk.description_zh: WA2000是一款无托狙击步枪，由@武器公司Walther开发。

rw26v.description_zh: 12.7x55杠杆动作托卡列夫-雷森科步枪。

wjowd.description: A modification of the AS Val assault rifle featuring increased modularity. The integrated Picatinny rail and multifunctional handguard make it possible to customize the rifle for a variety of different tasks.
wjowd.description_zh: AS Val突击步枪的改型，特点是增加了模块化。集成的皮卡汀尼导轨和多功能护木允许灵活地根据不同的任务定制步枪。

qj2l9.description: A well-known American machine gun in its latest modification, used among the contingent of NATO countries included in the SSPP.
qj2l9.description_zh: 著名的美国机枪的最新改进型，在加入SSPP的北约国家部队中有所使用。

5lnq4.description: German general-purpose machine gun. It is an improved version of the MG 42 machine gun.
5lnq4.description_zh: 德国通用机枪。是MG 42机枪的改进型。

rw2d5.description:
An American sniper rifle that uses 7.62x51 NATO rounds. It was developed specifically to be a powerful, compact, quiet, and accurate weapon for covert use by the army and security forces at close range, mainly in urban situations.
Additional properties
rw2d5.description_zh: 一款使用7.62x51 NATO弹的美国狙击步枪。它专为军队和安全部队在近距离（主要在城区）进行隐蔽行动而开发，旨在成为一种威力大、紧凑、安静且精确的武器。

j5vz0.description: Weapon upgraded in the Arsenal Workshop

m0mo7.description: A Russian sniper rifle based on the compact 9A-91 assault rifle and designed for silent, flash-suppressed firing. The VSK-94 was developed as a cheaper and more widely available alternative to the VSS Vintorez rifle. Indeed, the VSK-94 is effectively a cheap analog of the Vintorez: both systems use 9x39 rounds and have similar technical characteristics and tactical capabilities, but the VSK-94 is more technical, simpler in its configuration, cheaper to produce, and has a whole plethora of further advantages.
m0mo7.description_zh: 一款俄罗斯狙击步枪，基于紧凑的9A-91突击步枪设计，用于无声、无焰射击。VSK-94是作为VSS“绞丝机”步枪更便宜和更广泛可用的替代品而开发的。事实上，VSK-94实际上是“绞丝机”的廉价类似物：两种系统都使用9x39弹药，具有相似的技术特性和战术能力，但VSK-94更具技术性，配置更简单，生产成本更低，并且具有众多进一步的优势。

4qnzl.description: Experimental handheld machine gun chambered for the 12.7x55mm round. A powerful weapon for defeating armored targets at long ranges. It has a strong recoil and low rate of fire, which makes it difficult to use.
4qnzl.description_zh: 使用12.7x55毫米弹药的实验性手持机枪。用于远距离打击装甲目标的强大武器。后坐力强，射速低，难以使用。

knvmj.description: A deadly three-bladed knife created for killing. Wounds inflicted by this knife resemble the ones made with a three-edged bayonet. They take a long time to clot, so the victim usually dies of blood loss. This weapon got its name from an Austrian special ops units.
knvmj.description_zh: 为杀戮而创造的三刃致命刀。这把刀造成的伤口类似于三棱刺刀造成的伤口。它们需要很长时间才能凝固，因此受害者通常死于失血。这款武器得名于奥地利特种作战部队。

xs3059xD.description: An assault rifle for those whose stories invariably begin with the phrase, “Back in my day...” Under its muzzle, any of your tales will be listened to with due attention and reverence.
xs3059xD.description_zh: 一款为那些其故事总是以“想当年……”开头的人准备的突击步枪。在其枪口下，你的任何故事都会被带着应有的关注和敬意倾听。

3gr1z.description: A submachine gun that takes 9x19 mm Parabellum rounds. The special features of its construction, like a gas-operated system with a short-stroke piston, reduce the recoil and increase the weapons overall accuracy.
3gr1z.description_zh: 一款使用9x19毫米帕拉贝鲁姆弹药的冲锋枪。其结构细节，如短行程活塞气动系统，减少了后坐力并提高了武器的整体精度。

2ony6.description: The IWI X95 is an Israeli assault rifle that was developed and produced by Israel Weapon Industries as part of the Tavor series of weapons, alongside the TAR-21.
2ony6.description_zh: IWI X95是以色列突击步枪，由以色列武器工业公司作为Tavor武器系列的一部分开发和制造，与TAR-21并列。

4qnyn.description: A single-shot anti-tank weapon with a shortened barrel and an improvised mount for various types of sights. For the sake of accuracy, this weapon should be fired from a prone position.
4qnyn.description_zh: 一款单发反坦克武器，带有缩短的枪管和用于安装各种瞄准镜的临时支架。为了精度，应从卧姿发射此武器。

zzlwy.description: Weapon upgraded in the Arsenal Workshop

7lno6.description:
An American sniper rifle, modified by Black Market craftsmen to use the common caliber found in the Zone.

Despite a reduction in performance caused by the change in ammunition, the mechanics managed to compensate for the losses by reinforcing the bolt assembly and receiver. In addition, the recoil system was refined, allowing the rifle to retain handling comfort close to its original configuration.
Additional properties
7lno6.description_zh: 一把由美国黑市工匠改装以使用禁区常见口径的美式狙击步枪。

4q0gl.description:
The name emphasizes its hybrid design, combining the ergonomics of the AR-15 with the reliability of the AK. A hybrid platform that aims to bring together the best of both worlds—and succeeds remarkably well.

Since it is manufactured for the civilian market, examples found in the Zone are modified for fully automatic fire. An excellent choice for stalkers who value comfort, reliability, and substantial firepower.
4q0gl.description_zh:
其名称强调了它的混合设计，结合了AR-15的人体工程学与AK的可靠性。这个混合平台旨在融合两者的优点——并且非常成功地做到了。

由于它是为民用市场制造的，在区域中发现的型号都被改装为全自动射击。对于重视舒适性、可靠性和强大火力的潜行者来说，这是一个绝佳的选择。

zz7q9.description: Based on a gun that the Black Market obtained from the Murmur, this 9x39 mm assault rifle is a formidable weapon that excels in mid-range combat.
zz7q9.description_zh: 基于黑市从Murmur借来的武器，这款9x39突击步枪是一种强大的武器，在中距离战斗中表现出色。

zz2g9.description: A Russian general-purpose machine gun, based on the PKM. It was intended for attacking enemy personnel, gun batteries, transport, and airborne targets.
zz2g9.description_zh: 俄罗斯通用机枪，基于RMB。旨在攻击敌方人员、火炮阵地、运输工具和空中目标。

qj26k.description: The SSR (which stands for "Sniper Support Rifle") is an American sniper rifle and one example of the SCAR family of firearms. It was intended for use as a Designated Shooter Rifle, the tactical equivalent of the SVD Dragunov sniper rifle.
qj26k.description_zh: SSR（意为“狙击支援步枪”）是一款美国狙击步枪，也是SCAR枪族的一个代表。它旨在作为指定射手步枪使用，在战术上相当于SVD德拉贡诺夫狙击步枪。

wj7nd.description: The latest belt-fed LMG. This new addition to the machine gun family is designed with all the nuances of modern combat in mind. Still a rarity in the Zone...
wj7nd.description_zh: 最新式的弹链供弹轻机枪。机枪家族的这个新成员在设计时考虑了现代战斗的所有细节。在特异区里仍然很罕见...

0rq99.description: Weapon upgraded in the Arsenal Workshop

m02jr.description: An AR-15 variant developed at the request of special services and intended for silent, covert operations. Compared to its “big brother,” it features more compact dimensions, relatively low weight, and a specially designed suppressor. After the prototype was not adopted for service and was banned from sale on the civilian market, 5.56-caliber Honey Badger variants began making their way into the Zone. A delicate instrument for precision work, one that truly shines in the hands of a professional.
m02jr.description_zh: 应特勤部门要求开发的AR-15变体，用于无声、隐蔽行动。

6w6lp.description: A German anti-tank rifle from the early period of World War II.
6w6lp.description_zh: 一种二战早期的德国反坦克步枪。

4q1nj.description: A legendary combination of axe, knife, and machete. The Kukri is distinguished by the curved shape of its blade and the forward-weighted center of gravity.
4q1nj.description_zh: 斧、刀和砍刀的传奇组合。廓尔喀刀的显著特点是其刀刃的弯曲形状和前重的重心。

2od90.description: A submachine gun designed in Slovakia under the name Laugo and manufactured in the Czech Republic by Česká Zbrojovka Uherský Brod.
2od90.description_zh: 一款在斯洛伐克制造为Laugo并在捷克由Česká Zbrojovka Uherský Brod生产的冲锋枪。

7lng9.description: A Belgian pistol that gained widespread notoriety due to numerous bans on its sale and civilian ownership. The reason is its exceptional armor penetration for a handgun. It also boasts a high-capacity magazine, low weight thanks to its polymer frame, and mild recoil. The pistol is widely used by special operations units and SSPP military personnel, although some examples occasionally find their way into the hands of stalkers.
7lng9.description_zh: 一把比利时手枪，因多次被禁止销售和民间持有而臭名昭著。原因在于它作为手枪拥有非凡的穿甲能力。它还拥有大容量弹匣、得益于聚合物框架的轻量化以及柔和的后坐力。该手枪被特种作战单位和SSPP军事人员广泛使用，不过偶尔也有一些落入潜行者手中。

2on45.description:
The KS-23 is a Soviet pump-action shotgun and the largest-caliber production shotgun ever manufactured. It is a unique firearm because, under Soviet GOST standards, any weapon with a caliber exceeding 20 mm is officially classified as light artillery.

The most remarkable feature, however, is its barrel. To reduce manufacturing costs, rejected barrels intended for 23 mm aircraft cannons were repurposed, proving perfectly suitable for firing less powerful ammunition.

Within the Zone, the KS-23 is the ultimate big-game stopper, built to bring down targets that ordinary shotguns simply cannot.
2on45.description_zh:
KS-23是一款苏联泵动式霰弹枪，也是有史以来量产的最大口径霰弹枪。它是一款独特的武器，因为根据苏联GOST标准，任何口径超过20毫米的武器都被正式归类为轻炮。

然而，它最显著的特征在于枪管。为降低制造成本，原本用于23毫米飞机机炮的废弃枪管被重新利用，事实证明它们非常适合发射威力较低的弹药。

在区域内，KS-23是终极的大型猎物终结者，专门用来击倒普通霰弹枪无法应对的目标。

okvr4.description:
A South Korean assault rifle representing a major modernization of the earlier K2. Compared to its predecessor, it features a full-length Picatinny rail on the receiver and handguard, an adjustable stock, and improved ergonomics.

Korean Typhoon operatives value it for its excellent accuracy and reliability. And since weapons like this are always in demand within the CEZ, it wasnt long before they began appearing on the black market.
okvr4.description_zh:
一款韩国突击步枪，代表了早期K2的重大现代化改进。与前者相比，它在机匣和护木上配备了全长的皮卡汀尼导轨、可调节枪托和改进的人机工程学。

韩国Typhoon特工因其出色的精度和可靠性而对其青睐有加。由于这类武器在禁区内总是有需求，没过多久它们就开始出现在黑市上。

dmq75.description:
A new version of the Vityaz submachine gun. Named after Viktor Mikhailovich Kalashnikov, the son of the legendary Soviet firearms designer, this weapon represents the latest evolution of the platform. It features improved ergonomics, enhanced reliability, and Picatinny rails for mounting optics and accessories.

Its redesigned polymer handguard and folding telescopic stock provide greater shooting comfort, while its simple blowback operating system leaves virtually no room for malfunctions. What more could you ask of a compact submachine gun in the Zone?
dmq75.description_zh:
Vityaz冲锋枪的新版本。以传奇苏联枪械设计师之子维克托·米哈伊洛维奇·卡拉什尼科夫命名，这款武器代表了该平台的最新演进。它具备改进的人机工程学、增强的可靠性，以及用于安装光学瞄具和附件的皮卡汀尼导轨。

其重新设计的聚合物护木和折叠伸缩枪托提供了更佳的射击舒适度，而其简单的自由枪机式操作系统几乎没有故障空间。在区域中，你对一把紧凑型冲锋枪还能要求什么呢？

qjv99.description:
The KS-1 is a new AR-15-pattern rifle adopted by the Royal Marines and the British Rangers. While it still employs a direct impingement gas system, its reinforced internal components and self-regulating gas block ensure outstanding reliability under any conditions, while its high manufacturing quality delivers excellent accuracy.

Its only real drawback is the price, making it affordable only to the Zones elite fighters.
qjv99.description_zh:
KS-1是皇家海军陆战队和英国游骑兵采用的新型AR-15平台步枪。虽然它仍然采用直接导气式系统，但其强化内部部件和自调节导气箍确保了在任何条件下的出色可靠性，而其高制造质量则提供了卓越的精度。

它唯一的真正缺点是价格，使其只有区域中的精英战士才能负担得起。

j5op4.description:
A South Korean light machine gun adopted to replace the aging K3. Its key features include enhanced reliability, modern ergonomics, improved accuracy, and reduced barrel heat buildup.

It found its way into the Zone after Korea joined the SSPP and began taking an interest in the Exclusion Zone, immediately proving its worth. Any experienced stalker knows: the only thing better than an assault rifle is a machine gun.
j5op4.description_zh:
一款韩国轻机枪，用于取代老旧的K3。其主要特点包括增强的可靠性、现代人机工程学、改进的精度以及减少的枪管热量积聚。

在韩国加入SSPP并开始对隔离区产生兴趣后，它进入了区域，并立即证明了自己的价值。任何有经验的潜行者都知道：唯一比突击步枪更好的东西就是机枪。

lyv9k.description: Weapon upgraded in the Arsenal Workshop

wj6l2.description: Weapon upgraded in the Arsenal Workshop

wj75o.description: The FN SCAR (Special Operations Forces Combat Assault Rifle) is a weapons system developed by the American subdivision of Belgian company FN Herstal.
wj75o.description_zh: FN SCAR（来自短语“特种作战部队战斗突击步枪”）是一个武器系统，由比利时公司FN赫斯塔尔的美国分部开发。

vj2zd.description: A modification of the Belgian FN FAL rifle that was created by the American company DS Arms.
vj2zd.description_zh: 比利时FN FAL步枪的改型，由美国DS Arms公司创造。

p63d2.description: A 7.62 mm assault rifle based on the HK416.
p63d2.description_zh: 一款基于HK416设计的7.62毫米突击步枪。

3gnk5.description:
The Franchi SPAS-15 is an Italian combat shotgun developed in the mid-1980s as the successor to the famous SPAS-12.

Its primary improvement over its predecessor is the use of detachable box magazines instead of an under-barrel tubular magazine, dramatically reducing reload times. Its appearance resembles the M16 rifle, featuring a similar carrying handle and control layout.

An excellent weapon for fighting mutants or clearing buildings.
3gnk5.description_zh:
弗兰奇SPAS-15是一款意大利战斗霰弹枪，于20世纪80年代中期开发，作为著名的SPAS-12的后继型号。

与前者相比，它的主要改进是采用可拆卸盒式弹匣而非枪管下方的管状弹仓，大幅缩短了装填时间。其外观类似于M16步枪，配有类似的提把和操作布局。

这是一款用于对抗变异体或清理建筑的出色武器。

knmy3.description:
The DSA RPD is a modern reincarnation of the legendary Soviet Degtyaryov light machine gun, manufactured by the American company of the same name. Externally, it retains the unmistakable appearance of the original, with its distinctive bipod, protective front sight ears, and ammunition box, but incorporates modern upgrades such as a lightweight fluted barrel, an ergonomic polymer handguard, and an M4 telescoping stock.

A rare but highly sought-after weapon within the CEZ.
knmy3.description_zh:
DSA RPD是现代对传奇苏联捷格加廖夫轻机枪的再现，由同名的美国公司制造。外观上，它保留了原版 unmistakable 的外观，带有标志性的两脚架、准星护翼和弹药箱，但融入了现代化升级，如轻量化螺旋槽枪管、符合人体工学的聚合物护木以及M4伸缩枪托。

在禁区内是一种稀有但备受追捧的武器。

7ln2j.description:
The AEK-965 is a Russian pump-action shotgun chambered in 23×75 mm, developed as a more ergonomic alternative to the famous KS-23. The goal of the project was to create a more comfortable, higher-capacity shotgun while preserving the devastating stopping power of the 23 mm caliber.

Within the Zone, the AEK-965 is an exceptionally rare trophy. It offers excellent firepower, respectable magazine capacity, and ergonomics vastly superior to the heavy and unwieldy KS-23.
7ln2j.description_zh:
AEK-965是一款俄罗斯泵动式霰弹枪，使用23×75毫米口径弹药，是作为著名的KS-23更具人体工程学设计的替代方案而开发的。该项目的目标是打造一款更舒适、容量更大的霰弹枪，同时保留23毫米口径毁灭性的停止作用力。

在区域内，AEK-965是一件极其稀有的战利品。它提供了出色的火力、可观的弹匣容量，以及远远优于笨重KS-23的人体工程学设计。

vjryn.description: Modified version of a compact Russian rifle based on the silent AS Val. Equipped with a folding handle and a standard Val stock.
vjryn.description_zh: 紧凑型俄罗斯步枪的改装版本，基于消音的AS“巨浪”步枪开发。配备折叠握把和标准的“巨浪”枪托。

p635w.description:
The Mk 14 EBR is a modern reinterpretation of the M14 rifle, which once served as the transitional link between the M1 Garand and the M16.

Its updated handguard, modular design, and the excellent accuracy of the original make it an excellent choice for medium- to long-range engagements. Just dont forget to maintain it properly.
p635w.description_zh:
Mk 14 EBR是对M14步枪的现代重新诠释，M14曾作为M1加兰德与M16之间的过渡纽带。

其更新的护木、模块化设计以及原枪出色的精度，使其成为中远程交战的绝佳选择。只是别忘了妥善保养。

qj23j.description:
A Russian suppressed large-caliber sniper rifle built in a bullpup configuration. Designed to eliminate armored personnel, enemies behind cover, and lightly armored vehicles.

Equipped with an integrated flash suppressor and sound suppressor. Its appearance alone commands respect. Within the Zone, it excels at penetrating heavy armor and taking down exceptionally resilient mutants.
Additional properties
qj23j.description_zh:
一款俄罗斯无托结构大口径消音狙击步枪。设计用于消灭装甲人员、掩体后的敌人以及轻型装甲车辆。

配备一体式消焰器和消音器。仅凭其外观就令人敬畏。在区域内，它擅长穿透重甲并击倒异常坚韧的变异体。

wj7l2.description:
A British-made sniper rifle developed by Accuracy International, adopted by the British Army in the mid-1980s under the designation L96. Modified versions of the rifle are also used by police and special operations forces.
Additional properties
wj7l2.description_zh: 英国制造的狙击步枪，由Accuracy International公司开发。在1980年代中期，这款步枪被英国陆军以L96的名称采用。该步枪的改型也存在，供警察和特种部队使用。

ly2d1.description: The FAMAS is a French 5.56 mm caliber assault rifle with a bullpup configuration. It is equipped with a silencer and an underbarrel grenade launcher.
ly2d1.description_zh: FAMAS是一款法国5.56毫米口径的无托结构突击步枪。它配备了消音器和下挂式榴弹发射器。

n42y9.description: A dagger with a twisted blade that curves in on itself. Perfectly suited for combat in tight spaces, where standard knives cant be used.
n42y9.description_zh: 一把刀刃扭曲内弯的匕首。非常适合在标准刀无法使用的狭窄空间内战斗。

lyl3j.description: A Russian large-caliber assault rifle created to meet the needs of the Russian Federal Security Services special ops units.
lyl3j.description_zh: 一款俄罗斯大口径突击步枪，旨在满足俄罗斯联邦安全局特种部队的需求。

knv5y.description: Weapon upgraded in the Arsenal Workshop

knl30.description: A Belgian assault rifle developed by the FN Herstal company, intended for modern combat missions in regional military conflicts
knl30.description_zh: 一款比利时突击步枪，由FN赫斯塔尔公司开发。该武器旨在用于局部军事冲突中的现代战斗任务。

ok9z6.description: Weapon upgraded in the Arsenal Workshop

j5od6.description: The FAMAS is a French 5.56 mm caliber assault rifle with a bullpup configuration.
j5od6.description_zh: FAMAS是一款法国5.56毫米口径的无托结构突击步枪。

4qn6j.description: A Russian automatic pistol developed in the mid-1990s by a team of designers from the Central Design and Research Bureau of Sporting and Hunting Arms under the leadership of I. Ya. Stechkin to replace the Stechkin Automatic Pistol.
4qn6j.description_zh: 俄罗斯自动手枪，由中央运动狩猎武器设计研究局的设计团队在I. Ya. Stechkin的领导下于1990年代中期开发，旨在替换斯捷奇金自动手枪。

j5lm4.description: A unique take on the modern assault rifle from the oldest weapons manufacturer in the world. It combines Italian design, excellent modularity, and an integrated underbarrel grenade launcher, in case the primary caliber isnt enough. The short-stroke piston system, where the piston travels a distance of 50.8 mm, offers very smooth and comfortable recoil along with excellent reliability. The lucky ones who managed to acquire it in the CEZ can attest to this.
j5lm4.description_zh: 来自世界上最古老武器制造商的现代突击步枪的独特演绎。它结合了意大利设计、出色的模块化以及集成的下挂式榴弹发射器，以防主要口径不够用。短行程活塞系统，活塞移动距离为50.8毫米，提供了非常平稳舒适的后坐力和出色的可靠性。那些在特异区有幸获得它的人可以证明这一点。

dmqk5.description: A compact Russian assault rifle developed by the Kalashnikov Concern
dmqk5.description_zh: 一款紧凑型俄罗斯突击步枪，由卡拉什尼科夫公司开发。

96m4w.description: Ammunition for this Chinese assault rifle used to be hard to find, easy to lose, and even easier to forget. But rechambered for one of the most common ammunition types, it caused quite a stir in the Zone and has since become the choice of professionals.
96m4w.description_zh: 以前，这种中国突击步枪的弹药很难找到，容易丢失，甚至更容易遗忘。但在改装成使用最常见的弹药类型之一后，它在特异区引起了不小的轰动，并已成为专业人士的选择。

y37kw.description: A lightweight and ergonomic professional rifle, the PSA 20 is burst-fire only, which ensures high accuracy and low recoil.
y37kw.description_zh: 一款轻便舒适的专业用步枪。由于仅有点射模式，它具有精度高和后坐力低的特点。

vj497.description: A classic Cossack shashka. A long, heavy blade intended for offensive combat. Excellent for chopping off limbs!
vj497.description_zh: 经典的哥萨克骑兵刀。一种用于进攻战斗的长而重的刀刃。非常适合砍断肢体！

wj66z.description: A small cleaver equipped with a system for heating the blade. It looks stylish and can cook enemies wounds into a bloody crisp.
wj66z.description_zh: 配备刀刃加热系统的小型切肉刀。看起来时尚，可以将敌人的伤口烧灼成血痂。

p615w.description:
A Turkish AR-15-style shotgun popular among civilians and law enforcement alike thanks to its affordability and reliability.

Equipped with the proprietary BufferBolt system, which significantly reduces recoil. A rare but highly sought-after shotgun in the Zone, leaving enemies with little chance of survival at close range.

7lry3.description: A small integrally suppressed Russian assault rifle developed by the Kalshnikov Concern
7lry3.description_zh: 俄罗斯小型集成消音突击步枪，由卡拉什尼科夫公司开发。

7lnj7.description: Compact Tactical Carbine, a modification of the Belgian FN FAL rifle, created by the American company DS Arms.
7lnj7.description_zh: 紧凑战术卡宾枪，比利时FN FAL步枪的改型，由美国DS Arms公司创造。

4q17r.description: Weapon upgraded in the Arsenal Workshop

6wr5j.description:
The AK-15 is part of the modernized rifle family developed for the Russian Armed Forces. Designed as an AK-12 variant chambered in a larger caliber, it restores the stopping power of the AKM while incorporating improved ergonomics. 

Enhanced modularity, a free-floating barrel for improved accuracy, and the platforms trademark reliability. A perfect choice for stalkers who appreciate modernized classics and a little extra caliber.
6wr5j.description_zh:
AK-15是为俄罗斯武装力量开发的现代化步枪家族中的一员。作为AK-12的大口径版本设计，它恢复了AKM的停止作用力，同时融合了改进的人体工程学设计。

增强的模块化、用于提高精度的浮动枪管，以及该平台标志性的可靠性。对于欣赏现代化经典和稍大口径的潜行者来说，这是一个完美的选择。

p614d.description: A universal weapon and tool that is suitable both for combat and for survival. Made on orders from the Russian Navy to replace the obsolete divers knife.
p614d.description_zh: 适用于战斗和生存的通用武器和工具。根据俄罗斯海军的订单制造，以替换过时的潜水员刀。

y32wo.description: The XM8 is a range of firearms that was jointly developed by the American arms company ATK (Alliant Techsystems) and the German company Heckler & Koch. The XM8 was based on the HK G36, boasts solid performance, and was developed mainly as a replacement for the M16 and M4A1 assault rifles.
y32wo.description_zh: XM8是由美国武器公司ATK（Alliant Techsystems）和德国公司Heckler & Koch联合开发的一系列枪支。XM8基于HK G36，性能可靠，主要是作为M16和M4A1突击步枪的替代品而开发的。

vj2mp.description:
A version of the domestically designed Saiga-12 manufactured by the American branch of the Kalashnikov Concern.

The Kalashnikov rifle platform adapted into a magazine-fed shotgun proved so popular that it is now manufactured on both sides of the Atlantic. Since weapons are smuggled into the Zone from both directions, this model found its way here as well and remains in high demand.
vj2mp.description_zh:
由卡拉什尼科夫集团美国分公司生产的国产赛加-12霰弹枪版本。

卡拉什尼科夫步枪平台改装为弹匣供弹霰弹枪后大受欢迎，以至于现在大西洋两岸都在生产。由于武器从两个方向走私进入区域，该型号也由此进入此地，并且一直需求旺盛。

y37qz.description: A submachine gun developed by Transformational Defense Industries. It uses a semi-free slide system that directs the breech downward at a sharp angle under recoil.
y37qz.description_zh: 一款由Transformational Defense Industries公司开发的冲锋枪。它使用半自由枪机系统，该系统在后坐力作用下将枪机以较大角度向下引导。

dmjz2.description:
The Pancor Jackhammer, named after the jackhammer as a symbol of raw power and impact, first appeared as an experimental design in the 1980s but never entered mass production.

The world changed, however, and the demand for devastating close-range firepower brought it back. An outstanding weapon for clearing mutant nests, narrow corridors, and confined spaces unfortunate enough to contain enemy forces. Its detachable drum magazine provides excellent reload speed.
dmjz2.description_zh:
Pancor Jackhammer，以象征着原始力量和冲击力的风镐命名，最初作为实验设计出现于20世纪80年代，但从未投入大规模生产。

然而，世界发生了变化，对毁灭性近距离火力的需求使其重获新生。这是一款清理变异兽巢穴、狭窄走廊和不幸藏有敌军的密闭空间的出色武器。其可拆卸式弹鼓提供了极快的装填速度。

n4md3.description: XM8S is an optimized variant of the classic XM8. The built-in optical sight was replaced with a mechanical one with Picatinny rails for various attachments.
n4md3.description_zh: XM8S——经典XM8的优化变体。内置光学瞄具被替换为机械瞄具，并配有皮卡汀尼导轨以安装各种附件。

knmdv.description:
A sniper rifle that uses a system of electromagnets to accelerate bullets. This system is fed by energy from the Comet artifact. It is also known as "Object 62."
Additional properties
knmdv.description_zh: 一款狙击步枪，使用电磁铁系统加速子弹。该系统由“彗星”神器提供能量。也被称为“62号物体”。

4qn7r.description: A high-power beam rifle, one of the newest scientific developments that appeared in the Zone relatively recently. A real gift from scientists and gunsmiths to all researchers of the Zone!
4qn7r.description_zh: 高能光束步枪，最新科学进展之一，相对较新出现在特异区。科学家和枪匠送给所有特异区研究者的真正礼物！

3gnl1.description:
While its hard to say that the CR-380 has become a sought-after weapon in the Zone, the frenzy with which wealthy stalkers snapped them up was noticed by ZIVCAS.

The CR-72 was one of ZIVCASs first successful attempts to adapt the unique design solutions of the Gauss rifle into a compact format. According to the manufacturer, the weapon is still undergoing field testing, which may lead to various technical issues.
Additional properties
3gnl1.description_zh:
虽然很难说CR-380在区域已成为抢手武器，但富有的潜行者们疯狂抢购它们的狂热引起了ZIVCAS的注意。

CR-72是ZIVCAS将高斯步枪独特的设计方案适配到紧凑格式的首次成功尝试之一。据制造商称，该武器仍在进行现场测试，这可能导致各种技术问题。

3g6p5.description: A ski costume that doesnt restrict movement. It obviously handles the cold better than a regular jacket.
3g6p5.description_zh: 一件不限制行动的滑雪服。显然，它比普通夹克更能应对寒冷。

1rk7g.description:
Defected or irreparable Auroras often get a second life in the hands of the Zones artisans.

 Despite its worn appearance, Picklock is not the worst choice for an inexperienced stalker looking to save money on initial gear.
1rk7g.description_zh:
有缺陷或无法修复的奥罗拉经常在区域工匠手中获得第二次生命。

尽管外观磨损，但撬锁器对于想要在初始装备上省钱的无经验潜行者来说，并不是最差的选择。

4ql0r.description: A waterproof cloak with a sweater underneath which a cheap bulletproof vest is hidden. A good choice for the first steps in the Zone.
4ql0r.description_zh: 一件防水斗篷，里面隐藏着一件廉价防弹背心的毛衣。特异区第一步的良好选择。

0r429.description:
It is quite difficult to obtain a good Aurora jumpsuit from a stalker, which is why the bandits decided to look for alternatives.

 Their choice fell on Red Shield products, known for their collaboration with Mullers cartel, establishing the RS-32 suit as the outfit for not the wealthiest bandits who have just entered the Zone.
0r429.description_zh:
从一个潜行者那里获得一件好的奥罗拉连体服是相当困难的，这就是为什么强盗们决定寻找替代品。

他们的选择落在了红盾的产品上，红盾以与穆勒卡特尔合作为名，将RS-32套装确立为刚刚进入特异区、不太富裕的强盗们的装备。

3g6nl.description:
A cheap ghillie suit with a tactical vest, purchased by traders in the South.

 Heavy textiles and the ability to hide easily attract those who enjoy setting up ambushes.
3g6nl.description_zh:
一件便宜的吉利服配战术背心，由南方的商人购买。

厚重的纺织品和易于隐藏的能力吸引了那些喜欢设伏的人。

g4yw6.description: A leather jacket with sweatpants, extremely popular among the green bandits. Cheap and comfortable—exactly what a newcomer to the Zone needs.
g4yw6.description_zh: 一件皮夹克配运动裤，在绿皮强盗中极为流行。便宜又舒适——正是初入特异区的新手所需。

p6my4.description: Warms you up and puts you in a holiday mood. Under the sweater, it comes with good body armor.
p6my4.description_zh: 让你暖和起来，带给你节日的心情。毛衣下面是优质的防弹衣。

0r439.description:
A beat-up Hazmat Suit from an SSPP warehouse that made its way onto the Zone market.

Judging by the dates on its decommissioning markings, it should have been disposed of before the Night of Exodus.
0r439.description_zh: 从仓库退役的军用斗篷帐篷，经主人改造后可用作护甲。

dmgqj.description: A thick cloak with attached large Modular Tactical Vest. A cheap solution for hunting small mutants.
dmgqj.description_zh: 一件厚斗篷，附加大型模块化战术背心。猎杀小型变异生物的廉价解决方案。

zzy6y.description: A sturdy jacket with a convenient tactical belt is a basic set for hunters. Its popular among newbie bandits due to its low cost and wide availability.
zzy6y.description_zh: 一件结实的夹克配实用的战术腰带，是猎人的基本套装。由于其低成本和广泛的可用性，在新手强盗中很受欢迎。

m062y.description: A jacket with a comfortable and reliable body armor. Does not hinder movement.
m062y.description_zh: 一件带有舒适可靠防弹衣的夹克。不妨碍行动。

wjgm2.description:
The standard raincoat from the Mainland.

 According to scientists, the range of the hydrogen index of rain in the Zone can cover the entire spectrum of the scale, not to mention its dosimetric indicators. Nevertheless, experienced stalkers just dont listen to them, saying there are threats in the Zone more dangerous than a little rain.
wjgm2.description_zh:
来自大陆的标准雨衣。

根据科学家的说法，特异区内雨水的pH值范围可能覆盖整个标尺谱系，更不用说其剂量指标了。尽管如此，有经验的潜行者就是不听他们的，说特异区里有比小雨更危险的威胁。

y35ok.description: Ergonomic suit that doesnt restrict movement. It is ideal for hunting small mutants and moving through the Southern Zone, making it particularly popular among diggers.
y35ok.description_zh: 符合人体工程学的套装，不限制行动。它是狩猎小型变异生物和在南部区域移动的理想选择，因此在挖掘者中特别受欢迎。

qjo2j.description:
One of Research Institute 7s early and less successful projects—an attempt to create an industrial analog of the combined artisanal armored suit popular among stalkers.

 Once the institute began its collaboration with the stalkers from Horizon and established it as a full-fledged subsidiary atelier, the Aurora modernization project was finally abandoned, with work on the Artifact Hunter series beginning instead.
qjo2j.description_zh:
第7研究所早期且不太成功的开发之一，该研究所曾试图为潜行者中流行的组合式自制护甲创造工业类似物。

随着研究所开始与地平线的潜行者合作，并成立一个完整的附属工作室，奥罗拉现代化项目最终被放弃，但取而代之的是开始了“神器猎人”系列的工作。

4ql2r.description: A jacket with a comfortable and reliable body armor. Does not hinder movement.
4ql2r.description_zh: 一件带有舒适可靠防弹衣的夹克。不妨碍行动。

rwnrv.description:
A standard tourist suit, popular both on the Mainland among outdoor enthusiasts and among completely green stalkers in the Zone.

It doesnt offer any outstanding protection, but its still better than jeans and a T-shirt!
rwnrv.description_zh:
一件标准的旅游套装，在大陆的户外爱好者中和特异区里完全新手的潜行者中都很流行。

它没有出众的防护特性，但仍然比牛仔裤和T恤好！

6w0p0.description: A thick leather cloak, a fancy sweater, and an ushanka-hat are a real gentlemans kit.
6w0p0.description_zh: 一件厚皮斗篷、一件漂亮的毛衣和一顶乌沙帽-帽子是真正的绅士套装。

AwYf0Jgw.description: A sturdy jacket and comfortable trousers—an experienced hunter’s suit.
AwYf0Jgw.description_zh: 一件结实的夹克和舒适的裤子——经验丰富的猎人套装。

7lmpj.description: A warm vest, a knitted sweater, and a gas mask to avoid discomfort from the prickly winter wind.
7lmpj.description_zh: 一件保暖背心、一件针织毛衣和一个防毒面具，以避免刺骨的冬风带来的不适。

wjgo2.description:
The IP-4M closed-circuit breathing gas mask, which comes with a reinforced cloak, is popular among green stalkers.

 Although Reseacrh Institute 7 is a leading manufacturer of protective equipment against anomalies, many inhabitants of the Zone prefer artisanal products due to their affordability.
wjgo2.description_zh:
IP-4M闭路呼吸防毒面具，配有一件加固斗篷，在新手潜行者中很受欢迎。

尽管第7研究所是生产针对异象的防护装备的领先制造商，但许多特异区居民由于负担得起，更喜欢自制产品。

knqmy.description: Bandits prefer to look not only imposing but also different from stalkers. A stalkers repainted cloak, as the bandits rightly notes, isnt a stalkers cloak anymore.
knqmy.description_zh: 强盗们不仅希望看起来有气势，还希望与潜行者不同。潜行者重新涂色的斗篷，正如强盗们正确指出的那样，不再是潜行者的斗篷了。

96n2l.description: An ordinary jacket. The polyester is waterproof and withstands the effects of chemical reagents.
96n2l.description_zh: 一件普通的夹克。涤纶面料防水，并能抵抗化学试剂的影响。

1rk6g.description: A black jacket. Lightweight and comfortable, just what a newbie bandit needs.
1rk6g.description_zh: 一件皮夹克配运动裤，在绿皮强盗中极为流行。便宜又舒适——正是初入特异区的新手所需。

5lr71.description: A durable leather jacket. It is quite effective against the teeth of small mutants; however, it is not suitable for traveling to the North.
5lr71.description_zh: 一件耐用的皮夹克。它能相当有效地抵御小型变异生物的牙齿；但是，它不适合前往北方。

y35q0.description:
A presentable suit for stalkers who wish to flaunt their solid appearance.

 Unfortunately, the business-like appearance does not provide any additional protection against any threats of the Zone.
y35q0.description_zh:
一套适合希望炫耀其可靠外观的潜行者的体面套装。

不幸的是，这种商务外观并没有提供任何额外的防护来对抗区域的任何威胁。

96nrq.description: Stalkers also like to stand out, sometimes in unconventional ways. And a light bulletproof vest, hidden under a stylish shirt, doesnt restrict movement and provides extra protection!
96nrq.description_zh: 潜行者也喜欢以非传统的方式脱颖而出。一件轻便的防弹背心，隐藏在时尚的衬衫下，不限制行动，并提供额外的防护！

dmgw2.description: A simple ghillie suit, popular among various snipers and enthusiasts who like to ambush an unexpecting opponent from a hiding spot.
dmgw2.description_zh: 一件简单的吉利服，在各种狙击手和喜欢从藏身处伏击毫无戒备的对手的爱好者中很受欢迎。

m06my.description:
A cheap modification of the RS-32, made for bandits who like to ambush green stalkers in the most unexpected places.

 It might not have any significant advantage in performance over the stalker variant, but the price is more than reasonable!
m06my.description_zh:
RS-32的改装版，为那些喜欢在最意想不到的地方伏击新手潜行者的强盗制作。

当然，与潜行者版本相比，要想在性能上取得显著优势是不可能的，但价格相当合理！

rwn2v.description:
Aurora, modified by one of the Zones craftsmen. Despite being artisanal, it differs from its original only for the better!

 The optimization of tactical vest and additional insulating lining allowed the mechanic to achieve a good result, ensuring that the craftsman was provided with orders for a long time.
rwn2v.description_zh:
由特异区的一位工匠改装的奥罗拉。尽管是自制的，但它与其原版相比只有更好！

战术背心的优化和额外的绝缘衬里让机械师取得了良好的成果，确保这位工匠在很长一段时间内都有订单。

n4rm1.description:
Popular among green bandits the RS-32 suit, artisanal modified by one of the Black Market craftsmen.

 A good tactical vest and an improved insulation layer not only allow you to reach the stalker but also to carry all his loot to the stash.
n4rm1.description_zh:
在新手强盗中流行的RS-32套装，由黑市的一位工匠改装而成。

一件好的战术背心和改进的绝缘层不仅让你能追上潜行者，还能把他所有的战利品都带到藏匿处。

96npy.description:
Many stalkers and bandits cannot stand winter in the Zone due to brutal temperature changes and Blizzards that periodically sweep across the CEZ.

And although an ordinary down jacket is unlikely to solve the frostbite problem, the Arctic Explorer, padded with an extra layer of synthetic insulation, will at least keep you from freezing the moment you step outside the Bar.
96npy.description_zh:
许多潜行者和强盗无法忍受区域的冬天，因为其剧烈的温度变化和冬季期间周期性地覆盖CEZ的暴风雪。

虽然普通的羽绒服不太可能解决冻伤的问题，但用额外一层合成填充物隔热的北极探索者至少能防止在酒吧门外的最初时刻冻僵。

96ngz.description:
A hazmat suit with an inexpensive protective lining, worn with light body armor.

 A very popular combination due to its low cost and wide availability.
96ngz.description_zh:
一套带有廉价防护衬里的危险品防护服，与轻型防弹背心一起使用。

由于其低成本和普及，这是一种非常受欢迎的组合。

lyj2k.description: Variant of Aurora suit, equipped with an inexpensive closed breathing system, which has improved its anomaly protection performance. However, this enhancement came at the cost of reducing internal reinforced elements to decrease the overall weight of the equipment.
lyj2k.description_zh: 奥罗拉套装的变体，配备了廉价的闭路呼吸系统，提高了其异常防护性能。然而，这种增强是以减少内部加固元件为代价的，以减轻装备的整体重量。

7lmn6.description: A digger suit, assembled from all sorts of scrap. However, despite its components, it offers good protection against mutants. It is particularly effective against small creatures like rats, hounds, and mutts, which is how it got its name.
7lmn6.description_zh: 一件挖掘者套装，由各种废料组装而成。然而，尽管其组件如此，它提供了对变异生物的良好防护。它特别有效地对抗老鼠、猎犬和杂种犬等小型生物，因此得名。

7lmr6.description:
Artisanal suit with good mobility.

 Diggers, whose main threats are mutants and anomalies, have become skilled in creating gear that allows them to work more freely. The average protection against damage is compensated by basic anomalous resistances.
7lmr6.description_zh:
具有良好机动性的自制套装。

挖掘者的主要威胁是变异生物和异象，他们在制作能让他们更自由工作的装备方面变得熟练。平均的伤害防护通过基本的异常抗性得到补偿。

j5ko0.description:
Simple artisanal modification of the popular Aurora jumpsuit.

 Due to an integrated gas mask and additional insulating lining, this armor can withstand greater exposure to harsh environments, but it doesnt match the protection level of the full-fledged scientific suits from Research Institute 7.
j5ko0.description_zh:
流行奥罗拉连体服的简单自制改装版。

由于集成了防毒面具和额外的绝缘衬里，这种护甲可以承受更恶劣的环境暴露，但其防护水平无法与第7研究所完整的科学套装相匹敌。

6w06p.description:
A suit that entered the Zone through the Mercenaries and their equipment suppliers. Red Shield, considering additional markets beneficial, began supplying equipment not only to mercs but to anyone interested.

 A Scout suit, although not adapted to all Zones threats, performs well in combat with armed enemies, which is why it has gained popularity among not the wealthiest stalkers.
6w06p.description_zh:
通过雇佣兵及其装备供应商进入特异区的套装。红盾考虑到额外的市场有利可图，开始不仅向雇佣兵供应装备，也向任何感兴趣的人供应。

侦察兵套装虽然不能适应所有区域威胁，但在与武装敌人的战斗中表现良好，因此在不那么富裕的潜行者中获得了欢迎。

ok0m6.description:
An affordable RS-33 suit with custom modifications for adapting gear to the conditions of the Zone.

 Initially, Red Shield did not intend to collaborate with anyone in the Zone except their trusted clients, the Mercenaries. However, Leibniz convinced the other chiefs to expand the categories of equipment supplies for the Zone, meeting the demand of some CEZ inhabitants.
ok0m6.description_zh:
具有定制改装的廉价RS-33套装，用于使装备适应特异区条件。

最初，红盾除了其信任的客户雇佣兵外，不打算与特异区内的任何人合作。然而，莱布尼茨说服其他负责人扩大特异区装备供应的类别，以满足一些CEZ居民的需求。

zzyjk.description:
The second version of the suit from the CD series, produced in the Horizon atelier.

 Stalker costumes from this atelier are famous for their ergonomics. However, the armor of this series is distinguished not only by decent protection against the Zones anomalies but also by its resistance to more real threats, such as bullets and claws.
zzyjk.description_zh:
地平线工作室生产的CD系列的第二版套装。

来自这个工作室的潜行者服装以其人体工程学而闻名。然而，这个系列的护甲不仅以其对区域异常的体面防护而著称，还以其对更真实威胁（如子弹和爪子）的抵抗力而著称。

j5kv0.description:
Further development of the suit series created by Research Institute 7 in collaboration with its subsidiary atelier.

 Like its predecessor, it combines the convenience needed by any stalker with decent protective features for its price segment.

 As can be easily noticed, Nomad would be more appropriately called a modification rather than full-fledged armor, which is why the AH-1 quickly disappeared from the market, being replaced by the next suit in the series.
j5kv0.description_zh:
第7研究所与其附属工作室合作创建的套装系列的进一步发展。

与其前身一样，它结合了任何潜行者所需的便利性和其价格段内不错的防护特性。

很容易注意到，游牧者更应被称为改装版而不是完整的护甲，这就是为什么AH-1迅速从市场上消失，被该系列的下一个套装取代。

2oqnl.description:
The first suit from the Artifact Hunter series, which succeeds the Aurora.

Although the Drifter might not be considered an armor masterpiece by the Zones standards, at the time of its release, it significantly outperformed every competitor on the market in overall characteristics.

Stalkers attribute this to the institutes newfound collaboration with the stalkers who joined Research Institute 7s subsidiary—the Horizon atelier.
2oqnl.description_zh:
神器猎人系列的第一套套装，取代了奥罗拉。

尽管漂流者可能不被认为是特异区护甲领域的杰作，但在其发布时，它在整体性能上显著优于市场上所有竞争对手。

潜行者认为，这一结果是开始与加入研究所附属工作室地平线的潜行者合作的结果。

vj12r.description:
A Combat-5M, modified by the Black Market to have a more "bandit" look.

 Just like the original suit, it enters the Zone through smuggling networks, many of which are linked to the Baron.
vj12r.description_zh:
黑市改装过的战斗-5M，使其具有更“强盗”的外观。

作为原版套装，它通过走私计划进入特异区，其中许多与男爵有关。

g4y3n.description:
One of the suits from the Horizon atelier.

 With experience gained in the Zone, the ateliers consultants know perfectly well what any stalker needs at the beginning. The CD-1, combining the advantages of comfort and affordability, has become a quite popular suit for newly acquainted stalkers.
g4y3n.description_zh:
地平线工作室的套装之一。

凭借在区域获得的经验，工作室的顾问非常清楚任何潜行者初期需要什么。CD-1结合了舒适性和可负担性的优点，已成为刚接触潜行的新手们非常受欢迎的套装。

p6m3w.description:
Army-produced armored suit, modified for Zone conditions.

 Even though the anomalous protection of the suit is not enough to roam freely around the CEZ, it is more than sufficient for the ordinary soldiers serving at the Perimeter.
p6m3w.description_zh:
军队生产的护甲套装，为适应特异区条件而改装。

尽管套装的异常防护不足以在CEZ自由活动，但对于在边界服役的普通士兵来说绰绰有余。

1rk32.description:
A reliable suit assembled by diggers in consultations with stalkers from the Horizon atelier.

Designed to protect against the bitter cold of the winter Zone and Anomalous Blizzards.
1rk32.description_zh:
由挖掘者与地平线工作室的潜行者咨询后组装的可靠套装。

旨在防护异常暴风雪和冬季区域典型的极低温条件。

knqvy.description:
An artisanal suit assembled from various parts of both military and stalker gear.

 Despite its low cost, Falcon adequately meets most of the needs of a novice stalker by combining the qualities of both a scientific jumpsuit and combat armor.
knqvy.description_zh:
一件由军用和潜行者装备的各种部件组装而成的自制套装。

尽管成本低，但猎鹰充分满足了新手潜行者的大多数需求，结合了科学连体服和战斗护甲两者的特性。

lyjvk.description:
Further development of the Artifact Hunter series.

 This version was created using lightweight composite materials and some of the latest developments from Research Institute 7, allowing for progress in creating armor that combines decent protective characteristics against all threats in the Zone.

 Although Seeker achieved a certain level of success, the staff at the Horizon were not completely satisfied with the outcome, which led them to immediately start working on the next suit in the series.
lyjvk.description_zh:
神器猎人系列的进一步发展。

这个版本是使用轻型复合材料和第7研究所的一些最新开发成果创建的，允许在创造结合了对区域所有威胁的体面防护特性的护甲方面取得进展。

尽管探索者取得了一定程度的成功，但地平线的工作人员对结果并不完全满意，这导致他们立即开始研究该系列的下一个套装。

2oqdl.description: An improved version of Houndmaster—protection is distributed evenly across the body, preserving full mobility. The hockey mask has been replaced with a makeshift combination of a ballistic mask and respirator.
2oqdl.description_zh: 猎犬大师的改进版——防护均匀分布在全身，不降低机动性。冰球面具被替换为弹道面具和呼吸器的自制改装版。

0rnw1.description:
The Zircon, created in an attempt to address the shortcomings of the Garnet, failed to gain any significant popularity, just like its predecessor, much to the disappointment of its engineers and designers.

 Nevertheless, the work put into it eventually helped advance a series of specialized equipment and secure the funding needed to develop a new series—the Artifact Hunters.
0rnw1.description_zh:
锆石，在尝试解决石榴石问题的过程中创建，不幸的是并没有像其前身那样获得太多欢迎，令套装的工程师和设计师非常失望。

尽管如此，在套装上所做的工作后来允许开发一系列专业设备，并确保了创建新系列——“神器猎人”的资金。

0r4q9.description:
Like other suits in Research Institute 7s scientific series, the Iolite is designed specifically for protection against the particular threat of high radiation levels.

 Although radiation is one of the most common hazards in the Zone, many stalkers consider this suit a hard sell, as most gear in the Zone already offers adequate radiation resistance on its own, without sacrificing protection against more immediate threats.
0r4q9.description_zh:
与第7研究所科学系列的其他套装一样，堇青石专门设计用于防范特定威胁——高辐射水平。

尽管辐射是区域最常见的危险之一，但许多潜行者认为这套套装不是最需要的，因为区域的大多数装备在不牺牲对更切实威胁的防护的情况下，已经具有自己的防护特性。

g4y5p.description: CD-3a is a third-generation suit from the CD series that combines everything a newbie stalker needs. Increased anomalous protection combined with a decent level of armor and refined ergonomics makes this suit one of the best in its price range.
g4y5p.description_zh: CD-3a是CD系列的第三套套装，结合了新手潜行者所需的一切。增强的异常防护与体面的装甲水平和良好的人体工程学相结合，使这件套装成为其价格范围内最好的套装之一。

knq0p.description:
An old military suit without any frills.

 Decommissioned army equipment often finds its second life in the Zone. However, Lynx, like many other old armored suits, has a major drawback in the form of less than outstanding anomalous protection.
knq0p.description_zh:
一件没有多余装饰的旧军用套装。

退役的军用装备经常在区域获得第二次生命。然而，山猫与许多其他旧的护甲套装一样，有一个主要缺点，即其异常防护并不出色。

qjogj.description:
An alternative to the Falcon, created by Black Market masters.

 As stalkers joke, the suits name aptly describes not only the armor itself—a straight copy of the original—but also the Barons craftsmen and their habit of modifying stalker gear for the bandits.

 Despite all the jokes, Black Market mechanics know their craft, and the quality of the Mockingbird is unquestionable.
qjogj.description_zh:
猎鹰的替代品，由黑市的大师创造。

正如潜行者开玩笑说的那样，这套套装的名字不仅准确地描述了这套从原始套装复制而来的护甲本身，还描述了男爵工匠的活动，他们喜欢为强盗改装潜行者装备。

尽管有各种玩笑，但为黑市工作的机械师们精通他们的手艺，因此模仿鸟的质量是毋庸置疑的。

wjgq3.description:
A specialized suit based on relic technology found in an abandoned scientific complex in the Zone.

 The original suit provided reliable protection against psyonics. By reverse-engineering it, scientists from Research Institute 7 discovered which components were responsible for these properties. This discovery became an important step in the development of a series of research suits.
wjgq3.description_zh:
一种专业套装，基于在区域一个废弃的科学综合体中发现的遗物技术开发。

原始套装提供了可靠的防Psi辐射防护。第7研究所的科学家通过逆向工程，发现了哪些组件负责这些特性。这一发现成为开发一系列科学套装的重要一步。

2oq75.description:
Unusual suit crafted by a quirky artisan, who wanted to create both frightening and attractive image.

 The costume does not offer much protection, but its appearance more than makes up for it!
2oq75.description_zh:
由一位古怪的工匠制作的不寻常套装，他想创造出既吓人又有吸引力的形象。

这套服装提供的防护不多，但其外观足以弥补！

dmgjj.description: Artisanal rework of a standard military armored suit. The lining is infused with a special medicinal brew made from several rare plants of the Zone, which, according to rumors, was personally prepared by the Herbalist.
dmgjj.description_zh: 标准军用护甲套装的自制改造版。衬里注入了一种由特异区几种稀有植物制成的特殊药用制剂，据传言，这是草药师亲自准备的。

rwgl5.description:
One of Research Institute 7s "foil" series scientific suits, designed not only to protect against anomalous effects but also to sustain the wearers life.

 The Garnet may not have been the most successful suit, but the research institute gathered valuable feedback from the stalker community, outlining directions for future development.
rwgl5.description_zh:
第7研究所“锡纸”系列科学套装的解决方案之一，不仅旨在防护异常效应，还旨在维持穿着者的生命。

尽管石榴石不是最成功的套装，但研究所收到了一些来自潜行者社区的反馈，概述了进一步的发展方向。

m06vy.description:
One of Research Institute 7s research suits, nicknamed "foil" by stalkers.

 Increased protection against biological threats and chemical exposure is beneficial in the Zone, not only for researching various anomalies, but also when inspecting the abandoned chemical and industrial facilities that remain in the CEZ.
m06vy.description_zh:
第7研究所科学套装系列的代表之一，被潜行者昵称为“锡纸”。

增强的对生物威胁和化学暴露的防护不仅对研究各种异象有益，而且对检查CEZ中遗弃的化学和工业设施也有益。

rwnzv.description:
Scientific suit manufactured by Research Institute 7, designed for work in anomalous zones with high temperatures.

 One of the early prototypes of equipment from the research institute, intended to protect against specific anomalous threats. Despite being tailored for particular tasks, many stalkers consider such suits a decent solution, at least for the early period.
rwnzv.description_zh:
第7研究所制造的科学套装，设计用于在高温异常区域工作。

该研究所早期用于防范特定异常威胁的设备原型之一。尽管为特定任务量身定制，但许多潜行者认为这种套装是一个不错的解决方案，至少对于早期阶段来说是这样。

96n9l.description:
Similar to Scout, this armored suit was initially used only by low-income mercenaries who had just entered the Zone.

 Due to the mercs connections with bandits, the suit first gained recognition among them, and subsequently began to be purchased by stalker equipment traders.

 RS products, initially not intended for the conditions of the Zone, have issues with protection against anomalous threats. However, the protection against injuries that can be sustained in combat with an enemy meets quality standards for its price segment.
96n9l.description_zh:
与侦察兵类似，这种护甲套装最初只被刚进入区域、收入不高的雇佣兵使用。

由于雇佣兵与强盗的联系，该套装首先在他们中获得了认可，随后开始被潜行者装备商人购买。

红盾的产品最初并非为区域条件设计，在应对异常威胁方面存在问题。然而，在与敌人战斗中可能受到的伤害防护方面，其价格段的质量标准达到了。

vj1kp.description: Old cloak adorned with bones and mutant teeth, crafted into a complete outfit by an unknown quirky artisan. A battered hat, completing the look, is fastened to the cape to ensure it doesnt fall off, even in the most unusual positions.
vj1kp.description_zh: 一件装饰着骨头和变异生物牙齿的旧斗篷，被一位不知名的古怪工匠制作成一套完整的服装。一顶破旧的帽子，完成了整个造型，被固定在斗篷上，以确保即使在最不寻常的姿势下也不会掉落。

wjg72.description:
One of the early MIS series models that never made it to mass production, yet somehow turned up in the Zone contrabandist warehouses.

 According to Research Institute 7 operatives, Ambers protective characteristics against both anomalies and physical threats are frankly underwhelming. Even so, its low cost makes it a decent enough suit for a stalker looking to take their first steps in arthunting.
wjg72.description_zh:
MIS系列早期型号之一，从未投入量产，却不知何故出现在了禁区的走私仓库里。

据第七研究所特工称，“琥珀”对异常环境和物理威胁的防护性能都相当平庸。即便如此，低廉的价格使其成为初涉神器猎取的新手潜行者尚可一用的套装。

wjg2o.description:
Military gear with additional armoring, designed to provide good protection from bullet wounds.

However, like many other old armored suits, Altyn-T has poor protection against anomalous exposure.
wjg2o.description_zh:
带有额外装甲的军用装备，旨在提供对枪伤的良好防护。

然而，与许多其他旧的护甲套装一样，金钟罩-T对异常影响的防护很差。

zzy1n.description:
Old set of army equipment brought into the Zone from the Mainland.

 Despite not having the most outstanding protection against anomalies, the time-tested Altyn performs well in skirmishes with armed opponents.
zzy1n.description_zh:
从大陆带入区域的旧式军用装备套装。

尽管对异常的防护并非最出色，但经受过时间考验的金钟罩在与武装敌人的冲突中表现良好。

zzy2y.description:
Although some bandits consider it "shameful" to hunt artifacts themselves instead of "jumping rookies," most still copy stalkers by adopting their arthunting practices.

 Baron smelled profit and moved fast, providing the bandits with their own suit by making minor modifications to the Uranus units purchased from Research Institute 7.
zzy2y.description_zh:
尽管一些强盗认为“抢劫傻瓜”而不是自己寻找神器是“可耻的”，但他们中的大多数人仍然跟随潜行者，采用他们的神器狩猎做法。

男爵嗅到了潜在的利润，迅速采取行动，为强盗们提供了他们自己的套装，对从第7研究所购买的天王星进行了微小的修改。

g4yq5.description:
An artisanal creation by a mechanic from the South, who decided to use leftover parts for his armor.

 The unusual appearance quickly attracted the attention of curious stalkers, making the new exoarmor known throughout the Zone in just a few days.
g4yq5.description_zh:
一位南方机械师的手工杰作，他决定用剩余的零件来打造自己的装甲。

其不同寻常的外观迅速吸引了好奇潜行者的注意，使得这套新型外骨骼装甲在短短几天内便传遍了整个区域。

y352k.description:
The Black Market aims to cater to buyers by satisfying the bandits desire to stand out from stalkers.

 The armys Voshod armored suit, which enters the Zone through various gray smuggling schemes, requires only minor modifications and a can of black paint to transform into the notorious bandit Thug.
y352k.description_zh:
黑市旨在满足买家，满足强盗们想要区别于潜行者的愿望。

通过各种灰色走私计划进入区域的军队日出护甲套装，只需要微小的修改和一罐黑漆，就可以变成臭名昭著的强盗暴徒。

1rkn1.description:
A battered Uranus that found its second life in the hands of an experienced artisan.

 A custom modification of a cheap servomotor system fitted to a research suit not only "tightened up" the characteristics of the well-used suit, but also significantly improved its load capacity.

 Rumor has it among green stalkers that suits that survive this much tend to bring good luck!
1rkn1.description_zh:
一件破旧的天王星，在一位经验丰富的工匠手中获得了第二次生命。

将廉价的伺服电机系统改装成科学套装的原创改造不仅“提升”了这件使用良好的套装的特性，还显著提高了其负载能力。

在新手潜行者中，有传言说，这样的套装经历了多次冲突，会带来好运！

2oqll.description:
Ideological successor of the Osh suit, aiming to provide greater protection from the fangs and claws of mutants.

 Additional limb protection allows you to not worry about bites from small mutants.
2oqll.description_zh:
奥什套装的思想继承者，旨在提供对变异生物爪牙的更大防护。

额外的四肢防护让你不必担心小型变异生物的咬伤。

4qldn.description:
The early version of Uranus, released by Research Institute 7 shortly before work began on the AH series.

 Although the anomalous protection metrics of Tonga do not reach the best in its class, the suit more than compensates for its shortcomings with high-quality servomotors and a reliable life support system, which were the focus during the development of the suit.
4qldn.description_zh:
天王星的早期版本，由第7研究所在开始AH系列工作前不久发布。

尽管汤加的异常防护指标没有达到其级别中的最佳水平，但该套装以其高质量的伺服电机和可靠的生命支持系统（这些是套装开发过程中的重点）来弥补其缺点。

6w0zp.description: Decommissioned Samsons that end up on the Black Market often are either picked up by a stalker or given a cosmetic makeover, becoming exoarmor for "decent guys."
6w0zp.description_zh: 最终出现在黑市的退役参孙，经常要么在潜行者中找到买家，要么经过外观改装，成为“体面家伙”的外骨骼装甲。

5lr20.description:
A combat version of the third suit in the CD series, created by stalkers from Horizon.

 Despite being classified as a combat suit, its anomalous protection indicators are almost on par with the CD-3a version. This was made possible by Horizons collaboration with Research Institute 7.
5lr20.description_zh:
地平线潜行者创建的CD系列第三套套装的战斗版本。

尽管该护甲套装被标记为战斗型，但其异常防护指标几乎与CD-3a版本相当。这之所以成为可能，是因为地平线开始与第7研究所合作。

zzy9m.description:
Exoarmor, created by diggers in collaboration with stalkers from Horizon, is intended for extremely low temperatures commonly encountered in the winter Zone.

 An additional fur lining and electric heating elements allow you not only to venture beyond the safety of the camp but also to return without frostbitten limbs!
zzy9m.description_zh:
由挖掘者与地平线潜行者合作创建的外骨骼装甲，适用于冬季区域常见的极低温度。

额外的毛皮衬里和电加热元件不仅让你能冒险走出营地安全区，还能在四肢未冻伤的情况下返回！

5lr4q.description:
Yorsh with its unusual appearance and excellent characteristics quickly attracted attention of stalkers to its creator. But soon the craftsmen disappeared. When he showed up again, it became clear that Baron had made him an offer he couldnt refuse.

 It later emerged that the suits creator was just one of many craftsmen whom the Black Market had decided to take under control.
5lr4q.description_zh:
尤尔什以其不寻常的外观和出色的特性迅速吸引了潜行者对其创作者的注意。但很快这位工匠就消失了。当他再次出现时，很明显男爵向他提出了一个他无法拒绝的条件。

后来发现，这些套装的创作者只是黑市决定控制的众多工匠之一。

0r4gy.description:
A suit created as a byproduct of the Horizon stalkers work on the Blizzard Walker project.

 While another suit, inspired by work with diggers, was biased towards defensive characteristics for combat, Expedition was developed with an emphasis on comfort and the aim to provide general protective features.

 Unfortunately, maintaining reasonable mobility required sacrificing additional protection against bullet wounds. Despite this, Expedition gained popularity among some stalkers.
0r4gy.description_zh:
一件作为地平线潜行者在暴风雪行者项目工作副产品的套装。

虽然另一件受到与挖掘者合作启发的套装偏向于战斗的防御特性，但远征是为了强调舒适性和提供一般防护特性而开发的。

不幸的是，保持合理的机动性需要牺牲对枪伤的额外防护。尽管如此，远征在一些潜行者中获得了欢迎。

wjg62.description:
An expensive tactical gear set designed for combat in specific conditions.

 While this suit is an ideological successor to Hoplite, significant work on external threat protection means Legionnaire can be used without worry in lightly contaminated environments.
wjg62.description_zh:
一套昂贵的战术装备，设计用于特定条件下的战斗。

尽管这套战斗套装是重装步兵的思想继承者，但对潜在外部威胁防护的大量工作允许军团士兵使用，而无需过度担心轻微的污染。

y359o.description:
Artisanal armored suit created based on military Voshod.

 While a significant part of stalkers prefer to use industrially produced gear, some inhabitants of the Zone favor the creations of local craftsmen who know exactly what a stalker needs.
y359o.description_zh:
基于军用日出改造的自制护甲套装。

虽然很大一部分潜行者更喜欢使用工业生产的装备，但区域的一些居民青睐当地工匠的作品，他们确切地知道潜行者需要什么。

3g6rl.description:
The main distinguishing feature of Hoplite compared to the cheaper Red Shield suits is the reinforced gas mask, which proves to be extremely useful in the Zone.

 Despite providing decent protection, the armored suit was not designed for the Zone, which affects its anomalous effects protection.
3g6rl.description_zh:
与更便宜的红盾套装相比，重装步兵的主要区别在于加固的防毒面具，这在特异区内被证明极为有用。

尽管提供了不错的防护，但该护甲套装并非为特异区设计，这影响了其对异常效应的防护。

5lrn1.description:
Military gear set, designed for SSPP.

 Good armor greatly improves your odds of surviving a bullet from a brazen bandit or a cornered stalker.
5lrn1.description_zh:
为SSPP设计的军用装备套装。

好的护甲显著增加了从狂妄的强盗或走投无路的潜行者枪下幸存的机会。

dmgvj.description:
Protective suit, invented by one of the diggers based on their own experience as a dog handler.

 Good protection for both the torso and limbs makes the Osh a good armor for encounters with mutants.
dmgvj.description_zh:
一件防护服，由一位挖掘者根据自己作为训犬师的经验发明。

对躯干和四肢的良好防护使奥什成为遭遇变异生物时的良好护甲。

knqly.description:
Protective gear set designed for reporters working in the Zone.

 Although unreliable stories and rumors are the main sources of information in the CEZ, journalists occasionally appear even here.
knqly.description_zh:
为在特异区工作的记者设计的防护装备套装。

尽管不可靠的故事和谣言是CEZ的主要信息来源，但记者偶尔也会出现在这里。

5lrg1.description: The bandit version of the Scythian-2m. Comes in a stylish shade of black.
5lrg1.description_zh: Scythian（Scythian（斯基泰））-2m的强盗版本。采用时尚的黑色色调。

p6m1w.description:
Raider, created shortly after the appearance of AH-3 on the market, vividly showcases the talent of both the engineers from Research Institute and the staff of Horizon.

 Additional protection against both anomalous threats and more tangible threats allows AH-4 to be called one of the best suits at its level.
p6m1w.description_zh:
掠夺者，在AH-3出现在市场上后不久创建，生动地展示了第7研究所工程师和地平线工作人员的才能。

对异常威胁和更切实威胁的额外防护使AH-4能够被称为其级别中最好的套装之一。

4qlnr.description:
Modification of MIS-99 Amber suit.

 Despite the fact that the predecessor of the Malachite did not go into mass production, the engineers of Research Institute 7 decided to refine the suit. The result of these efforts was a decent suit that performs well in the southern parts of the Zone.
4qlnr.description_zh:
MIS-99琥珀套装的改装版。

尽管孔雀石的前身没有投入批量生产，但第7研究所的工程师决定改进这套套装。这些努力的结果是一件不错的套装，在区域南部表现良好。

g4ym6.description:
Collaboration between stalkers from Horizon and engineers, who began work on a series of scientific suits with additional armor protection, has yielded results embodied in Uranus.

 When creating Tonga, the craftsmen of the stalker association made progress in developing a suit with an effective life support system. However, when it came to Uranus, the institutes engineers insisted on their priorities, emphasizing enhanced protection against anomalous threats.
g4ym6.description_zh:
地平线的潜行者与工程师合作，开始研究带有额外装甲防护的科学套装系列，其结果体现在天王星上。

在创造汤加时，潜行者协会的工匠们在开发具有有效生命支持系统的套装方面取得了进展。然而，当天王星出现时，研究所的工程师坚持他们的优先事项，强调增强对异常威胁的防护。

ok096.description:
One of the latest works in the "foil" series, created in an attempt to provide the wearer with the maximum possible protection against anomalous effects.

 Like other MISs, the Amethyst is hardly a good armor for combat encounters, but its anomalous protection ratings combined with an affordable build make it a comfortable choice for exploring any archianomaly!
ok096.description_zh:
“锡纸”系列的最新作品之一，旨在尝试为穿着者提供最大可能的异常效应防护。

与其他MIS一样，紫水晶几乎不是战斗遭遇的好护甲，但套装的异常防护等级以及其低成本组装允许舒适地探索任何古异象！

vj14r.description:
Despite the success of AH-4, Research Institute 7 aimed to create a full-fledged counterpart to ZIVCAS developments, which led to the continuation of work on the Artifact Hunters series.

 The optimization of the exoskeleton made by Horizon not only enhanced protection against external impacts but also increased the load capacity of the suit.

 Unfortunately for the engineers, the initial tests revealed that such a configuration placed too much strain on the servomotors, reducing mobility. Nevertheless, the institutes management decided to put a trial batch on the market to gauge consumer reaction to this engineering solution.
vj14r.description_zh:
尽管AH-4取得了成功，但第7研究所旨在创建与ZIVCAS开发成果完全对应的产品，这导致了对神器猎人系列工作的继续。

地平线对外骨骼的优化不仅增强了对外部冲击的防护，还增加了套装的负载能力。

不幸的是，对于工程师来说，初步测试显示这种配置对伺服电机造成了太大的压力，降低了机动性。尽管如此，研究所管理层决定将一批试验品投入市场，以评估消费者对此工程解决方案的反应。

zzyly.description:
The set of army protective gear, specifically designed for the conditions of the Zone, was commissioned by SSPP.

 Although Scythians are intended exclusively for internal use by the Special Security Perimeter Protection, many worn equipment sets end up in the hands of stalkers through various smuggling schemes and are slightly refined by local mechanics to avoid excessive complaints about their used condition.
zzyly.description_zh:
专门为区域条件设计的军用防护装备套装，由SSPP委托制造。

尽管Scythian（Scythian（斯基泰））人仅供特种安全边界保护内部使用，但许多磨损的装备套装通过各种走私计划最终落入潜行者手中，并由当地机械师稍加改进，以避免对其使用状况的过度抱怨。

1rkz2.description:
A shipment of protective gear sets intended for a group of foreign mercenaries was intercepted and modified by unknown individuals. A week later, the entire shipment appeared on the market and gained popularity among stalkers.

According to a couple of mechanics, some of the engineering solutions resemble the work of Black Market craftsmen.

Instead of responding, Baron chose to remain silent, and soon it was revealed that the Black Market was indeed not related to the first Brigand. However, a year later, Baron announced the appearance of identical equipment sets.
1rkz2.description_zh:
一批为一队外国雇佣兵准备的防护装备被不明身份的人拦截并改装。一周后，整批货物出现在市场上，并在潜行者中流行起来。

根据一些机械师的说法，部分工程解决方案类似于黑市工匠的作品。

男爵没有回应，而是选择保持沉默，不久之后发现黑市确实与第一个强盗无关。然而，一年后，男爵宣布出现相同的装备套装。

g4y25.description: Modified version of Quartz. It has not only an additional layer of fabric insulation but it also features add-on armored elements that do not dissipate heat but enhance the suit wearers protection.
g4y25.description_zh: 石英的改装版。它不仅有一层额外的织物隔热层，还具有附加的装甲元件，这些元件不散热但增强了套装穿着者的防护。

qjomk.description:
An armored suit made by the Horizon atelier, developed from their work with diggers on winter gear..

 Although the Blizzard Walker isnt intended to provide additional Frost Protection, its design was clearly inspired by the snowy Zone.
qjomk.description_zh:
由地平线工作室与挖掘者在开发冬季装备期间合作制作的护甲套装。

尽管暴风雪行者并非旨在提供额外的寒冷防护，但其设计显然受到区域冰雪区域的启发。

qjoz3.description:
Exoskeleton combined with Lynx armored suit.

 Observant stalkers notice that the servomotors design does not resemble any of the common models, which, along with the archaic design, raises many questions among the inhabitants of the Zone regarding the time of creation of Bear.
qjoz3.description_zh:
与山猫护甲套装组合的外骨骼。

观察敏锐的潜行者注意到，伺服电机的设计不像任何常见型号，这一点以及其古老的设计，在区域居民中引发了许多关于熊的创建时间的疑问。

knqkv.description:
One of the ZIVCAS developments included in the Albatross series.

 The standard servomotor for suits in this series has received an additional modification aimed at enhancing the exoskeletons lightness and mobility. As a result, Albatross Scout rightfully takes its place as one of the best light exoskeleton armored suits on the open market!
knqkv.description_zh:
ZIVCAS的开发之一，包含在信天翁系列中。

该系列套装的标准伺服电机进行了额外的改装，旨在增强外骨骼的轻便性和机动性。因此，信天翁侦察兵理所当然地成为公开市场上最好的轻型外骨骼装甲套装之一！

j5krg.description:
A personal modification of the Fog Hunter, made by a skilled mechanic.

 It was never intended to go public, but once stalkers started showing interest, the craftsman decided to sell replicas of his suit for a good price.
j5krg.description_zh:
雾都猎人的个人改装版，由熟练的机械师制作。

起初它并不是一件打算公开的套装。然而，由于潜行者的需求，这位工匠决定以可观的金额出售他的套装的复制品。

7lm56.description:
One of the first examples of military exoskeleton armor, created for reconnaissance operations within the Zone.

 The high cost of the initial batches of Samson, as well as the reduction in raids deep into the CEZ after the scandal of the Night of Exodus, played a role in making the suit not the most common among military equipment.
7lm56.description_zh:
军用外骨骼装甲的最早范例之一，为区域内的侦察行动创建。

参孙初始批次的高成本，以及出埃及之夜丑闻后深入CEZ的袭击减少，导致该套装在军用装备中并不常见。

p6mg4.description:
Like the other diggers armor, Ratcatcher was created from various scraps given a second wind by black diggers.

 The repaired and modified exoskeleton not only possesses decent mobility but also enables its owner to carry away any goods found in the Zone.
p6mg4.description_zh:
像其他挖掘者的护甲一样，捕鼠者是由被赋予第二次生命的各种废料制成的。

修复和改装过的外骨骼不仅具有体面的机动性，还能让主人带走区域中发现的任何货物。

4qlwo.description:
A set of military gear, assembled for the escort group assigned by SSPP to the employees of Research Institute 7, who were conducting studies on the anomalous fog at the Sovkhoz.

 They say that some stalkers managed to acquire similar armored suits by assisting the institutes employees in their work. However, most of these likely ended up in their hands through trivial smuggling.
4qlwo.description_zh:
一套为SSPP分配给第7研究所员工的护送小组组装的军用装备，这些员工正在国营农场研究异常迷雾。

他们说，一些潜行者通过协助研究所员工的工作设法获得了类似的护甲套装。然而，其中大多数很可能是通过简单的走私落入他们手中的。

y35l3.description:
Artisanal modification of AH-4, crafted by the craftsmen of the Black Market.

 The reinforced anomalous protection suit can be considered one of the experiments by the Zones masters, created by some inexplicable intuition.

 No one can say for sure why the Barons mechanics decided to focus so much on protection against electricity. However, due to a makeshift protective system working on the principle of a Faraday cage, it provides an extremely high level of protection against electric discharges. Nonetheless, this kind of protection required sacrificing the suits mobility, which is why Spanner did not gain much popularity.
y35l3.description_zh:
AH-4的自制改装版，由黑市工匠制作。

加固的异常防护套装可以被认为是区域大师们的实验之一，由某种难以言喻的直觉创造。

没有人能确切地说出为什么男爵的机械师如此专注于对电的防护。然而，由于一个基于法拉第笼原理的临时防护系统，它提供了极高的防电击保护水平。尽管如此，这种防护需要牺牲套装的机动性，这就是为什么扳手没有获得太多欢迎。

y35jk.description:
Version of the Scythian developed using data obtained from the SSPP military bases.

 Despite the minor visual differences of Scythian-4 from previous versions of the suit, the protective characteristics of the equipment stand out favorably compared to its predecessors.

 Even though military participated in the creation of the armored suit, some of them continued to complain about Scythian not meeting the standards of advanced stalker gear, which hindered the Headquarters operations.
y35jk.description_zh:
使用从SSPP军事基地获得的数据开发的Scythian（Scythian（斯基泰））版本。

尽管Scythian（Scythian（斯基泰））-4与套装先前版本相比，视觉差异不大，但装备的防护特性与其前辈相比脱颖而出。

尽管军方参与了该护甲套装的创建，但他们中的一些人仍然抱怨Scythian（Scythian（斯基泰））不符合先进潜行者装备的标准，这阻碍了总部的行动。

zzjgn.description:
The designed ZIVCAS exoarmor from the Albatross series was created as a compromise for stalkers with a relatively modest budget who wish to afford equipment from the renowned corporation.

 Despite the fact that most ZIVCAS suits previously had their own narrow specialization, this model aims to retain the advantages of all earlier developments. Because of this, Albatross Infiltrator can be considered an excellent solution for an experienced stalker.
zzjgn.description_zh:
设计的ZIVCAS外骨骼装甲来自信天翁系列，是为那些希望购买来自知名公司设备且预算相对有限的潜行者创造的折衷方案。

尽管大多数ZIVCAS套装之前都有其特定的专业方向，但该型号旨在保留所有早期开发的优点。因此，信天翁渗透者可以被视为经验丰富的潜行者的绝佳解决方案。

rwgmg.description:
This exoarmor is an excellent purchase for a sniper working in the Zone.

 High mobility is combined with the ability to lie for hours in a radioactive swamp, waiting for the enemy. Masters of ambush from Rise approve!
rwgmg.description_zh:
这件外骨骼装甲是区域狙击手工作的绝佳购买品。

高机动性与在放射性沼泽中埋伏数小时等待敌人的能力相结合。自由的大师们赞同！

m06k2.description:
The advanced army armored suit for conducting assault operations within the Zone, specifically developed at the request of Headquarters in collaboration with Research Institute 7.

 Thanks to its protection against both anomalous and combat threats, Scythian-5 quickly gained popularity among many military stalkers, who were the first to showcase the armored suit within the CEZ. However, regular stalkers soon had the opportunity to try this latest military development, which quickly entered the Zones market through contrabandists grey channels.
m06k2.description_zh:
专为禁区突击作战研发的先进军用装甲套装，由总部委托第七研究所联合打造。

凭借对异常环境与战斗威胁的双重防护能力，Scythian（Scythian（斯基泰））-5型迅速在众多军方潜行者中赢得青睐，他们是最早在隔离区展示该套装的人群。然而，普通潜行者很快也有机会体验这款军用新锐装备——它通过走私者的灰色渠道迅速流入禁区市场。

g4310.description: Full-scale production of this super-heavy armored suit has not begun yet. It is merely a prototype. That hasnt stopped Rise from getting their hands on a few samples of the Chieftain. Seeing their enemies re-arming themselves, the anarchists decided not to fall behind. Only the very best Rise soldiers get a chance to try this armored suit in action.
g4310.description_zh: 这种超重型护甲套装的全面生产尚未开始。它只是一个原型。这并没有阻止自由弄到几件酋长的样品。看到他们的敌人重新武装自己，无政府主义者决定不落后。只有最优秀的自由士兵才有机会在实战中试用这件护甲套装。

y3q3o.description: The combat wing took a long time to convince Chatskiy to allocate resources for an armored suit specifically designed for combat. The result of those efforts, the Prometheus, is considered by many Rise members to be the finest work from their factions engineering corps.
y3q3o.description_zh: 战斗部门花了很长时间才说服恰茨基分配资源来专门为战斗设计一套护甲。普罗米修斯，这些请求的结果，被许多崛起成员认为是他们科学部门工程师最好的作品。

y3q1o.description:
Heavy sapper armor, developed by an outside contractor on SSPPs commission shortly after the Night of Exodus.

 The military quickly realized the suit had no place in the Zone. Although it seemed to offer excellent protection, it proved rather ineffective on the anomalous side of the Perimeter.

 The Tank never saw widespread use, but it did leave a mark in the form of a sizable stockpile of sapper equipment sitting in SSPP warehouses. And "abandoned equipment" has always made for excellent trading material between cunning warrant officers and resourceful contrabandists.
y3q1o.description_zh:
重型工兵护甲，由SSPP在出埃及之夜后不久委托外部公司开发。

军方很快意识到该套装不适合区域。虽然它似乎提供了出色的防护，但其在异常的边界一侧的有效性却相当低。

坦克的使用并未普及，但确实在SSPP仓库中留下了大量的工兵装备。而“遗弃装备”一直是精明的准尉和资源丰富的走私者之间交易的绝佳物品。

g43k0.description:
Possessing good load capacity and mobility, Mule was specifically designed for various reconnaissance operations by the SSPP in the Zone.

 Thanks to decent protection against anomalous threats in its category, it gained popularity among both military stalkers and regular stalkers.

 Some green stalkers, who come to the Zone for money, strive to join the military stalkers to receive a government-issued Mule from the SSPP. However, such smart guys quickly face the high requirements for recruits.
g43k0.description_zh:
具有良好的负载能力和机动性，骡子专为SSPP在区域内的各种侦察行动而设计。

由于其类别内对异常威胁的体面防护，它在军用潜行者和普通潜行者中都获得了欢迎。

一些为了钱来到区域的新手潜行者，渴望加入军用潜行者，以便从SSPP获得政府发放的骡子。然而，这样的聪明人很快面临对新兵的高要求。

0rn7d.description: A set of army gear adapted to Frontiers requirements. The Vanguard Armored Suit provides exceptional protection from mutants claws and teeth, and good bullet resistance makes it a reliable aid in the war for influence in the Zone.
0rn7d.description_zh: 一套适应纪律需求的军用装备。先锋护甲套装提供对变异生物爪牙的卓越防护，良好的防弹能力使其在区域影响力战争中成为可靠的助手。

qj1lk.description:
Combat armor by Horizon.

 When creating the new armored suit, former stalkers from the atelier design department focused on the military series Scythian, aiming to preserve both its simplicity of design and signature comfort.

 Their collaboration with Research Institute 7—which Horizon had become a subsidiary of at the time of the suits creation—gave the suit a notable boost in protection against the Zones anomalous threats.
qj1lk.description_zh:
地平线的战斗护甲。

在创建新的护甲套装时，工作室设计部门的前潜行者专注于军事系列Scythian（Scythian（斯基泰）），旨在保持其设计的简单性和他们标志性的舒适度。

与第7研究所的合作（该研究所在套装创建时已成为工作室的附属机构）对装备应对区域异常威胁的防护特性产生了积极影响。

4ql1r.description:
After close collaboration with SSPP on the development of Hector and its decent sales in the Zone market, Red Shield allocated additional funding for Alen Leibniz, who had long advocated increasing the studios focus on the Zone.

 Thanks to cooperation with Muller, Leibniz was able to quickly provide the necessary project documents, strengthening not only the collaboration with the Mercenaries but also his position on the Red Shield board of directors.
4ql1r.description_zh:
在与SSPP就赫克托的开发密切合作并其在区域市场取得体面销售后，红盾为长期主张增加工作室对区域关注的阿伦·莱布尼茨分配了额外资金。

由于与穆勒合作，莱布尼茨能够快速提供必要的项目文件，不仅加强了与雇佣兵的合作，也加强了他在红盾董事会的地位。

g43rp.description:
One of ZIVCASs legendary designs, which for years set the standard of exoarmor with combined protection against the Zones threats.

 It embodies the advantages of the latest models of research suits and military exoskeleton armor.

 Thanks to a well-designed servo system and an advanced life support system, it still holds its position in the Zones equipment market.
g43rp.description_zh:
ZIVCAS的传奇开发之一，多年来已成为具有针对区域威胁的组合防护的外骨骼装甲标准。

它体现了最新型号科学套装和军用外骨骼装甲的优点。

由于其设计良好的伺服系统和先进的生命支持系统，它仍然在区域装备市场上保持其地位。

ok3q0.description:
Modified by order of the SSPP, Albatross Infiltrator variant was specifically created for Operation Pole.

 It combines composite polymer plates with a movable internal frame made of titanium and nickel. A flexible protective mesh made from a tungsten alloy is added between the layers of fabric.
ok3q0.description_zh:
应SSPP要求改装的信天翁渗透者变体，专为极地行动创建。

它结合了复合聚合物板和由钛和镍制成的可移动内部框架。织物层之间添加了由钨合金制成的柔性防护网。

2ovr0.description:
One of Research Institute 7s advanced developments, demonstrating significant progress in scientists understanding of the nature of anomalous threats as well as in developing comfortable equipment for the Zone.

 According to respected stalkers, if it werent for Saturn, the areas around the Forge would have remained unexplored for much longer.
2ovr0.description_zh:
第7研究所的先进成果之一，展示了科学家对异常威胁性质理解的显著进步，以及为特异区开发舒适装备的进步。

根据资深潜行者的说法，如果不是Saturn，熔炉周围的地区可能会在更长的时间内未被探索。

p69k2.description:
An experimental gear prototype created by Scientific Research Institute 7 specifically for its operatives performing tasks in heavily contaminated areas.

The design of Ganymede went in parallel with the work on Antares. However, due to a group of engineers who disappeared in the summer of 2025, the further development process was delayed. This allowed them to use knowledge of unsuccessful decisions in the design of another suit to their advantage.

As a result, the engineers managed to better optimize the exoskeletons performance and devise a more precise design, ideally suited for work in anomalous zones and the collection of various samples.
p69k2.description_zh:
科学研究所7为其在重污染区域执行任务的特工创建的实验性装备原型。

木卫三的设计与安塔雷斯 的工作并行进行。然而，由于一组工程师在2025年夏天失踪，进一步的开发过程被推迟。这使得他们能够利用对另一套套装设计中不成功决策的了解，来发挥他们的优势。

结果，工程师们成功优化了外骨骼的性能，并构思出更精确的设计，非常适合在异常区域工作和收集各种样本。

96yz0.description: The RS-124 Reiter is a super-heavy armored suit, perfect for survival in intense combat situations. Mercenaries gained access to the Reiter model thanks to the broad connections of their leader, Muller. Its dog-eat-dog in the Zone, and getting worse by the day, so Muller felt it was crucial to get his elite fighters the best protection.
96yz0.description_zh: RS-124莱特是超重型护甲套装，非常适合在激烈的战斗情况下生存。雇佣兵获得莱特模型的访问权限要归功于他们的领袖穆勒广泛的人脉。区域里是狗咬狗，而且一天比一天糟，所以穆勒觉得为他的精英战士提供最好的防护至关重要。

6wgwy.description: This suit currently uses a TEMPORARY model that will be replaced.
6wgwy.description_zh: RS-41“浪人”是专门为满足雇佣兵需求而设计的护甲套装。它适用于那些优先考虑交火的经验丰富的战士。无论是在激烈的枪战中坚守阵地，还是突破交叉火力，穿着这种护甲的雇佣兵都准备好接受任何命令。

n4363.description:
The new exoarmor, created by the Black Market with the latest technology, is specially designed for those inhabitants of the Zone who seek equipment capable of withstanding various infections as well as encounters with mutants.

According to the Baron himself, Marten might primarily interest people involved in transporting goods across the Zone. Thanks to the exoskeletons design, the suit does not lose mobility, which is crucial for navigating any route.

At the same time, some mechanics studying the suit note the similarity of certain technical solutions with the ZIVCAS exoarmor, suggesting thoughts about successful corporate technology theft.
n4363.description_zh:
黑市采用最新技术创造的新型外骨骼装甲，专门为那些寻求能够抵抗各种感染以及与变异生物遭遇的区域居民设计。

根据男爵本人的说法，貂可能主要吸引那些参与在区域运输货物的人。由于外骨骼的设计，套装不会失去机动性，这对于导航任何路线都至关重要。

同时，一些研究该套装的机械师注意到某些技术解决方案与ZIVCAS外骨骼装甲的相似性，暗示了成功的公司技术盗窃的想法。

ly3kj.description: When you see soldiers in this armor, be warned—the day of Judgment has come! These Covenant fanatics are bringing suffering to the world. But those who wear this armor are well protected from suffering due to the increased bullet resistance.
ly3kj.description_zh: 当你看到穿着这种护甲的士兵时，要当心——审判日已经到来！这些契约狂热分子正在将痛苦带给世界。但是，由于增强的防弹能力，穿着这种护甲的人受到的保护很好，免受痛苦。

1rpl6.description: The prototype of a super-heavy armored suit thats still in development. Even so, when clashing with other factions, Frontier has no choice but to use this model now for some of its subdivisions. Only the very best Frontier soldiers have a chance to try on this armored suit. They walk the Zone with granite tread, eliminating mutants and anarchists alike.
1rpl6.description_zh: 仍在开发中的超重型护甲套装原型。即便如此，当与其他部族发生冲突时，纪律别无选择，现在不得不为其一些部门使用这个型号。只有最优秀的纪律士兵才有机会试穿这件护甲套装。他们踏着花岗岩般的步伐行走在区域，消灭变异生物和无政府主义者。

wj4lp.description: The Covenants craftsmen obviously wanted to make this a multipurpose suit. It gives solid protection in fierce fights, but also offers enhanced resistance to anomalous effects. A good choice for aspiring Covenant warrior monks.
wj4lp.description_zh: 契约的工匠显然想把这种套装做成多用途的。它在激烈的战斗中提供坚实的防护，同时也增强了对异常效应的抵抗力。对于有抱负的契约武僧战士来说是一个不错的选择。

5l1q0.description:
Despite the fact that the SSPP strives to localize the production of equipment for their fighters, the military does not shy away from seeking help in various external organizations.

 However, Hector, the result of the collaboration between the Red Shield atelier and SSPP, will not be able to enter "military conveyor" production due to its high cost, which, it must be said, quite matches the characteristics of the exosuit.

 After receiving a rejection from the military, Red Shield decided to recoup their development losses of this unique equipment by putting it up for sale to external buyers —stalkers and other inhabitants of the Zone.
5l1q0.description_zh:
尽管SSPP致力于为其战士实现装备生产的本地化，军方并不排斥向各类外部组织寻求帮助。

然而，作为“红盾”工坊与SSPP合作的产物，“赫克托”因其高昂的成本而无法进入“军用流水线”生产——不得不说，其成本与外骨骼装甲的性能倒也确实相称。

在遭到军方拒绝后，“红盾”决定将这套独特装备推向外部买家——即潜行者与区域内的其他居民，以弥补其开发损失。

zzjk2.description:
Although the Ace is almost entirely identical to its original version, seasoned bandits favor the Black Market craftsmens take on it.

 Baron endured significant losses for a long time before deciding to set up his own small-scale production. Thanks to the Ace, however, the Black Market not only recovered its losses but also turned a decent profit, allowing it to expand its product range.
zzjk2.description_zh:
尽管王牌几乎完全与其原始版本相同，但有经验的强盗更喜欢使用黑市工匠的改装版。

男爵在决定建立自己的小规模生产之前，长期承受了重大损失。然而，由于王牌，黑市不仅收回了损失，还实现了可观的利润，使其能够扩大产品范围。

5l1yg.description:
Advanced version of the suit from the Artifact Hunter series.

 The advanced life support system, developed by the employees of Research Institute 7, eliminates the need to worry about extra medical supplies, while good protection against external threats soften all other troubles.

 Despite intentions for further development of the series, the institutes engineers faced the limitation of the current level of technology, which necessitated the suspension of work on new suits in the line.
5l1yg.description_zh:
神器猎人系列的先进版本套装。

第7研究所员工开发的先进生命支持系统消除了对额外医疗用品的担忧，而良好的外部威胁防护则软化了所有其他麻烦。

尽管打算进一步发展该系列，但研究所工程师面临着当前技术水平限制的问题，这需要暂停该系列新套装的工作。

5l1l0.description: This design, proposed by a junior engineer at Research Institute 7, served as the foundation for the Orion suit and was highly appreciated not only by the science wing of the Rise but also by many of the factions fighters. Built with the latest technology, this suit is meant to provide access to even the most dangerous areas of the Zone—because science should always reach for the stars!
5l1l0.description_zh: 第7研究所初级工程师提出的设计，成为猎户座的基础，不仅受到自由科学部门成员的赞赏，也受到该团体许多战士的赞赏。这件采用最新技术制作的套装，旨在提供即使是最危险区域区域的访问权限——因为科学必须向上发展！

ly3w1.description: One of the advanced developments of Research Institute 7, created in collaboration with the subsidiary atelier Horizon. Continuing the creation of suits for scientific activities, Research Institute 7 enlisted the support and expertise of Horizons specialists to develop equipment suitable not only for exploring anomalous zones but also for direct combat with the fauna and contingents of the CEZ. However, not the best placement of servomotors and the non-standard closed breathing system make it less comfortable to use than other models designed by the institute.
ly3w1.description_zh: 第7研究所的先进开发之一，与附属工作室地平线合作创建。在继续为科学活动创建套装的过程中，第7研究所获得了地平线专家的支持和专业知识，以开发不仅适合探索异常区域，也适合直接与CEZ的动物群和人员战斗的装备。然而，并非最佳的伺服电机布置和非标准的闭路呼吸系统使其使用起来不如研究所设计的其他模型舒适。

wj49p.description:
A handcrafted suit by digger craftsmen, based on Jaeger.

 The use of a more advanced version of the servomotors and additional armor reinforcement increased the manufacturing cost. However, thanks to these enhancements, Beast Slayer can withstand direct encounters with Behemoth and even take a hit from a fiend!
wj49p.description_zh:
由挖掘者工匠制作的自制套装，基于猎人创建。

使用更先进版本的伺服电机和额外的装甲加固增加了制造成本。然而，由于这些增强，屠兽者能够承受与巨兽和魔鬼的直接遭遇和攻击！

ly30j.description:
Anyone who encounters Longevity in the Zone is likely to mistake it for Uranus, but any experienced inhabitant of the CEZ knows that only an experienced and authoritative stalker can acquire such an item.

 One of the artisans responsible for creating the suit once declared that he would make such a suit for anyone who could prove they had lived in the Zone longer than he had. Rumor has it that the poor guy is still obliged to keep his word to maintain his credibility!
ly30j.description_zh:
任何在区域遇到长寿的人都很可能将其误认为天王星，但任何有经验的CEZ居民都知道，只有经验丰富且权威的潜行者才能获得这样的物品。

负责制作该套装的一位工匠曾宣称，他会为任何能证明自己在区域生活时间比他长的人制作这样一套套装。传言说，这个可怜的家伙仍然有义务信守诺言以维持他的信誉！

kn3yv.description:
One of the developments by Scientific Research Institute 7, based on the latest advancements in exoarmor design for the CEZ.

 The collaboration with stalkers from Horizon on the Artifact Hunters series motivated the institutes engineers to resume the development of combined armor based on Uranus.

 The result of this work is a suit that provides excellent comprehensive protection against almost all threats of the Zone!
kn3yv.description_zh:
第7研究所基于CEZ外骨骼装甲设计的最新进展而开发的成果之一。

与地平线潜行者在神器猎人系列上的合作激励了研究所的工程师恢复基于天王星的组合护甲的开发。

这项工作的结果是一件提供针对几乎所有区域威胁的出色全面防护的套装！

96y6z.description:
Crafted by Black Markets artisans, this armor allows the warriors of the Covenant to endure suffering while still caring for their mortal bodies.
