 Its the perfect balance of spiritual and physical, sublime and mundane, high mobility and good protection.
96y6z.description_zh:
由黑市工匠制作的护甲，允许契约的战士承受痛苦的同时仍然关心肉体凡胎。

它是精神与肉体、崇高与世俗、高机动性和良好防护的完美结合。

zzjzn.description: This suit currently uses a TEMPORARY model that will be replaced.
zzjzn.description_zh:
尽管纪律专注于阵地战，但这套护甲套装在调查员中变得非常受欢迎，因此得名。

纪律的战士们声称，套装的高机动性不仅让他们能更快地到达目标，还能追上使用猎犬的最快的自由成员。

g434p.description:
The latest military development designed for operations in the most aggressive environments. As the Frontier members say, the suit was complete junk until it ended up in the hands of the factions craftsmen through internal channels.

 The modified research suit by the Frontier craftsmen is on par with even the best works of Research Institute 7, which should enable fighters to reach the most inaccessible places where the Zones contamination lurks.
g434p.description_zh:
为在最恶劣环境中行动设计的最新军事开发。正如纪律成员所说，这套套装在通过内部渠道落入该阵营工匠手中之前完全是垃圾。

纪律工匠改装过的科学套装甚至可以与第7研究所最好的作品相媲美，这应该能使战士们到达区域污染潜伏的最难以接近的地方。

m034j.description:
The RS-72 Punisher is a universal armored suit developed specifically designed to meet the needs of mercenaries operating in the Zone.

 According to Muller, it took much to initiate separate work in this direction within Red Shield, but the result has clearly justified itself.

 Thanks to the experience of the mercenaries, RS engineers succeeded in creating a universal suit to confidently execute any tasks assigned to them.
m034j.description_zh:
RS-72惩罚者是专门为满足在区域行动的雇佣兵需求而开发的通用护甲套装。

根据穆勒的说法，在红盾内部启动这个方向的单独工作需要很多努力，但结果显然证明了其合理性。

由于雇佣兵的经验，RS工程师成功创造了一套通用的套装，以自信地执行分配给他们的任何任务。

1rpr1.description: This suit currently uses a TEMPORARY model that will be replaced.
1rpr1.description_zh: 圣殿骑士护甲套装是契约理想的体现。如同他们的信念一样坚定，如同他们的信仰一样不可动摇，它旨在确保士兵在圣战的炽热中生存，并将痛苦带给异教徒。

7lzl7.description:
The RS-152 Navigator is designed to assist mercenaries in missions across the most dangerous and unexplored areas of the Zone.

 As Muller says, "Anomalies and radiation are not valid excuses for mission failure," which means its worth taking precautions to minimize their impact.
7lzl7.description_zh:
RS-152导航者旨在协助雇佣兵在最危险和未探索的区域区域执行任务。

正如穆勒所说，“异象和辐射不是任务失败的正当理由”，这意味着最好提前做好准备，以尽量减少它们的影响。

m03w7.description:
M2-based exoarmor, specially developed for ZIVCAS field commanders.

 This advanced model is fitted with an innovative integrated communication device and a holographic interface, ensuring effective operative coordination and continuous battlefield monitoring!

Additionally, the defense and life support systems were upgraded, providing the highest survival rate of any comparable suit, keeping the most valuable ZIVCAS fighters alive.
m03w7.description_zh:
基于M2的外骨骼装甲，专门为ZIVCAS战地指挥官开发。

这种先进型号配备了创新的集成通信设备和全息界面，可以有效地协调操作员的行动并持续跟踪战场局势！此外，防御和生命支持系统也进行了升级。增强的防御和生命支持系统提供了与任何同类产品相比最高的生存率，拯救了最有价值的ZIVCAS战士的生命。

wj4no.description:
Legendary armor by the well-known corporation that supplies the best exoarmors for Zone conditions!

Although the Albatross Heavy Assault Armored Exoskeleton uses the servomotor system common to all suits in the series, additional modifications were made to the exoskeleton during its development, improving its protective properties without sacrificing mobility.

Advanced materials and top quality make the Albatross Heavy Assault Armored Exoskeleton one of the most desired suits among stalkers.
wj4no.description_zh:
知名公司的传奇护甲，为区域条件提供最好的外骨骼装甲！
尽管信天翁重型突击护甲外骨骼使用了该系列所有套装共用的伺服电机系统，但在开发这件套装时对外骨骼进行了额外的改装。这不仅改善了其防护性能，还保持了机动性。
先进的材料和顶级质量使信天翁重型突击护甲外骨骼成为潜行者中最令人向往的套装之一。

ljn2.description:
Unlike other artifacts from Blizzard, Chilly possesses a unique composition. A significant portion of it consists of metallic hydrogen, which is incredibly strong and likely encases argon.

 The presence of this inert gas within the unbreakable shell was determined through the superconductivity observed on the artifacts surface. When various electric charges were passed through it, the artifacts luminosity changed.
ljn2.description_zh:
与其他来自暴风雪的神器不同，寒冰拥有独特的成分。其很大一部分由金属氢构成，这种物质极其坚固，很可能包裹着氩气。

这种惰性气体存在于坚不可摧的外壳内，是通过观察神器表面超导性确定的。当各种电荷通过它时，神器的发光度会发生变化。

qo06.description:
An electrophysical artifact, in consistency resembling an elastic but rather dense jelly with a clear internal structure.

 The features of the Transformer are still being discussed by scientists, as the artifacts material is capable not only of restoring any structural deformations to their original state but also of independently generating small electric charges.
qo06.description_zh:
一种电物理神器，在稠度上类似于一种有弹性但相当致密的果冻，具有清晰的内部结构。

变压器的特性仍在被科学家讨论，因为该神器的材料不仅能够将任何结构变形恢复到原始状态，还能独立产生小的电荷。

zyw2.description:
A small, brightly glowing artifact resembling a fiery vortex with a peculiar feature—its center and edges rotate in different directions.

 There is a rumor among experienced stalkers about a Candlelight with a fully synchronized rotation, though scientists from the Research Institute 7s artifactology department deny its existence.
zyw2.description_zh:
一种小型的、明亮发光的神器，外观类似于一个具有奇特特征的火涡旋——中心和边缘向不同方向旋转。

在有经验的潜行者中，有关于烛光的传言，其旋转完全同步，但第7研究所神器学部门的科学家否认存在这种形式的烛光。

y5vw.description:
The unusually precise geometric figures covering the inner side of the artifact are formed simultaneously from two different allotropic modifications of calcium. The traces of organic material found in the mineral indicate the involvement of unidentified microorganisms in their formation.

 Botanists suggest that such precise patterns may arise due to a mechanism similar to that of some lichens, which leads scientists to consider the involvement of plants in the appearance of the artifact.
y5vw.description_zh:
覆盖神器内侧的异常精确的几何图形同时由两种不同的钙同素异形体形成。在矿物中发现的有机物质痕迹表明未鉴定的微生物参与了它们的形成。

植物学家认为，如此精确的图案可能是由于与某些地衣相似的机制而产生的，这使科学家们考虑植物参与了该神器的出现。

qokj.description:
An unusual artifact formed near gravitational anomalies in the Wild North.
The strange geometrical regularity of the Pumpkin immediately led scientists to hypothesize its kinship with the Polyhedron, but no serious similarities were found in various analyses. Professor Kubov, on the other hand, considers the existence of the Pumpkin as confirmation of his hypothesis about universal structures. Stalkers, usually uninterested in high matters, saw nothing extraordinary in the regularity of the artifacts shapes, dubbing it Pumpkin for its characteristic veins.
qokj.description_zh:
一种在狂野北方重力异常点附近形成的不寻常神器。
"南瓜"奇特的几何规则性立即让科学家们推测它与"多面体"有亲缘关系，但在各种分析中并未发现实质性的相似之处。另一方面，库博夫教授认为"南瓜"的存在证实了他关于普遍结构的假说。通常对高深事物不感兴趣的潜行者，对这种规则形状的神器并无特别看法，只是因其特有的纹理而称之为"南瓜"。

lj0j.description:
A representative of electrophysical artifacts that can be found only in the territory of the Wild North.

A significant portion of the properties of the Coil, according to the artifactology department staff, remains unclear. Nevertheless, the formation of ionized air around the artifact was recently explained in a report by Research Institute 7. Scientists state that Coil emits ultraviolet radiation in the range of about 100 nm, which initiates the process of photoionization.

Although ionized air has a positive effect on health, many stalkers are wary of carrying the artifact without a container. Rumor has it that one veteran who brought a dozen Coils from an extended raid was struck by lightning indoors!
lj0j.description_zh:
一种只能在狂野北方地区发现的电物理特性神器的代表。

根据神器学部工作人员的说法，"线圈"的大部分特性仍未明确。尽管如此，第七研究所最近的一份报告解释了该神器周围形成电离空气的现象。科学家指出，"线圈"会发射约100纳米波段的紫外线，从而引发光电离过程。

虽然电离空气对健康有积极影响，但许多潜行者对不将神器装入容器随身携带的做法持谨慎态度。传闻有位老兵在一次长线突袭中带回十几个"线圈"，结果在室内被闪电劈中！

4lpo.description:
A rare gravitational artifact found only in the Wild North.

Scientists suggest that Static has some kinship with Bracelet due to similar magnetic properties of the artifact. According to Professor Kubovs hypothesis, specimen No. 527-AO, known among stalkers as Static, is formed by particles with properties close to a theoretical magnetic monopole, allowing the artifact to have a sufficiently strong field capable of significantly slowing a bullet even from a rifle.

The unusual electromagnetic field properties that the artifact exhibits also hold its fragments together. Research by Research Institute 7, during which attempts were made to detach one of the parts of the Static, showed no results. However, there is a tale among stalkers of a careless rookie who managed to break the artifact by awkwardly landing on a Backpack from a Trampoline.
4lpo.description_zh:
一种仅在狂野北方发现的稀有重力神器。

科学家认为"静电场"与"手镯"存在某种亲缘关系，因为两者具有相似的磁特性。根据库博夫教授的假说，潜行者称之为"静电场"的第527-AO号样本，是由特性接近理论中磁单极子的粒子构成的，这使得该神器具备足够强大的场，即使步枪子弹也能显著减速。

该神器展现出的异常电磁场特性也使其碎片能够聚合在一起。第七研究所曾试图分离"静电场"的部件进行研究，但未能成功。然而潜行者中流传着一个故事，有个粗心的菜鸟从"跳床"上笨拙地摔到背包上，竟然把这神器给摔碎了。

k3rv.description:
An artifact resembling a Czech hedgehog.

The unique structure of the artifact, consisting of metallic "spikes" and a "core," is actually quite fragile. As initial experiments in the artifactology department of Research Institute 7 have shown, when the "core" is destroyed, the remaining structure loses its shape, turning into molten lead.
k3rv.description_zh:
一种形似捷克刺猬的反坦克障碍物的神器。

该神器由金属“刺”和“核心”组成的独特结构实际上相当脆弱。正如第七研究所神器学部门的初步实验所示，当“核心”被摧毁后，剩余结构会失去形状，变成熔融的铅。

6goy.description:
An unusual artifact representing a constantly circulating stream of water flowing in a closed loop.

Despite being composed of liquid, the Loop can be held in ones hands—the main challenge is not letting the stream slip away, as it can easily "flow" out of your grip.

It is said that several stalkers attempted to experiment with the artifact, trying to disrupt the flow of the liquid. However, it merely bent further and returned to its usual pattern of circulation.

Nowadays, rumors circulate in the Bar that the artifact does a surprisingly good job of cleaning the inner walls of containers, although this has yet to be confirmed.
6goy.description_zh:
一个异常的神器，呈现为一股呈闭环状不断循环流动的水流。

尽管由液体构成，但“绳套”可以被握在手中——主要挑战在于别让这股水流溜走，因为它很容易从你的指缝间“流走”。

据说曾有几位潜行者尝试对这个神器进行实验，试图扰乱液体的流动。然而，它只是弯曲得更厉害，然后又恢复到其通常的循环模式。

如今，酒吧里流传着一种说法，称这个神器在清洁容器内壁方面出奇地好用，虽然这一说法尚未得到证实。

1kv2.description:
According to some stalkers, the small appendages covering the Prima resemble legs or antennae, but the scientists at Research Institute 7 claim that their cellular structure places them closer to the root hairs of small shrubs common in the Zone.

 The outer "shell" of the artifact, resembling stone, is made not of rock, but primarily of organic chitin. This supports those who consider the Prima more akin to some living larva than an artifact.
1kv2.description_zh:
根据一些潜行者的说法，覆盖沙子的小附属物有点像腿或触角，但第7研究所的科学家声称，这些形成物在细胞结构上更接近区域常见的小灌木的根毛。

该神器的外部“壳”，看起来像石头，并非由岩石构成，而主要由有机几丁质构成。这支持了那些认为沙子更类似于某种活体幼虫而不是神器的人。

j306.description:
A strange artifact whose outer elements resemble parts of a tank.

Scientists at Research Institute 7 are still puzzling over how the artifactogenesis process works, but the leading hypothesis is that it copies the structural forms of matter that may once have occupied the site of the anomalous field.

At the same time, the substance the artifact is made of bears no real resemblance to metal, instead looking more like a cluster of microscopic crystals.
j306.description_zh: 一件奇怪的神器，其外部元素酷似坦克部件。

04yr.description:
A unique organic artifact that can be found only in the Wild North.

Modern theory of artifactogenesis provides no reliable explanation for the formation process of anomalous structures. The appearance of the Loop and studies of its internal structure indicate the artifacts organic nature, which still offers no understanding of how such a formation could have formed. Many stalkers, in turn, believe that most artifacts form from certain objects caught in anomalies. Although scientists do not fully share these beliefs, some artifactology department employees conduct research in this direction, attempting to track the connection between specific objects in the anomalys vicinity and the artifacts it creates.
04yr.description_zh:
一种仅在狂野北方才能找到的独特有机神器。

现代神器成因理论无法为异常结构的形成过程提供可靠解释。"环"的出现及其内部结构研究表明其具有有机性质，但这仍无法解释这种结构是如何形成的。许多潜行者则认为，大多数神器是由陷入异常点的特定物体形成的。尽管科学家不完全认同这种观点，但神器学部门的一些研究人员正在朝这个方向探索，试图追踪异常点附近特定物体与其产生的神器之间的联系。

q10k.description:
An artifact with an unusual appearance, resembling a pile of links from hovering caterpillar tracks around a center of mass.

Despite the clear similarity of the artifacts fragments to tank tracks, scientists studying the obtained samples reject hypotheses about the involvement of fragments of military equipment in its artifactogenesis. According to Professor Cubov, lithium predominates in the fragments, which is not a component of the tracks used in machinery.
q10k.description_zh: 一件外观异常的神器，酷似一堆围绕质心悬浮的履带链环。

gy06.description:
A gray-brown sphere covered in a layer of rough, lignified cells, from which the growths covering the artifact also consist, creating the impression of numerous clicking beaks.

 The glow emerging from within Scrubber is due to strong bioluminescence of plant cells.
gy06.description_zh:
一个灰棕色的球体，覆盖着一层粗糙的木栓化细胞，构成覆盖该神器的生长物的也是这些细胞，产生了众多咔哒作响的喙的印象。

从贝壳内部发出的光是由于植物细胞的强烈生物发光。

5rg1.description:
This artifacts name comes from a tale spun by a fence that was trying to convince his clients to dispose of the Cursed Rose as quickly as possible, claiming it "unnaturally attracts misfortune."

 The merchant nearly pulled it off, but some time later, the poor fellow turned up dead. Its said he accidentally fell down the stairs trying to escape with the artifacts from some unhappy stalkers.
5rg1.description_zh:
该神器的名称与一个故事有关，这个故事源于一个买家说服客户迅速处理掉诅咒玫瑰，声称它“奇怪地吸引不幸”。

尽管这位商人几乎成功地实施了这样一个简单的骗局，但最终，这个不幸的人被发现死亡。据说他在试图带着神器逃离不满的潜行者时，不小心摔下了楼梯。

rnvg.description:
A thermal artifact found exclusively in the Wild North.

The appearance of this anomalous formation confuses many stalkers, but not scientists, who know to trust their instruments. Despite a hypothesis suggesting that organic cells are replaced with mineral substances, analysis of artifact fragments has shown no evidence of any internal cellular structure.

The first stalker to discover the Cone believed the artifact to be an unusual fruit of the Chernobyl pine and attempted to pass the sample to the flora and fauna department through a familiar operative of Research Institute 7. According to the operative, the scientists had already cooked up a hundred theories about anomalous pine trees by the time Professor Cubov happened to wander into the biologists wing.
rnvg.description_zh:
一种仅在狂野北方发现的热属性神器。

这种异常形态的出现令许多潜行者感到困惑，但习惯了依赖仪器的科学家们却不为所动。尽管存在一种假说认为其有机细胞被矿物物质所取代，但对神器碎片的分析并未显示有任何内部细胞结构的证据。

第一个发现"松果"的潜行者以为这是切尔诺贝利松树的奇异果实，试图通过熟识的科研所特工将样本转交给动植物部门。据该特工称，当库博夫教授偶然闯入生物学家区域时，科学家们已经就异常松树提出了上百种理论。

q1lk.description:
A trophy artifact obtained in battles with Murmur.
It resembles a chitinous cocoon with resilient translucent formations that look like the respiratory organs of fish. These formations slightly "open" and absorb oxygen from the surrounding environment. When in proximity to a large living organism, it begins to form a transparent slime with a strong odor on the organisms epithelial surface, which is instantly absorbed into the skin without a trace. Samples of the slime contain microorganisms—a bacterial colony of unknown nature.
q1lk.description_zh:
在与低语者战斗中获得的战利品神器。
它类似于一个几丁质茧，带有弹性的半透明形成物，看起来像鱼的呼吸器官。这些形成物轻微“张开”并从周围环境中吸收氧气。当靠近大型生物体时，它开始在生物体的表皮表面形成一种透明的、有强烈气味的粘液，这种粘液会立即被皮肤吸收，不留痕迹。粘液样本含有微生物——一种未知性质的细菌菌落。

gyjg.description:
A semi-transparent anomalous formation of a salad-green color, which typically appears near Aspic.

 On some facets of Acid Crystal, small formations can be seen, which are characteristic of each artifact sample. Interestingly, they are located in the same place on all Acid Crystal samples.

 Scientists specializing in molecular chemistry believe that such a phenomenon is only possible if the structures of all artifact samples completely coincide.
gyjg.description_zh:
一种沙拉绿色的半透明异常形成物，通常出现在凝胶附近。

在酸水晶的一些晶面上，可以看到小的形成物，这是每个神器样本的特征。有趣的是，它们位于所有酸水晶样本的同一位置。

专门研究分子化学的科学家认为，只有当所有神器样本的结构完全重合时，才可能出现这种现象。

wgr3.description:
A matte black crystal, noticeably different from other artifacts in its group by its level of transparency.

 According to stalkers, Dark Crystal is an excellent writing tool, although its shape is inconvenient. Scientists who studied the artifact explain that its molecular structure is similar to the structure of graphite used in pencils. The only difference is the presence of silicon atoms in the lattice. How such a structure forms and remains stable is not yet explained by scientists.
wgr3.description_zh:
一种磨砂的黑色晶体，在其组的透明度水平上明显区别于其他神器。

根据潜行者的说法，黑水晶是一种极好的书写工具，尽管其形状不便。研究该神器的科学家解释说，其分子结构类似于铅笔中使用的石墨结构。唯一的区别是晶格中硅原子的存在。科学家尚未解释这种结构是如何形成并保持稳定的。

jkq7.description:
One of the most beautiful artifacts of the Zone, found only in the Wild North.

Although among the inhabitants of the Zone it has earned the straightforward name Magma, scientists can accurately state that the viscous high-temperature liquid is not molten rock, although it tries very hard to resemble it. Hot Resin, as one scientist described it, has the greatest similarity to various hydrocarbons, which, according to the Research Institute 7 employees, is what allows it to maintain the artifacts temperature.

While Magma can certainly cause burns if handled with bare hands, many collectors from the Mainland are very interested in the artifact, eager to add it to their collections.
jkq7.description_zh:
特异区中最美丽的神器之一，仅能在狂野北方发现。

尽管在特异区居民中它被直白地称为"岩浆"，但科学家可以明确表示，这种粘稠的高温液体并非熔融岩石，尽管它极力模仿岩石的外观。正如一位科学家所描述的那样，热熔树脂与各种碳氢化合物最为相似，第七研究所的研究人员认为，正是这种特性维持了神器的温度。

虽然用手直接触碰"岩浆"肯定会被烫伤，但许多来自大陆的收藏家对这种神器非常感兴趣，渴望将其加入自己的收藏。

rnkl.description:
Objects classified under the EA class often do not exhibit pronounced anomalous properties—and so the Snares remained in the Research Institute 7s sample storage for a long time, overlooked by scientists.

However, stalkers with a keen eye immediately noticed the new curiosity and even accidentally discovered its unusual property—any object weighing exactly 3.14 grams cannot cross the artifacts permanent static field, turning into ash on contact. 

Scientists believe that the artifact draws energy to sustain its static field from the destruction of molecular bonds within such objects.
rnkl.description_zh:
由于该神器所属的EA类物体通常不表现出明显的异常特性，陷阱长期以来一直存放在样品库中，没有得到第7研究所科学家的任何关注。

然而，眼尖的潜行者立刻注意到了这个新奇的玩意儿，甚至无意中发现了该神器的不寻常特性——任何恰好重3.14克的物体都无法穿过该神器的永久静态场，而是在接触时化为灰烬。

科学家认为，通过破坏此类物体内部的键，该神器吸取能量以维持静态场。

j3p6.description:
A trophy artifact obtained from battles with Murmur. 
Externally—a crystal covered with resilient whitish resin. Carbon analysis revealed organic particles undergoing constant mutations in the resin composition.
Near a large living organism, the crystal alters its molecular properties, causing the resin to move. Observations showed no invasive action on the organism; however, blood samples post-contact revealed organic particles resembling those composing the resin.
j3p6.description_zh:
在与低语者战斗中获得的战利品神器。
外观——一块晶体，覆盖着有弹性的白色树脂。碳分析显示树脂成分中存在不断突变的有机颗粒。
靠近大型生物体时，晶体会改变其分子特性，导致树脂移动。观察显示对生物体没有侵入性作用；然而，接触后的血液样本揭示了类似于构成树脂的有机颗粒。

w4no.description:
A trophy artifact obtained from battles with Murmur.
A cool-to-touch artifact covered with a dense organic formation over which a slight ripple occasionally passes, resembling muscle contractions. Inside, the silhouette of another artifact can be distinguished, suggesting the objects composite nature. 
Upon proximity to the body, the hard mass begins to produce a polymorphic enzyme in the blood. No painful sensations were noted during the process.
Significant capillary tension is observed in the organism affected, especially near the artifact. Upon removal, light inflammation appears on the skin, which quickly passes.
w4no.description_zh:
在与低语者战斗中获得的战利品神器。
一种触感凉爽的神器，覆盖着致密的有机形成物，其上偶尔会掠过轻微的涟漪，类似于肌肉收缩。内部可以分辨出另一个神器的轮廓，表明该物体的复合性质。
靠近身体时，坚硬的物质开始在血液中产生一种多态酶。过程中未观察到疼痛感。
在受影响的生物体中观察到显著的毛细血管张力，尤其是在神器附近。移除后，皮肤上出现轻微的炎症，但很快消失。

y5nz.description:
Anthracite-black drops the size of an apple, which can be found near the Lighter anomaly. They have a limited effect on the surrounding temperature balance by influencing particle vibrations.

 Some stalkers use the artifact to change the temperature of food and drinks. Scientists strongly advise against following such reckless practices.
y5nz.description_zh:
炭黑色的泪滴状物，大小如苹果，可以在打火机异象附近找到。它们通过影响粒子振动来有限地影响周围的温度平衡。

一些潜行者使用该神器来改变食物和饮料的温度。科学家强烈建议不要效仿这种鲁莽的做法。

9n1w.description:
A red-brown artifact of organic origin, whose surface is covered with formations reactive to loud sounds. The movements of these little "eyes" often frighten inexperienced stalkers seeing the Berry for the first time.

 The artifacts unusual appearance and behavior provoke rumors that it emerges from the remains of those who perished in the Blender, but scientists have been unable to confirm any truth to these stalker tales.
9n1w.description_zh:
一种红棕色的有机起源神器，其表面覆盖着对响亮声音有反应的形成物。这些“眼睑”的运动常常吓到第一次见到浆果的没有经验的潜行者。

该神器不寻常的外观和行为引发了关于该神器来自在搅拌机中丧生者遗骸的传言，但科学家一直无法证实这些潜行者故事的真实性。

y5m3.description:
Scientists at Research Institute 7 joke that the formation of Cryogen occurs when someone from the fundamental research department makes a sign error in physics calculations.

 Like Amberite, it is covered with a semi-transparent liquid that significantly refracts light, which appears on the surface of the warm mineral. Professor Cubov believes that the mirroring between the artifacts might be caused by some phenomenon of chirality at a higher, non-molecular level.
y5m3.description_zh:
第7研究所的科学家开玩笑说，当基础研究部门的某人在物理计算中犯了一个符号错误时，就会形成冷凝剂。

像琥珀石一样，它覆盖着一种显著折射光线的半透明液体，这种液体出现在温热的矿物表面。库博夫教授认为，神器之间的镜像可能是由某种更高层次的非分子手性现象引起的。

49zn.description:
A trophy artifact obtained from battles with Murmur.
A sticky and soft-to-touch organic base covered with dense connective tissue tendrils.
In a resting state, extremities occasionally undergo spasms. When the artifact exerts its effect, the tendrils attempt to envelop the limb and penetrate the epithelium while significantly elongating. Simultaneously, the organic base begins pulsing in rhythm with heart contractions.
Injects a cocktail of hormones and organic compounds affecting blood supply and higher nervous activity.
49zn.description_zh:
在与低语者战斗中获得的战利品神器。
一种粘稠且触感柔软的有机基质，覆盖着致密的结缔组织卷须。
静止状态下，肢体偶尔会发生痉挛。当神器发挥其作用时，卷须试图包裹肢体并穿透表皮，同时显著伸长。与此同时，有机基质开始以心脏收缩的节奏搏动。
注入一种影响血液供应和高级神经活动的激素和有机化合物混合物。

5rd1.description:
This stony formation resembles both the Hedgehog and the Scrubber. However, unlike other artifacts, Steel Hedgehog has non-moving protrusions, and its glow is noticeably dimmer.

 It can be conjectured that the Steel Hedgehog is the final stage of the Hedgehogs metamorphosis, where all internal resource reserves have been completely depleted, and energy to sustain processes begins to be generated by the decomposition of metal-containing salts from the soil.
5rd1.description_zh:
这种石质形成物类似于刺猬和贝壳。然而，与其他神器不同的是，钢铁刺猬具有不可移动的突起，并且其发光明显更暗。

可以推测，钢铁刺猬是刺猬蜕变的最终阶段，其所有内部资源储备已完全耗尽，维持过程的能量开始由土壤中的含金属盐分解产生。

ljpq.description:
A small cube with chaotically protruding, regularly shaped formations. Most facets of the artifact feature green inclusions, indicating biological activity.

 According to scientists, the internal structure of the artifact is even more intriguing. The internal cavity of the Polyhedron, filled with a greenish luminescent liquid, contains a copy of the artifact. This “nesting doll” effect repeats down to the micrometer scale, and the artifacts properties are likely directly related to this peculiarity.
ljpq.description_zh:
一个小的立方体，带有不规则形状的、随机突出的形成物。该神器的大多数面上都有绿色的内含物，表明存在生物活性。

根据科学家的说法，该神器的内部结构甚至更有趣。多面体的内部腔体充满了绿色的发光液体，其中包含一个神器的复制品。这种“俄罗斯套娃”效应一直重复到微米尺度。该神器的特性很可能直接与此特征相关。

51l0.description:
A creepy gravitational artifact nicknamed "Mug" by stalkers for its resemblance to a human face.

Scientists at Research Institute 7 have long tried to determine its composition and structure, but have not reached a consensus. Although all Mug samples look almost identical, they may actually be composed of different debris.

Stalkers have noted another feature: two blinking diodes that sync to the bearers heartbeat. Such similarity of this artifact to the Heart has spawned many tales among the Zones inhabitants.
51l0.description_zh:
一种令人毛骨悚然的引力神器，因其略微类似于人脸而被潜行者命名为大杯子。

第7研究所的科学家长期以来一直试图确定其成分和结构，但未能达成共识。尽管每个大杯子样本看起来几乎完全相同，但它实际上可能由不同的碎片构成。

潜行者注意到了另一个特征：两个闪烁的二极管，与携带者的心跳同步。大杯子与心脏的这种相似性在区域居民中催生了许多故事。

5rog.description:
It got its name due to the characteristic movements caused by the differences in the shape memory effect of the metals that compose it.

 Under normal conditions, the artifact scarcely attenuates, but it quickly loses its mobility and inner incandescence when placed in an area of high atmospheric pressure.
5rog.description_zh:
由于构成它的金属的形状记忆效应差异引起的特征运动而得名。

在正常情况下，该神器的衰减微乎其微，但当置于高气压区域时，它会迅速失去其流动性和内部炽热。

kqoj.description:
A Blizzard artifact resembling an inverted heel, with an unusual composition and structure for an artifact that at first glance seems to consist entirely of ordinary ice.

 As with the Fahrenheit, the issue lies in the unusual gas content, with mass significantly lower than that of air. The artifacts hollow structure and the properties of these gases create a peculiar effect resembling a roly-poly toy.
kqoj.description_zh:
暴风雪神器，类似于倒置的鞋跟，对于乍一看似乎完全由普通冰组成的神器来说，其成分和结构相当不寻常。

与华氏度类似，问题在于不寻常的气体含量，其质量明显比空气轻。神器的空心结构和内部气体的特性产生了一种奇特的效果，让人联想到不倒翁玩具的行为。

5r04.description:
An extremely fragile, rough-to-the-touch artifact whose surface is often mistaken for metallic. Scientists explain that the appearance of the Phlegm is associated with material degradation, likely due to the complete destruction of bonds between the organic molecules of the substance.

 At present, the exact mechanism by which the artifact manages to maintain its structure despite the complete destruction of most molecular bonds is unknown. However, the flora and fauna department at Research Institute 7 believes it may occur due to the life processes of yet undiscovered microorganisms.
5r04.description_zh:
一种极其脆弱、触感粗糙的神器，其表面常被误认为是金属。科学家解释说，痰液的出现与材料的降解有关，很可能是由于物质有机分子之间的键完全破坏所致。

目前，尚不清楚该神器如何能够在大多数分子键完全破坏的情况下保持其结构。然而，第7研究所的动植物部门认为，这可能是由于尚未发现的微生物的生命活动所致。

9nml.description:
The artifact forms in the Fluff anomaly. It outwardly resembles a small ball with soft spines that consist of something akin to muscle tissue.

 The parent anomaly, Burr, being unusual even by the standards of the Zone, apparently creates such formations during its reproduction process.
9nml.description_zh:
该神器在绒毛异象中形成。它外观类似于一个小球，上面覆盖着由类似肌肉组织的东西构成的柔软尖刺。

其母体异象——刺果，即使在区域的标准下也不寻常，显然在其繁殖过程中会产生这样的形成物。

g34p.description:
A peculiar anomalous formation of biochemical nature discovered by stalkers in the Wild North.

Scientists are still unable to find clear explanations for why some artifacts appear only in certain areas. Of particular interest is the significant enhancement of anomalous properties, which has a general correlation with the distance from the Zones boundaries. Such observations have become the foundation for the theory of the Epicenter.

Experienced stalkers dwelling on the Zones frontier, seeking paths to new territories, occasionally bring back previously unseen artifacts from their trips. According to Curie, such stalkers can host feasts for a week with the money that Research Institute 7 offers in exchange for such rarities.
g34p.description_zh:
潜行者在狂野北方发现的一种奇特的生化性质异常构造体。

科学家至今无法明确解释为何某些神器仅出现在特定区域。特别令人关注的是，异常特性的显著增强与距特异区边界的距离存在普遍关联。这类观察结果已成为"震中"理论的基础。

栖息在特异区边缘、探寻通往新区域路径的经验丰富的潜行者，偶尔会在旅程中带回前所未见的神器。据居里说，这样的潜行者能用第七研究所为这些稀有物品提供的报酬大吃大喝一整周。

jkj4.description:
Many stalkers still believe that the uniqueness of Lemna lies in a successful attempt to create an artifact under laboratory conditions; however, this is nothing more than a tale spread by an enterprising trader to devalue the artifact.

 In reality, Lemna is intriguing for a more astonishing reason. Microscopy of the artifact conducted by Koyushevs group revealed unusual silicon formations whose structure resembles a primitive lipid layer.
jkj4.description_zh:
许多潜行者仍然认为，浮萍的独特性在于成功地在实验室条件下创造神器的尝试；然而，这只不过是一个精明的商人为了贬低该神器价值而传播的故事。

实际上，浮萍引人注目是出于一个更惊人的原因。科尤舍夫小组对该神器进行的显微观察揭示了不寻常的硅形成物，其结构类似于原始的脂质层。

qo59.description:
The artifact consists of several hollow, liquid-filled formations of organic nature. Among the greenish formations is cellular tissue with a unique structure that combines features of muscle and connective tissues.

 The periodic contractions of the sacs, scientists explain, are linked to the chaotic changes in the volume of the liquid. Such dynamic properties possibly arise from yet unexplained biological activity occurring within Gum.
qo59.description_zh:
该神器由几个中空的、充满液体的有机性质形成物组成。在绿色的形成物中，是具有独特结构的细胞组织，结合了肌肉和结缔组织的特征。

科学家解释说，囊的周期性收缩与液体体积的混乱变化有关。这种动态特性可能是由于神器中发生的尚未解释的生物活性所致。

5r5g.description:
Scientists who have worked with similar artifacts claim that the Ice Hedgehog is simply an ordinary Hedgehog that got into Discharge. Attempts to recreate the electrophysical artifact under controlled conditions, however, have never been successful.

 There are, nonetheless, more unusual hypotheses concerning the similarity of the artifacts. According to some of these theories, the appearance of various Hedgehogs is the result of colonies of unknown organisms, which use them as vessels, thus altering the artifact.
5r5g.description_zh:
研究过类似神器的科学家声称，冰刺猬只是一只普通的刺猬，它进入了放电。然而，在受控条件下重现电物理神器的尝试从未成功。

尽管如此，关于神器相似性还有更不寻常的假说。根据其中一些理论，各种刺猬的出现是未知生物群落的结果，它们将刺猬用作容器，从而改变了神器。

5rwq.description: The outward simplicity of Shard often deceives inexperienced stalkers, but among more experienced artifact hunters, it is highly valued. The secret lies in its unique structure—an almost perfectly smooth surface of Shard, without irregularities even at the atomic level.
5rwq.description_zh: 月华表面的简单外观常常欺骗没有经验的潜行者，但在更有经验的神器猎手中，它备受推崇。秘密在于其独特的结构——月华几乎完美光滑的表面，即使在原子水平上也没有不平整。

gyq5.description:
The unusually precise shape of the Spiral draws the interest of many stalkers and spawns numerous myths about the artifact.

 For instance, diggers, while verifying one of the legends, discovered that when buried underground, the Spiral slowly twists itself, rising to the surface.

 Based on these experiments, some scientists conclude that the artifact is originally formed in the soil under the influence of Stasis, after which it digs itself up to the surface.
gyq5.description_zh:
螺旋极其精确的形状吸引了许多潜行者的兴趣，并催生了许多关于该神器的神话。

例如，挖掘者在验证其中一个传说时发现，当埋在地下时，螺旋会自行缓慢扭转，上升到地表。

基于这些实验，一些科学家得出结论，该神器最初是在静态的影响下在土壤中形成的，之后自行挖掘到地表。

kqr0.description:
Helium externally resembles Disintegrator enclosed in a solid, transparent shell.

 Some researchers believe there is a clear connection between the two artifacts, calling Helium a more stable case of the Disintegrator artifactogenesis. However, aside from the external similarity, no other evidence of this hypothesis has been found.
kqr0.description_zh:
氦外观类似于封闭在固体透明外壳中的粉碎机。

一些研究人员认为这两种神器之间存在明确的联系，称氦气是粉碎机神创发生的更稳定情况。然而，除了外观相似之外，尚未发现该假说的任何其他证据。

kqp0.description:
It is evident that the Firebird has an organic origin and consists predominantly of wood. However, all attempts by Research Institute 7 to study the material have been unsuccessful, as the artifact ignites and burns to ashes within seconds when even slightly damaged.

 In foreign markets, it is most commonly sold under the name Phoenix.
kqp0.description_zh:
显然，火鸟具有有机起源，主要由木材构成。然而，第7研究所研究该材料的所有尝试都未成功，因为该神器在即使轻微受损时也会点燃并在几秒钟内烧成灰烬。

在外国市场上，它最常以凤凰之名出售。

wgvd.description:
An anomalous formation resembling something between a clump of earth and a tangle of roots. In fact, it appears to be of a vegetative nature, judging by the artifacts structure.

The dense dark pouches, which gave the artifact its name, are indeed filled with a liquid that resembles both ink and oil simultaneously. Although the solutions composition still raises questions among researchers, the bioactive substance is being used in the development of new drugs.
wgvd.description_zh:
一种异常形成物，介于土块和根团之间。事实上，根据该神器的结构判断，它似乎具有植物性质。

赋予该神器名称的致密黑色小袋确实充满了同时看起来像墨水和油的液体。尽管该溶液的成分仍在研究人员中引发疑问，但这种生物活性物质正在被用于开发新药。

zy7y.description:
A brown sphere covered with a layer of soft plant cells, topped with beak-like protrusions.

 Scientists theorize that the movement of the "beaks" and bioluminescence are fueled by chemosynthesis occurring inside the Hedgehog. The purpose of these contractions isnt entirely clear, but one theory suggests that the artifact uses this method to move in search of favorable conditions to grow into a full-fledged Fluff shoot.
zy7y.description_zh:
一个棕色的球体，覆盖着一层柔软的植物细胞，顶部有喙状突起。

科学家推测，“喙”的运动和生物发光是由刺猬内部发生的化学合成提供能量的。这些收缩的目的尚不完全清楚，但有一种理论认为，该神器利用这种方法移动以寻找有利条件，生长成完整的绒毛芽。

zyv9.description:
A resilient formation resembling silicon. Structural analysis of the Lollipop conducted at Research Institute 7 showed that the artifact mostly consists of biogenic deposits.

 The management of the research institute is periodically forced to resolve arising conflicts between the departments of biologists and artifactologists, both competing for samples for experiments.
zyv9.description_zh:
一种类似硅的弹性形成物。第7研究所对棒棒糖进行的结构分析显示，该神器主要由生物沉积物组成。

研究所的管理层不得不定期解决生物学家和神器学家部门之间出现的冲突，两者都争夺实验样本。

wg53.description:
Artifact, named for its external resemblance to the Bohr model of the atom. The visually observable rotation only adds points to the successful choice of name.

 However, scientists are little interested in this superficial resemblance. They are more intrigued by the unusual property of the artifacts fragments, which causes all its parts to try to return to their positions even when an attempt is made to separate them.

 A stalker who decides to stop the rotation of a part of Atom with his bare hands risks not only breaking bones but also receiving a puncture wound.
wg53.description_zh:
该神器因其与玻尔原子模型的外部相似性而得名。视觉上可观察到的旋转仅为这个成功选择的名称增添了色彩。

然而，科学家对这种表面相似性并不太感兴趣。他们更感兴趣的是该神器碎片的不寻常特性，该特性导致当试图将其部件分开时，其所有部件都试图回到原来的位置。

决定徒手阻止原子一部分旋转的潜行者，不仅面临骨折的风险，还可能受到穿刺伤。

9nvy.description:
Despite the fact that the Sponge always consists of three fragments, the most important of them is definitely the small quartz crystal at its center.

 What makes the Sponge—or rather its "core"—truly peculiar is that any attempt to separate the other parts causes them to disintegrate instantly, only to be replaced by small solid formations that gradually take the shape of the separated fragments.
9nvy.description_zh:
尽管海绵总是由三个碎片组成，但其中最重要的无疑是位于该神器中心的小石英晶体。

海绵，尤其是其“核心”的特殊性在于，当试图将其他部分与核心分离时，它们会瞬间瓦解，而在它们的位置上会出现小的固体形成物，随着时间的推移，这些形成物会呈现出先前分离碎片的形状。

gyg5.description:
The reddish resilient streaks resembling muscle tissue and the periodic movements of the artifact evoke a strong association with certain arthropods. Perhaps this is why many stalkers feel a strong aversion to the Shrimp.

 According to scientists in the artifactology department of Research Institute 7, the structure of the artifact is in many ways similar to that of Prima, which supports those who group these formations together.
gyg5.description_zh:
类似于肌肉组织的微红色弹性条纹以及该神器的周期性运动，强烈地让人联想到某些节肢动物。也许这就是为什么许多潜行者对虾有强烈的厌恶感。

根据第7研究所神器学部门科学家的说法，该神器的结构在很多方面类似于沙子的结构，这支持了那些将这些形成物归为一组的人。

wg62.description:
Just as there are tales about the unexplained properties of the Cursed Rose, White Rose also has unrecorded attributes, stories of which started from a Mercenary officer.

 Having been held captive by fanatics for a long time, he noticed that many recruiters and preachers of the Covenant try to carry one or two such artifacts, seemingly believing in the White Roses ability to lend persuasiveness to the wearers words.
wg62.description_zh:
就像有关诅咒玫瑰无法解释的特性有故事一样，白玫瑰也有未记录的属性，这些故事始于一位佣兵军官。

他被狂热分子俘虏了很长时间，注意到许多契约的招募者和传教士都试图携带一两个这样的神器，似乎相信白玫瑰能够赋予佩戴者的话语说服力。

wgzd.description:
Despite the not-so-euphonious nickname among stalkers, the artifact was eventually given the name Frame by scientists at Research Institute 7.

 The structure of the artifact, reminiscent to some of bone tissue and dried tendons binding the parts of Frame, maintains not only constant movement but also always strives to sustain one specific rhythm. Moreover, with several Frames present, their movements will stabilize, and soon all artifacts will stick to a single rhythm.
wgzd.description_zh:
尽管潜行者中有一个不那么悦耳的绰号，但该神器最终被第7研究所的科学家命名为骨架。

该神器的结构，让一些人联想到骨组织和连接骨架各部分的干燥肌腱，不仅维持着持续的运动，而且总是力求维持一种特定的节奏。此外，当存在多个骨架时，它们的运动会稳定下来，很快所有神器都将遵循单一的节奏。

y5jk.description:
The spongy structure of the artifact, reminiscent of corresponding bone tissue, initially led researchers to the right idea about the nature of the Veiner. When the artifact came into the hands of the artifactology department of Research Institute 7, scientists were surprised not just by the similarity, but by the identical structure of the completely metallic artifact to the organic structure of spongy bone. Moreover, microscopy of samples confirmed the suspicion that molecules of various metals replicate the cellular structure of bone even at the minimal possible level.

 Although the artifact is entirely composed of various metals, the mass of Veiner is barely perceptible. According to scientists, this results from the artifacts structure.
y5jk.description_zh:
该神器的海绵状结构，让人联想到相应的骨组织，最初使研究人员对该神器的性质有了正确的想法。当该神器落入第7研究所神器学部门手中时，科学家们惊讶地发现，这种完全由金属构成的神器不仅在相似性上，而且在结构上竟与海绵骨的有机结构完全相同。此外，样本的显微镜观察证实了怀疑，即各种金属的分子甚至在最小可能的水平上复制了骨的细胞结构。

尽管该神器完全由各种金属构成，但静脉的质量几乎感觉不到。根据科学家的说法，这是由于该神器的结构造成的。

y5yw.description:
The similarity of the Dumbbell to the Kettlebell—formed in electrophysical anomalies—has long sparked debates within the artifactology department of Research Institute 7, as have the similarities between many other artifacts.

 Professor Cubov, head of the department, believes that most artifacts gravitate towards certain universal structures. However, his colleagues counter this by pointing to unique artifacts as evidence that this is not a matter of "universality" but rather of greater structural stability.

 Meanwhile, the artifact itself, similar to the Kettlebell, consists of ferromagnetic materials.
y5yw.description_zh:
哑铃与在电物理异象中形成的壶铃的相似性，就像许多其他神器之间的相似性一样，长期以来在第7研究所神器学部门内部引发了争论。

该部门负责人库博夫教授认为，存在一些大多数神器都倾向于的通用结构。然而，他的同事们通过引用独特的神器来反驳这一点。他们认为，这表明问题不在于“通用性”，而在于结构的更大稳定性。

与此同时，该神器本身，类似于壶铃，由铁磁体构成。

zyly.description:
The Onion, named for its partial resemblance to a common onion bulb, has drawn the attention of scientists studying the Zones flora and fauna. Structural analysis of the artifact reveals that a significant portion of it consists of living cells with characteristics of four biological kingdoms simultaneously.

 Professor Salanchak, who is studying the issue, warns that such an anomalous combination of properties could pose a potential threat to all existing species of living organisms. He also notes that the only factor keeping this "new kingdom" in check is the rapid death of such cells outside the Zone.
zyly.description_zh:
洋葱，因其部分类似于普通洋葱球茎而得名，引起了研究区域动植物群的科学家的兴趣。根据对该神器结构的研究，很大一部分由具有四个界同时特征的活细胞组成。

研究该问题的萨兰恰克教授断言，这种异常的属性组合可能对所有现有物种构成潜在危险。他还指出，这种“新界”进一步传播的主要限制因素是此类细胞在区域外的迅速死亡。

yq3o.description:
A biochemical artifact of rather unsightly appearance, resembling a coiled larva.

While scientists in the artifactology department express doubts about certain properties akin to a living organism found in the sample, some members of the flora and fauna study department believe it to be a larva of an unknown underground mutant in a state of anabiosis, which nonetheless doesnt explain the artifacts anomalous properties.

Superstitious stalkers prefer not to handle Larva with bare hands. According to some rumors, after such contact, clusters of small holes resembling lotus seeds may appear on the skin.
yq3o.description_zh:
一种外观相当难看的生化神器，类似于一条盘绕的幼虫。

虽然神器学部门的科学家对样本中发现的某些类似于生物体的特性表示怀疑，但一些动植物研究部门的成员认为，这是一种未知的地下变异生物的幼虫，处于滞育状态，但这并不能解释该神器的异常特性。

迷信的潜行者不喜欢徒手处理幼虫。根据一些传言，在此类接触后，皮肤上可能会出现类似于莲蓬子的小孔簇。

zjzn.description:
The deceptive artifact, known to stalkers as Timber, initially appears to be an ordinary piece of wood. However, scientists from the artifactology department of Research Institute 7 discovered that it is composed of a previously unrecorded allotrope modification of carbon.

According to Professor Brusenko, studying this material could bring humanity closer to creating a space elevator if it can be synthesized on an industrial scale.

While scientists are still investigating the artifacts nature, stalkers have already found an unusual use for it. Timber continuously emits fume, which is perfect for smoking mutant meat.
zjzn.description_zh:
这种欺骗性的神器，被潜行者称为木材，最初看起来像一块普通的木头。然而，第7研究所神器学部门的科学家发现，它是由一种以前未记录的碳同素异形体变体构成的。

根据布鲁森科教授的说法，如果能在工业规模上合成这种材料，研究它可以使人类更接近制造太空电梯。

当科学家仍在研究该神器的性质时，潜行者已经为它找到了一个不寻常的用途。木材持续散发烟雾，非常适合熏制变异生物肉。

kqj3.description:
A small rounded formation resembling a snail shell. This peculiar shell, however, has little to do with living nature as it is entirely composed of copper.

 The liquid filling the tubes cavity interests scientists the most. Despite the complete hermetic sealing of the shell, the solution periodically seeps out. According to Professor Naumenko, the internal content of the artifact exhibits superfluid properties under normal conditions, a phenomenon that entirely contradicts conventional physical laws.
kqj3.description_zh:
一种小的圆形形成物，类似于蜗牛壳。然而，这种特殊的壳与自然界生物关系不大，因为它完全由铜构成。

填充管子腔体的液体最令科学家感兴趣。尽管外壳完全密封，但溶液会定期渗出。根据瑙缅科教授的说法，在正常情况下，神器的内部内容物表现出超流体特性，这种现象完全违背了常规物理定律。

y5w3.description:
Many scientists from Research Institute 7 are still trying to understand how Prism is formed.

 Although at first glance the artifact appears to be a simple geometric object made of translucent material, its internal structure has tiny facets that are almost imperceptible to the naked eye.

 Thanks to this unique cutting, Prism refracts light rays multiple times, creating a captivating play of light.
y5w3.description_zh:
第7研究所的许多科学家仍在试图理解棱镜是如何形成的。

尽管乍一看该神器看起来像是由透明材料制成的简单几何物体，但其内部结构具有几乎肉眼看不见的微小刻面。

由于这种独特的切割，棱镜多次折射光线，创造了迷人的光影游戏。

gyv6.description:
A gravitational artifact classified by Research Institute 7 into a separate group of "roses" based on its appearance. Like other members of the group, this artifact exhibits unusual behavior—its "petals" tremble chaotically.
Stalkers claim to have seen "roses" in bright red, green, and even yellow, but theres no reliable confirmation of the existence of other artifacts besides the three documented representatives of the group.
gyv6.description_zh:
一种引力神器，被第7研究所归类为单独的“玫瑰”组，因其相似的外观。与组中的其他形成物一样，该神器表现出不寻常的行为，表现为其“花瓣”的混乱颤抖。
潜行者声称见过亮红色、绿色甚至黄色的“玫瑰”，但除了该组三个有记录的代表之外，没有其他神器存在的可靠证实。

ljrj.description:
Despite its name, Radiator can do much more than just heat the surrounding air.

 The artifact effect can significantly stabilize the surrounding space. Scientists from Research Institute 7 believe that this occurs due to the barely noticeable movement of the plates that form Radiator, although they cannot fully explain the connection between these processes.
ljrj.description_zh:
尽管其名称如此，散热器能做的远不止加热周围的空气。

该神器的效应可以显著稳定周围空间。第7研究所的科学家认为，这是由于构成散热器的板片的几乎难以察觉的运动造成的，尽管他们无法完全解释这些过程之间的联系。

kqgy.description:
The department of advanced developments at Research Institute 7 is very interested in the substance forming Bracelet. According to Professor Orlov, the head of the department, the ability to synthesize such a material would greatly facilitate work on magnetic cushions for transport and other similar projects.

 Unfortunately for the entire department leading the project, the only result of analyzing the structure of the substance was the realization that the formation of such crystal lattices is impossible within the framework of conventional physics.
kqgy.description_zh:
第7研究所先进发展部门对构成手镯的物质非常感兴趣。根据该部门负责人奥尔洛夫教授的说法，合成这种材料的能力将极大地促进运输用磁悬浮垫和其他类似项目的工作。

对整个领导该项目的部门来说不幸的是，分析该物质结构的唯一结果是认识到，在常规物理框架内不可能形成这样的晶格。

zyo9.description:
The mysterious composition and structure of Swamp Rot raise many questions for scientists due to its adsorptive properties. Trials of Swamp Rot-based drugs on rats at Research Institute 7, conducted by the department of advanced developments, showed results that significantly surpass even the latest generation of absorbents. However, due to the short shelf life outside special chambers, the preparation did not advance beyond an experimental sample.

 Nevertheless, stalkers are most interested in whether the artifact is made of stone, which somehow became wood, or if its an ordinary petrified piece of wood.
zyo9.description_zh:
沼泽腐殖质的神秘成分和结构由于其吸附特性而给科学家带来了许多问题。第7研究所先进发展部门在老鼠身上进行的基于沼泽腐殖质的药物试验显示，其结果甚至显著超过了最新一代的吸收剂。然而，由于在特殊容器外的保质期短，该制剂未能超越实验样品阶段。

尽管如此，潜行者最感兴趣的是该神器是由石头制成的，石头不知何故变成了木头，还是它只是一块普通的石化木头。

4l7p.description:
An artifact of a stony nature, in which oxides of various metals have crystallized and formed in an unknown manner.

 Attempts to extract the crystals from the rock lead to the destruction of the entire lode, which, however, self-restores after some time.
4l7p.description_zh:
一种石质性质的神器，其中各种金属的氧化物以未知的方式结晶并形成。

试图从岩石中提取晶体会导致整个矿脉的破坏，然而，一段时间后它会自我恢复。

gyln.description:
Like many artifacts from Blizzard, Frost is partially composed of ice; however, an interesting feature is the small crystals growing on the surface of the icy crust. At first glance, they resemble ordinary ice crystals, but in reality, their composition still raises questions among scientists due to their extraordinary plasticity.

 Professor Cubov suggests that insoluble metals and salts in normal conditions are involved in the formation of the artifact, which explains the physical properties of Frost.
gyln.description_zh:
与暴风雪中的许多神器一样，冰霜部分由冰组成；然而，一个有趣的特征是生长在冰壳表面的小晶体。乍一看，它们像普通的冰晶，但实际上，由于其非凡的塑性，它们的成分仍在科学家中引发疑问。

库博夫教授认为，在正常情况下不溶的金属和盐类参与了该神器的形成，这解释了冰霜的物理特性。

jkml.description:
An unusual phase of ice known as Ice An, found in the artifacts central element, is believed by independent scientists to be the cause of the Eye of the Storms extraordinary properties.

 Nonetheless, researchers from Research Institute 7 propose that the matter lies in the special structure of the artifact, which not only allows for the formation of an unusual crystalline ice lattice but also acts as a catalyst for various nearby reactions.
jkml.description_zh:
在神器中央元素的成分中发现的一种不寻常的冰相，称为An冰，根据独立科学家的说法，是风暴之眼不寻常特性的原因。

尽管如此，第7研究所的研究人员提出，问题在于该神器的特殊结构，它不仅允许形成不寻常的冰晶格，而且还充当了附近各种反应的催化剂。

1kdg.description:
While Sticky Bur is outwardly very similar to its common version, its internal structure is significantly different.

 Being a sporangium, the artifact demonstrates an alternative way of Fluff reproduction, which may indicate the presence of features of both lower and higher plants in the anomalous flora.
1kdg.description_zh:
虽然粘性刺果外观上与它的普通版本非常相似，但其内部结构有显著不同。

作为一个孢子囊，该神器展示了绒毛繁殖的另一种方式，这可能表明异常植物中同时具有低等植物和高等植物的特征。

y54z.description:
Inexperienced stalkers often mistake an exotic finding for an unknown living organism due to its bizarre appearance. The artifact consists of two parts connected by moving appendages and a greenish growth.

 However, according to the latest scientific research, such an unusual appearance is due to the reaction of ferromagnetic materials, which the artifact is partially composed of.
y54z.description_zh:
没有经验的潜行者常常因其怪异的外观而将奇特的发现误认为未知生物体。该神器由两部分组成，通过活动的附属物和一个绿色的生长物连接。

然而，根据最新的科学研究，这种不寻常的外观是由于铁磁材料的反应所致，该神器部分由这种材料组成。

1k4q.description:
An artifact resembling a piece of lard with streaks of meat running through it. Best not to take a bite—the Lard is composed entirely of a solid mineral containing various metals.

 As with the Berry, the artifacts unusual appearance is the cause of many rumors, though its composition tells a different story.

 Another interesting feature of the artifact is that, according to Professor Cubov, replicating such a molecular structure under laboratory conditions is physically impossible.
1k4q.description_zh:
该神器外观类似于一块带有肉纹的猪油。不值得去咬——猪油完全由固体矿物组成，其中包括各种金属。

与浆果一样，该神器不寻常的外观是许多谣言的原因，但猪油的成分清楚地表明了相反的情况。

该神器的一个有趣特征是，根据库博夫教授的说法，在实验室条件下创造这样的分子结构在物理上是不可能的。

gypg.description:
Many stalkers believe that the anomalous formation literally appears due to some fruit falling into Blender, but the occurrence of the artifact even in anomalies remote from any vegetation significantly undermines this hypothesis.

 The artifactology department of the Research Institute 7 believes that the emergence of the Embryo may result from an unspecified impact of the anomaly on endemic microorganisms found in the soil or atmosphere of the CEZ.
gypg.description_zh:
许多潜行者认为，这种异常形成物确实是由于某个水果落入搅拌机而产生的，但即使在远离任何植被的异象中出现该神器，也极大地削弱了这一假说。

第7研究所神器学部门认为，胚胎的出现可能是异象对在CEZ的土壤或大气中发现的特定内生微生物的某种未明确影响的结果。

9n7z.description:
One of the rarest artifacts of the Inside Out.

 According to stalker tales, whoever manages to obtain the Rubik will always be lucky on their outings. Those who do not believe in the tale find a simple explanation for this "luck"—the Rubik boasts an exceptionally diverse range of useful properties, making it a good fit for numerous builds.

 Like some other Inside Out artifacts, it has no known direct parent artifact or analogue found anywhere in the regular Zone. However, many stalkers, fond of speculating on popular topics or pitching their genius ideas to scientists, claim that the Rubik might be some kind of hybrid of the Polyhedron and Atom.
9n7z.description_zh:
inside极其稀有的神器之一。

根据一些潜行者的故事，任何设法获得魔方的人将总是在他们的外出中走运。那些不相信这个故事的人为这种“好运”找到了一个简单的解释——魔方所表现出的有用特性范围极其多样，使其能够在众多组合中使用。

与inside的一些其他神器一样，它没有已知的直接母体神器或可以在常规区域找到的类似物。然而，许多喜欢推测流行趋势或将他们的天才想法卖给科学家的潜行者声称，魔方可能是多面体和原子的某种混合物。

5rzo.description:
According to scientists from Research Institute 7, most of the features of Rime are related to the properties that emerge when the artifact comes into contact with certain metals. However, the mechanism behind the emergence of these properties remains unknown.

 The artifacts unusual plasticity and conductivity were intended to be utilized in the production of superconductors. However, production was halted due to the inability to preserve the artifacts properties over an extended period.
5rzo.description_zh:
根据第7研究所科学家的说法，霜花的大部分特性与该神器与某些金属接触时出现的特性有关。然而，这些特性出现的机制仍然未知。

该神器不寻常的塑性和导电性本打算用于超导体的生产。然而，由于无法长期保存神器的特性，生产停止了。

y5k0.description:
An unusual artifact of Blizzard, named for its characteristic shape and constant rotation around its axis.

 According to reports from some researchers, Whirlwind is actually a liquid with unusual properties, enclosed in a thin transparent shell. Because the rupture of the vessel leads to the instant evaporation of the mysterious liquid, the reasons for the artifacts constant motion have not yet been determined.
y5k0.description_zh:
暴风雪的一种不寻常的神器，因其特征形状和围绕其轴的恒定旋转而得名。

根据一些研究人员的报告，旋风实际上是一种具有不寻常特性的液体，被封闭在一个薄薄的透明外壳中。由于容器的破裂会导致神秘液体瞬间蒸发，该神器持续运动的原因尚未确定。

k3yv.description:
A trophy artifact obtained from battles with Murmur.
The object presents a spiral-shaped hard structure of unknown anomalous origin, covered with organic cells related to the fungus kingdom.
Upon skin contact, it grows thin white threads resembling mycelium, covered with microscopic villi, which envelop the limb or contact area. The invasive nature of the effect is not confirmed.
k3yv.description_zh:
在与低语者战斗中获得的战利品神器。
该物体呈现一种螺旋状坚硬的未知异常起源结构，覆盖着与真菌界相关的有机细胞。
与皮肤接触时，它会长出细小的白色线状物，类似于菌丝，覆盖着微观绒毛，包裹肢体或接触区域。尚未证实其侵入性。

qoq6.description:
The artifact is a molten material of unknown origin that surrounds a noticeably colder core.

 The sphere is covered with a very thin gravitational field that maintains its shape and prevents its contents from spilling out, while also stopping scientists from getting inside.
qoq6.description_zh:
该神器是一种熔化的未知起源材料，包围着一个明显较冷的核心。

球体覆盖着一层非常薄的引力场，维持其形状并防止其内容物溢出，同时也阻止了科学家进入其内部。

wglp.description:
An organic artifact, covered with numerous spherical formations containing a sticky, biologically active liquid.

 Someone from the inhabitants of the Zone tried to give it an alternative name, Helminth, but it didnt stick—the stalkers didnt think it was the best idea to carry an artifact with a name like that in their set.
wglp.description_zh:
一种有机性质的神器，覆盖着众多含有粘性生物活性液体的球形形成物。

区域的一位居民曾试图给它一个替代名称蠕虫，但没叫开——潜行者认为携带一个有这样名字的神器不是一个好主意。

wgwz.description:
The Fahrenheit is quite unremarkable in appearance, but its internal structure raises many questions about its formation process.

 The fact that it is composed entirely of distilled water and tiny air bubbles supports the hypothesis that impurities are "pushed out" and replaced with air when the artifact forms.
wgwz.description_zh:
华氏度乍一看相对普通；然而，该神器的结构对其形成过程提出了许多疑问。

蒸馏水和完全构成华氏度的微小气泡的存在支持了杂质“置换”及其在神器形成时被空气取代的假说。

4l1r.description:
Like Onion, this artifact consists of various living cells that can be attributed to almost every kingdom. Botanists studying the Zones vegetation believe that the Proto-Onion might be a kind of fruit, whereas the regular Onion is more like a seed. At the same time, zoologists think that the artifact might represent the larval stage of some animals development.

 Unfortunately, for scientists struggling to understand the nature of these two artifacts, it has not been possible to determine whether they are alive to the extent understood before the Zones anomaly appeared, due to the many discrepancies of their nature with classical biology.
4l1r.description_zh:
像洋葱一样，该神器由各种活细胞组成，几乎可以归属于每个界。研究区域植被的植物学家认为，原洋葱可能是一种水果，而普通洋葱更像是一粒种子。与此同时，动物学家认为，该神器可能代表了某种动物发育的幼虫阶段。

不幸的是，对于那些试图理解这两种神器性质的科学家来说，由于它们的性质与经典生物学存在许多差异，无法确定它们在区域异常出现之前所理解的程度上是否具有生命。

5r34.description:
The artifact got its name because of its distinctive behavior. Heart periodically contracts and expands, leading to the stretching of the semi-transparent material stretched between its vertical formations.

Stalkers noticed a long time ago that the artifact starts pulsing in sync with the heartbeat of the nearest person. They use this property to detect adversaries. However, scientists are still unable to explain why this artifact possesses such an unusual property.
5r34.description_zh:
该神器因其独特的行为而得名。心脏周期性地收缩和扩张，导致其垂直形成物之间拉伸的半透明材料被拉伸。

潜行者很早就注意到，该神器开始与最近的人的心跳同步脉动。他们利用这一特性来检测对手。然而，科学家仍无法解释为什么该神器具有如此不寻常的特性。

1k96.description:
A representative of the family of electrophysical artifacts, named for the characteristic sound emitted by an anomalous formation.

 Among stalkers, there are tales that someone managed to pull apart the two parts of the Rattle, but no confirmations of these stories have been recorded.
1k96.description_zh:
电物理神器家族的代表，以其异常形成物发出的特征声音命名。

在潜行者中，有传言说有人设法将拨浪鼓的两个部分分开，但尚未记录到这些故事的确证。

5rpq.description:
Amberite is one of the artifacts whose properties should not only aid in developing innovative devices but also in understanding the fundamental principles of physics.

 As stated by Professor Naumenko, the effect of local gravitational shielding demonstrated by the artifact suggests already that existing physics models require significant revision.
5rpq.description_zh:
琥珀是那些特性不仅应有助于开发创新设备，而且有助于理解物理学基本原理的神器之一。

正如瑙缅科教授所说，该神器所展示的局部引力屏蔽效应表明，现有的物理模型需要进行重大修订。

zypm.description:
According to Professor Koyushev, head of the Zone flora and fauna department at Research Institute 7, the nearly identical structure of the Golden Prima and its "ordinary version" may be explained by the mechanism of anhydrobiosis. Such a survival strategy in extreme conditions might indicate a connection between Prima and invertebrates.

 Meanwhile, the artifactology department is highly skeptical of this opinion, arguing that the presence of cells in the structure of Primas may only indicate components involved in artifactogenesis.
zypm.description_zh:
金沙子与其“普通版本”接近百分之百的相似性，根据第7研究所区域动植物部门负责人科尤舍夫教授的说法，可能可以用脱水休眠机制来解释。这种在极端条件下的生存策略可能表明沙子与无脊椎动物之间存在联系。

与此同时，神器学部门对此观点持高度怀疑态度，认为沙子结构中存在细胞可能仅表明参与了神创发生的成分。

gy10.description:
A crystal with a matte surface. Like other similar artifacts, it has a precise number of large and small extensions.

 Experiments at Research Institute 7 revealed that the Red Crystal has another feature that distinguishes it from other "crystals." Under extreme cold and high atmospheric pressure, small cracks begin to form across parts of the crystals surface, settling into a regular hexagonal honeycomb pattern. This effect is likely caused by localized silicon inclusions.
gy10.description_zh:
一种具有磨砂表面的晶体。与其他类似神器一样，它具有精确数量的大大小小的延伸物。

由于第7研究所的实验，发现红晶具有区别于其他“晶体”的另一个特征。在极低温和高大气压的影响下，晶体的某些区域表面开始出现小裂缝，形成规则的六角形网格。这种效应可能是由于硅的局部夹杂物造成的。

9nd0.description:
A semi-transparent blue crystal formed in Discharge anomaly.

 The scientists from Research Institute 7 who studied the artifact never reached a definitive conclusion regarding its chemical composition. Most samples of the Spectral Crystal showed significant differences in their composition.
9nd0.description_zh:
在放电异象中形成的半透明蓝色晶体。

研究该神器的第7研究所科学家从未就其化学成分达成明确结论。电水晶的大多数样本在组成上显示出显著差异。

wg3p.description:
An unusual electrophysical artifact resembling ball lightning. However, unlike this uncommon phenomenon, Disintegrator is quite inert and shows no activity outside of a strong electromagnetic field, which facilitates the manifestation of the artifacts shielding properties.

 The natural discharges generated by Disintegrator can affect processes occurring in the body. Scientists studying the mechanisms of the artifacts activity have not yet been able to reach a conclusion about the principles of this effect.
wg3p.description_zh:
一种不寻常的电物理神器，类似于球状闪电。然而，与这种不常见的现象不同，粉碎机相当惰性，在强电磁场外不显示任何活性，而强电磁场有助于神器屏蔽特性的显现。

粉碎机产生的自然放电会影响体内发生的过程。研究神器活性机制的科学家尚未能就这种影响的原理得出结论。

7z77.description:
An anomalous formation resembling a jelly-like blob of slime.

Although the artifact constantly produces new "droplets" that make up its mass, its volume does not decrease.

Scientists explain this phenomenon by the artifacts unusual ability to condense water from the air and attract heavier particles in the atmosphere, allowing the substance to form.

The droplets themselves disappear half a second after coming into contact with a surface. Attempts to catch and hold even a single droplet have been unsuccessful.
7z77.description_zh:
一种类似果冻状粘液团的异常构造。

尽管该神器不断产生构成其本体的新“液滴”，但其体积并未因此减小。

科学家将这一现象解释为神器的特殊能力：它能从空气中凝聚水汽，并吸引大气中较重的微粒，从而使自身物质得以形成。

这些液滴在接触表面半秒后便会消失。试图捕获并保存哪怕一滴的努力均告失败。

4lrn.description:
A unique Inside Out artifact of the same nature as the Tiny Key, with no analogues or progenitors in the Zone. Its recognizable shape comes from the fractal influence of Distortion on artifactogenesis. Named after a metal found outside the Zone.

 Unlike its "relative" in structure, it distorts the quantum state of time at the cellular level, altering metabolic functions and neuron reactions—while also affecting tissue "fatigue."

 Likewise, metabolic activity increases in bacteria accumulating on the skin, mucous membranes, and equipment. It is recommended to use the artifact after disinfection or a shower.
4lrn.description_zh:
一种独特的inside神器，与小钥匙性质相同。它在区域中没有类似物或母体。由于其形状是神创发生过程中扭曲的分形影响所致，因此具有可识别的形状。以区域外发现的金属命名。

与其结构上的“亲戚”不同，它扭曲了身体细胞的量子时间状态，改变代谢功能和神经元反应，但影响组织的“疲劳度”。

积聚在皮肤、粘膜和装备上的细菌的代谢功能也会增加。建议在使用神器前进行消毒或淋浴。

gyn0.description:
The Comet is one of those artifacts that creates a false first impression. Its semi-transparent polymer extension is often mistaken by everymen for a spark.

 The most interesting aspect of the Comet is its composite structure. Experiments revealed that when the branched base and the polymer extension are separated, the artifact not only begins to quickly lose its properties, but also rapidly deforms into an amorphous mass of plastic with metal inclusions.
gyn0.description_zh:
彗星可以被描述为那些制造第一印象错觉的神器之一。一种常被外行人误认为火花的半透明聚合物延伸物。

彗星最有趣的方面是神器的复合结构。对该形成的实验揭示，当分支基座和聚合物延伸物分离时，神器不仅开始迅速失去其特性，还会迅速变形为一种由塑料和金属夹杂物构成的无定形结构。

rn1z.description:
Like the artifacts that emerge during the anomalous winter Blizzards, the Opal is composed of altered ice whose molecular structure has been distorted by anomalous influence.

The Opals most distinctive characteristic, and one of particular interest to scientists, is the way it refracts light, producing a peculiar shimmering ripple across its surface. Research conducted by the Institutes Department of Flora and Fauna has confirmed that these fluctuations of light can exert a hypnotic effect on most organisms possessing a complex higher nervous system. Moreover, the pattern of the shimmering changes depending on the living organism observing it.
rn1z.description_zh:
如同异常冬季暴风雪期间出现的神器一样，这颗蛋白石由受异常影响而分子结构扭曲的变异冰构成。

蛋白石最显著的特征，也是科学家们特别感兴趣的一点，在于它折射光线的方式，会在其表面产生一种奇异的闪烁波纹。研究所动植物系进行的研究已证实，这些光线的波动能对大多数拥有复杂高级神经系统的生物产生催眠效果。此外，闪烁波纹的图案会随观察它的生物不同而变化。

4lml.description:
Researchers believe that Snake Eye might be a representative of terrestrial coral polyps, but if this theory is correct, the question of how the polyp ended up so far from the nearest saltwater body remains unresolved.

 The solid formation, which at first glance resembles a stone, feels more like the surface of a seashell. Structural analysis shows a high calcium content in its composition.
4lml.description_zh:
研究人员认为，蛇眼可能是陆地珊瑚虫的代表，但如果这一理论是正确的，那么关于这种珊瑚虫如何远离最近的咸水体的问题仍然没有解决。

乍一看像石头的固体形成物，摸起来更像贝壳的表面。结构分析显示其成分中含有高钙。

zyqk.description: According to some scientists, the formation process of the Leaded Glass is very similar to that of another thermal artifact, the Scallop. Other researchers highlight the similarity of its crystals to those of the Frost. However, neither similarity explains the absorption properties of the crystals—a trait found in neither of these artifacts.
zyqk.description_zh: 根据一些科学家的说法，形成冬雪莲的过程与另一种热神器扇贝的形成过程非常相似。其他研究人员则强调该晶体与冰霜晶体的相似性。然而，任何一种相似性都无法解释这些晶体所表现出的吸收特性，而这些特性在任何一种神器中都没有表现出来。

zymn.description:
An object consisting of organic growths on the terminal side and a completely solid body base. Its appearance clearly indicates that the basic structure is inherited from Lard artifact. The material has the properties of both the crystalline growths of the Inside Out and the anomalous structures of the CEZ.

 It can absorb excess heat, causing light radiation that positively affects cell division.

 Upon contact with a high-voltage electromagnetic field, it forms a field that destroys cell membranes.
zymn.description_zh:
一个物体，由终端的有机生长物和一个完全坚固的物体基础组成。其外观清楚地表明，基本结构继承自猪油神器。该材料兼具inside的晶体生长物和CEZ异常结构的特性。

它可以吸收多余的热量，产生对细胞分裂有积极影响的可见光辐射。

当接触高压电磁场时，它会形成一个破坏细胞膜的场。

gy7p.description:
Despite its stone base and solid horn-like tissue growths, it has a completely organic origin, as its progenitor is Snake Eye, found in the CEZ.

 Essentially, it represents a distorted version of some organism feeding on bacterial and toxic environments.

 It releases a polyhormonal composition into the carriers blood, fully compatible with the body. When exposed to high temperatures, the composition loses its stability.

 An increased background of accompanying neurotransmitters slightly lowers neuronal resistance.
gy7p.description_zh:
尽管其基础是石头并且有坚硬的角状组织生长物，但它完全是有机起源的，因为它的母体是在CEZ中找到的蛇眼。

本质上，它代表了一种以细菌和有毒环境为食的某种生物的扭曲版本。

它将一种多激素组合物释放到携带者的血液中，与身体完全兼容。当暴露于高温时，该组合物失去其稳定性。

伴随的神经递质背景增加，轻微降低了神经元的抵抗力。

jky6.description:
The artifact resembles a smooth stone covered in long tendrils connecting eye-shaped growths—crystalline formations characteristic of the Inside Out. It takes its name from its CEZ ancestor, the Berry, as though it had been dried down to a hard, wrinkled state. Do not add to pilaf!

 The fine fibers covering the tendrils generate an energy field that affects neural conductivity. It is said that one should not stare at the eye-shaped growths for too long, or else one might "get stuck" for good, with no way out without outside help.

 A stalker without a theoretical background might mistake it for a Gum.
jky6.description_zh:
该神器类似于一块光滑的石头，上面覆盖着长长的卷须，连接着眼状生长物，这是inside的特征性晶体形成物。它因其CEZ祖先神器浆果而得名，浆果被干燥成坚硬起皱的状态。不要加入抓饭！

覆盖卷须的细纤维产生一个能量场，影响神经连接的传导性。据说，盯着眼状生长物看太久是不明智的，否则可能会在没有外部帮助的情况下永远“卡住”。

没有理论背景的潜行者可能会误认为是口香糖。

kq4v.description:
A fossilized and altered version of the Viburnum Branch artifact that can be found in the CEZ, but overgrown with crystalline formations characteristic of the Inside Out.

 It forms a psyonic field that distorts atomic forces in water hydride molecules, thereby changing the hydraulic capability of body fluids. A side effect is a mild hand tremor. It has a light psionic background.

Its recommended to ignore strange images and visions at the edge of your field of view.
kq4v.description_zh:
可以在CEZ中找到的妈链神器的化石和改变版本，但长满了inside的特征性晶体形成物。

它形成一个心灵感应场，扭曲水氢化物分子中的原子力，从而改变体液的液压能力。副作用是轻微的手部颤抖。具有轻微的心灵感应背景。

建议忽略视野边缘出现的奇怪图像和幻觉。

1kw1.description:
A crystal formation that can be found in the Inside Out. It is a molecular reflection of the Red Crystal artifact, up to the position of atoms in the lattice.

 It absorbs known types of radiation, converting them into a weak gravitational field.

 When field integrity is violated, it forms waves that are deadly to organic tissues. For unclear reasons, it promotes the reproduction of pathogenic microorganisms.
1kw1.description_zh:
可以在inside找到的晶体形成物。它是红晶神器的分子镜像，直到晶格中的原子位置。

它吸收已知类型的辐射，将其转化为弱引力场。

当场完整性被破坏时，它形成对有机组织致命的波。原因不明，它促进了病原微生物的繁殖。

qodk.description:
A spherical object with small growths and crystalline inclusions, slightly soft to the touch. It takes its name from its CEZ progenitor—the Gum—as if someone blew it into a bubble.

 It affects the carriers gravitational field, distorting force vectors of objects entering its area of influence from outside. A stalker without a theoretical background might mistake it for a Berry.
qodk.description_zh:
一个球形物体，带有小的生长物和晶体内含物。触感略软。它因其来自CEZ的母体神器——口香糖而得名，口香糖似乎被吹成了泡泡。

它会影响携带者的引力场，扭曲从外部进入影响区域的物体的矢量信息。没有理论背景的潜行者可能会误认为它是浆果。

qo94.description:
The Chicken God, nicknamed for its peculiar shape, may not bring luck like its stone "relative," but it possesses other properties that baffle many scientists.

 For instance, while it outwardly resembles a cluster of hard ice crystals, it is actually an extremely elastic substance closer to rubber that engages in various reactions with organic materials.

 Despite frequently passing through the hands of scientists from Research Institute 7, the artifactology department is still unsure about how many reactions the artifact can undergo upon contact with organic matter.
qo94.description_zh:
鸡神，因其奇特的形状而得名，可能不像它的石头“亲戚”那样带来好运，但拥有许多令科学家困惑的其他特性。
例如，该神器外观类似于硬冰晶的生长物，但实际上是一种类似于橡胶的极富弹性的物质，会与有机材料发生各种反应。

尽管鸡神经常落入第7研究所科学家的手中，但神器学部门仍不确定该神器在与有机物接触时可以发生多少种反应。

4lkp.description:
An artifact, dubbed the Ilyich Lamp by scientists for its resemblance to a household incandescent lamp.

 Although this artifact looks like glass, its material actually has nothing to do with it. The semi-transparent shell covering part of the artifact is actually made of an organic substance that resembles bone tissue.
4lkp.description_zh:
一种神器，因其与家用白炽灯泡的相似性而被科学家昵称为伊里奇 灯泡。

尽管该神器看起来像玻璃，但其材料实际上与之无关。覆盖部分神器的半透明外壳实际上是由一种类似于骨组织的有机物质制成的。

5rm0.description:
A unique Inside Out artifact of the same nature as Bismuth. It has no analogues or progenitors in the Zone. It has its shape due to the fractal influence of Distortion on artifactogenesis.

 It affects the strength of molecular bonds of hydrogen oxide in the blood, altering the hydraulic characteristics of the liquid and the muscles contraction capability.

 Induces weak electron-proton emission.
5rm0.description_zh:
一种独特的inside神器，与铋性质相同。它在区域中没有类似物或母体。由于其形状是神创发生过程中扭曲的分形影响所致。

它影响血液中氢氧化物分子键的强度，改变液体的液压特性和肌肉的收缩能力。

诱发弱电子-质子发射。

zyrm.description:
According to scientists, one of the most interesting Stasis artifacts is the one described below.

 The material, externally resembling a hexagonal frame of ice, focuses photons at the center of the artifact, creating a bright glow.

 Scholars at Research Institute 7 believe that the further dispersion of this light creates the shielding effect for which the artifact is valued.
zyrm.description_zh:
根据科学家的说法，下面描述的是最有趣的静态神器之一。

这种材料外观类似于一个六边形的冰框，将光子聚焦在神器的中心，产生明亮的光。

第7研究所的学者认为，这种光的进一步分散创造了该神器因之而备受珍视的屏蔽效应。

zy32.description:
The unusual shape and behavior of Battery at rest attract the curiosity of many stalkers.

 At first glance, the movements of metal prongs of this artifact do not seem dangerous. However, many stalkers who have lost fingers due to Battery might not agree with this.
zy32.description_zh:
电池不寻常的形状和静止时的行为引起了许多潜行者的好奇。

乍一看，该神器金属尖头的运动似乎并不危险。然而，许多因电池而失去手指的潜行者可能不会同意这一点。

w4jo.description:
An artifact of stunning beauty, attracting the attention of both stalkers and collectors from the Mainland.

Although the anomalous formation visually almost perfectly resembles a black hole, investigations of the object within the walls of Research Institute 7 revealed none of the structural and internal properties characteristic of gravitational class artifacts.

According to Professor Brusenko, this confusion with classification may stem from a less than optimal understanding of the fundamental laws governing artifacts and anomalies.
w4jo.description_zh:
一种令人惊叹的美丽神器，吸引了潜行者和来自大陆的收藏家的注意。

尽管这种异常形成物在视觉上几乎完美地类似于黑洞，但在第7研究所内部对该物体的调查中，并未发现引力类神器的任何结构和内部特征。

根据布鲁森科教授的说法，这种分类上的混淆可能源于对支配神器和异象的基本规律的理解不够理想。

wgko.description:
Stone formation with sharp pseudo-carbon growths of high density. It is based on the structure of the Cursed Rose artifact found in the CEZ.

 It locally slows down the interaction of chronons in organic tissue fields, changing the elasticity and density of the latter. Due to this, cellular metabolism is disrupted under the artifacts influence.

 Prolonged use may cause itching, malaise, pale skin, and nausea.
wgko.description_zh:
具有高密度伪碳尖突的石质形成物。其基础是在CEZ中找到的诅咒玫瑰神器的结构。

它在局部减缓有机组织场中时间子的相互作用，改变后者的弹性和密度。因此，在该神器的影响下，细胞代谢受到干扰。

长期使用可能导致瘙痒、不适、皮肤苍白和恶心。

y5ro.description:
The artifact represents a formation frozen during the artifactogenesis of Crust due to the influence of Distortion.

 It significantly alters the configuration of gravitons, making the carrier possess their own gravitational field, which can conflict with the gravity of space.

 A stalker carrying several Eggs in his backpack had the misfortune to stumble and fatally crash from the height of his own stature.
y5ro.description_zh:
该神器代表了在神创发生过程中，由于扭曲的影响，外壳凝固的形成物。

它显著改变了引力子的配置，使携带者拥有自己的引力场，这可能与空间的引力相冲突。

一位背包里装着几个蛋的潜行者不幸绊倒，从自身的高度摔下，致命地撞击了地面。

y3pdo.description:
A trophy sight recovered from a fallen Murmur fighter. Damaged, functionality is incomplete.
Made from a polymer combining dense plastic and anomalous inclusions. Instead of glass, a transparent crystalline composite is used that—for reasons unknown—does not get contaminated by fine particles and water droplets.
Reticle: two side bars and a yellow dot.
y3pdo.description_zh:
在一名阵亡的低语战士身上发现的缴获瞄准镜样本。已损坏，功能不完整。
由结合致密塑料和异常内含物的聚合物制成。代替玻璃，使用了一种透明晶体复合材料，由于未知原因，不会被细小颗粒和水滴污染。
准星——两个侧边条和一个黄点。

m0gqr.description: ATTENTION: if you use a silencer, the enemy wont know where you are firing from.
m0gqr.description_zh: 在一名被杀的低语战士身上找到的缴获消音器。已损坏，功能不完整。消音器沿线的连接器用途不明，但武器工程师怀疑其内部包含一个声音逆变器，能在射击时产生反向声波，将枪声的矢量分量几乎降至零。

2o760.description:
Laser color: blue

Some masters in the Zone entertain themselves by reselling gear with minimal cosmetic changes. If you like it—why not?
2o760.description_zh:
激光颜色：蓝色

区域里有些行家就爱给装备做些表面改动，然后转手倒卖，图个乐子。你要是喜欢——何乐不为？

zzpdn.description:
Captured sight obtained from battles with Murmur.
According to particularly impressionable individuals, they had a feeling that the lens seemed to move and adjust for greater convenience. However, engineers attribute this to the ocular composite used in production.
Reticle: crosshair, yellow dot.
zzpdn.description_zh:
从与低语的战斗中获得的缴获瞄准镜。
据特别敏感的人说，他们感觉镜片似乎在移动和调整以获得更大的便利。然而，工程师将此归因于生产中使用的眼用复合材料。
准星：十字线，黄点。

5lvk0.description:
Captured sight obtained from battles with Murmur.
Some owners of this attachment claim that its much easier to hit the enemy with it, as if someone else is guiding where to aim the weapon. Whether Murmur technology is involved or its just self-suggestion remains an open question.
Reticle: yellow dot.
5lvk0.description_zh:
从与低语的战斗中获得的缴获瞄准镜。
一些此配件的拥有者声称，用它更容易击中敌人，就好像有人在引导武器瞄准哪里。是低语技术参与其中，还是仅仅是自我暗示，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。
准星：黄点。

dm2l5.description:
Laser color: red

A small Laser Target Designator originally designed specifically for the customized Glock from the same gear line. While its hard to say that it doesnt quite fit the style of the pistol, when used on other weapons, it clearly doesnt have the same effect.
Nevertheless, there were people interested in purchasing such a designator separately from the pistol. And as is known, the customers wish is the law.
dm2l5.description_zh:
激光颜色：红色

一个小型激光指示器，最初是为同一装备系列的定制格洛克专门设计的。虽然很难说它不完全符合手枪的风格，但在其他武器上使用时，显然效果不佳。
尽管如此，还是有人有兴趣单独购买这样的指示器，而不买手枪。众所周知，顾客的愿望就是法律。

qjwq9.description: ATTENTION: if you use a silencer, the enemy wont know where you are firing from.

3g7k5.description: A trophy sample of a grip found on a fallen Murmur fighter. Damaged, with incomplete functionality. Made from an alloy with added artifact materials. According to the engineering teams analysis, when fully operational, it can absorb a significant amount of horizontal recoil due to pseudo-organic "muscles" within the body.
3g7k5.description_zh: 在一名阵亡的低语战士身上发现的缴获握把样本。已损坏，功能不完整。由添加了神器材料的合金制成。根据工程团队的分析，当完全运作时，由于其体内的拟有机"肌肉"，可以吸收大量水平后坐力。

g4gw5.description:
Lightweight tactical grip, clearly inspired by similar models from Fortis.

Although the Baron doesnt particularly try to hide his fondness for copying others creations, the grip turned out surprisingly practical and comfortable, making it hard to even start discussing the theft of designs from others.
g4gw5.description_zh:
轻量化战术握把，明显受到Fortis类似型号的启发。

尽管男爵并没有特别试图掩饰他对抄袭他人作品的喜爱，但这握把出乎意料地实用和舒适，让人甚至很难开始讨论从他人那里窃取设计的问题。

p6l4d.description_zh: 型号: S432@可变倍瞄具，经由大师改装。颜值与战力兼备。

p6yq5.description: ATTENTION: if you use a silencer, the enemy wont know where you are firing from.
p6yq5.description_zh: 虽然一些潜行者认为黑市配件在质量上有点比不上标准配件，但区域的大多数居民并不反对定制装备，并且愿意支付溢价购买这种独特外观的配件。

vjl3g.description: As is known, the Baron is willing to sell even knitted socks if it brings in good money. Attachments were no exception, becoming part of the gear line released just before the winter of 2025.
vjl3g.description_zh: 众所周知，只要能带来好收入，男爵甚至愿意卖针织袜子。配件也不例外，成为了2025年冬季前夕发布的装备系列的一部分。

zzp6m.description:
Most of the attachments crafted by the Barons artisans are made from various blanks and billets also used in the creation of other weapon tuning elements.

So, unless youre trying to catch the Baron in another price inflation for his goods, its safe to say that they are quite worthwhile even without the distinctive design.
zzp6m.description_zh:
男爵工匠制作的大部分配件都是用各种坯料和毛坯制成的，这些坯料也用于制造其他武器改装部件。

所以，除非你试图抓住男爵又一次抬高他的商品价格，否则可以放心地说，即使没有独特的设计，它们也相当值得购买。

j52q4.description: ATTENTION: if you use a silencer, the enemy wont know where you are firing from.

okjw5.description: A sniper scope with variable magnification of 6-8x, used by Murmur shooters. It is designed for precise shooting at long distances. The sights construction is monoblock, with a sealed tube body filled with nitrogen to prevent fogging of the optics. It is also equipped with a system to protect adjustment drums from accidental shifts.
okjw5.description_zh: Murmur射手使用的6-8倍可变倍狙击镜。专为远距离精准射击设计。瞄准镜采用一体式结构，密封的管状机身充填氮气，可防止光学器件起雾。此外还配备调节旋钮保护系统，防止意外转动。

m0k5k.description: An optical sight with a magnification of 4-6x used by Murmur snipers. It is characterized by high reparability, durability under field conditions, and a clear reticle. Its main advantage is a robust all-metal body that withstands moisture, dirt, and harsh impacts.
m0k5k.description_zh: Murmur狙击手使用的4-6倍可变倍光学瞄准镜。其特点是易于维修、在野外条件下经久耐用，并配有清晰的分划板。它的主要优点在于坚固的全金属机身，能够防潮、防尘并承受剧烈冲击。
