knoz0.description: Half a mandarin is all a stalker needs in order to get half their recommended daily amount of vitamin C. Thats so convenient!
knoz0.description_zh: 半个橘子就是一个潜行者获取一半每日推荐维生素C所需的全部。这太方便了！

g07g.description: This liqueur has a rich anomalous flavor of the CEZ and a hint of mint.

5lz3g.description: Nothing bolsters ones will to survive like the sweet flesh of a mandarin.
5lz3g.description_zh: 没有什么比橘子的甜美果肉更能增强人的求生意志了。

j5mg7.description: The preferred drink of refined ladies and stalkers who never learned to drink vodka.
j5mg7.description_zh: 优雅女士和从未学会喝伏特加的潜行者们的首选饮品。

2dkm.description: Perfect for making hot dogs and other dishes.

vrwg.description: The most basic foundation for making alcohol. Ingesting it without processing leads to sharp disturbances in peristalsis.

1dwq.description: Ordinary wine tasting of spirits and tomorrows headache. Still tastes better than boxed wine.

dm1ln.description: A product traditionally used only once a year.

y3kyz.description: People in the Zone have decided to import high-quality ice cream in the middle of winter... Why not?
y3kyz.description_zh: 区域里的人决定在隆冬时节进口高品质冰淇淋……为什么不呢？

jm94.description: A Russian offensive impact fragmentation grenade.
jm94.description_zh: 俄罗斯进攻型碰炸破片手榴弹。

1ddr.description: Aromatic pulp from a contaminated zone, with a sweet undertone. Chewing it can cause a slight burning sensation on the tongue. Surprisingly effective at relieving light fatigue.

nvpw.description: A flash grenade produced in the Zone. It is popular due to its price and lightness, and it allows you to scare small mutants.
nvpw.description_zh: 一款在特异区生产的闪光弹。由于其价格和轻便性而受欢迎，它允许你吓唬小型变异体。

y391o.description: This sausage definitely contains meat. But what kind...

ly6w1.description: When consuming, its best not to think about what the sausage is made of.

wj2no.description: A nutritious product with the taste of Soviet cardboard.

3g1qz.description: It warms you up, but has side effects.
3g1qz.description_zh: 能暖暖身子，但有副作用。

0row1.description: A classic snack for a simple meal.

7rvr.description: The result of skillful use of spices, a meat grinder, and a shotgun.

qjmjk.description: The food of a true stalker!

3rjk.description: Despite the name, the piggy content here is minimal.

j54p6.description: When consuming, its best not to think about what the sausage is made of.

rwol5.description: Consuming in large quantities may cause digestive issues.

7yrr.description: A fragmentation hand grenade produced in the Netherlands. Despite its small size, it is lethal within a range of several meters.
7yrr.description_zh: 荷兰生产的破片手榴弹。尽管尺寸小，但在几米范围内是致命的。

4qg3p.description: In order to always remain healthy, stalkers should watch their diet! "Happy New Year!" beans are an excellent discovery for a festive menu.
4qg3p.description_zh: 为了始终保持健康，潜行者应该注意饮食！"新年快乐！"豆子是节日菜单上的绝佳发现。

9m7w.description: Condensed milk inside, with a can outside.

okrq0.description: A tin of preserved food. Smells like meat.
okrq0.description_zh: 一罐罐头食品。闻起来像肉。

g4lk0.description: A specialized medical kit for treating physical wounds and bleeding. The kit contains a tourniquet for stopping bleeding, an adrenaline injection, a weak antirad treatment, and a special regeneration drug.
g4lk0.description_zh: 专为治疗物理创伤和出血而设计的特殊医疗包。包含止血带、肾上腺素注射剂、弱效抗辐射治疗剂和一种特殊的再生药物。

qj9y6.description: A first-aid treatment used for chemical burns of the larynx and lungs, or chemical poisoning. Does not protect against the direct effects of acid and open fire on the body.

rw1mg.description: The main component is an artificial steroid with a chemical make-up similar to testosterone. Used by stalkers for long journeys to increase muscle fatigue tolerance.
rw1mg.description_zh: 主要成分是一种化学结构与睾酮相似的人工合成类固醇。被潜行者用于长途跋涉，以提高肌肉疲劳耐受性。

qj9n6.description: Ice cream to be eaten at your own risk.

lngq.description: A Russian defensive impact fragmentation grenade.
lngq.description_zh: 俄罗斯防御型碰炸破片手榴弹。

r2mv.description: Aged fortified wine with a bright sweet taste. An excellent way to dissolve sad thoughts.

wjw9p.description: Removes radiation and psy-radiation from the body.
wjw9p.description_zh: 清除体内的辐射和精神辐射。

4qgop.description: Removes radiation and psy-radiation from the body.
4qgop.description_zh: 清除体内的辐射和精神辐射。

m0p4j.description: Lowers the effects of radiation on the body.
m0p4j.description_zh: 降低辐射对身体的影响。

0rdjd.description: This chocolate ice cream has no need of advertising—it tastes positively anomalous!
0rdjd.description_zh: 这款巧克力冰淇淋无需广告——它的味道简直好得异常！

7ly13.description: A first-aid kit with items assembled by an experienced stalker. Contains the most useful treatments in the right doses and is suitable for any situation.
7ly13.description_zh: 由经验丰富的潜行者组装的急救包。包含最有用且剂量合适的治疗品，适用于任何情况。

n4l63.description: An oceanic product from the depths of the earth.

lyn5j.description: If you want to survive in the Zone until next Christmas, dont look down your nose at Christmas beans! They dont just improve your stamina; they also increase your vitality!
lyn5j.description_zh: 如果你想在区域里活到下一个圣诞节，就不要瞧不起圣诞豆子！它们不仅能提高你的耐力，还能增加你的活力！

1r2o6.description: A medical kit developed especially for use in Zone conditions.
1r2o6.description_zh: 专为特异区环境使用而开发的医疗包。

n4vw6.description: Partially protects the skin from the effects of open fire and chemical substances.
n4vw6.description_zh: 部分保护皮肤免受明火和化学物质的影响。

2opo6.description_zh: 由贝尼斯制作的肉罐头。

rw1pg.description: A ripe mandarin resembles a small sun thats bursting with a sweet but sharp juice...
rw1pg.description_zh: 一个成熟的橘子就像一个小太阳，充满了甜美但又辛辣的汁液……

j5mn7.description: A first-aid treatment used for burns of the larynx and lungs in high-temperature environments. Does not protect against the direct effects of open flame on the body.

3gvgg.description: A tin of dog pâté... Or pâté for dogs?
3gvgg.description_zh: 一罐狗肉酱……或者给狗吃的酱？

vyrg.description: An American flashbang grenade with a short detonation time.
vyrg.description_zh: 一款具有短促爆时间的美国闪光弹。

lynkj.description: A beverage that gives a rush of energy. Contains a large dose of caffeine.
lynkj.description_zh: 一种能带来能量爆发的饮品。含有大剂量咖啡因。

knop0.description: Tastes better than a rotten pumpkin!

kno60.description: A pill that reduces the effects of psy-emissions. Frequent use has a negative effect on brainpower.

m0jw7.description: Hard to say if there are really sprats in it, but it tastes similar.

lynrj.description: A first-aid treatment used for chemical burns of the larynx and lungs, or chemical poisoning. Does not protect against the direct effects of acid and open fire on the body.

g00n.description: Sickly sweet, sticky pulp from a contaminated zone. Despite the taste, it contains virtually no carbohydrates. Can enhance other flavors.

j5456.description: A tin of high-quality canned meat from storage.
j5456.description_zh: 来自库存的高质量肉罐头。

6w59j.description: A cocktail of chemicals that quickly relieves pain and removes any feeling of fatigue.
6w59j.description_zh: 化学物质混合剂，能快速缓解疼痛并消除疲劳感。

g4lp0.description: A simple drink, once distorted by the Inside Out, becomes something different.
g4lp0.description_zh: 一种简单的饮料，一旦被内外世界扭曲，就会变成不同的东西。

964z0.description: If you get really drunk, you can see more than just monsters!
964z0.description_zh: 如果真的喝醉了，你看到的可能不止怪物！

okdno.description: Juicy and crispy—you wouldnt believe that this corn had been stored in an army warehouse since December 1986!
okdno.description_zh: 多汁又爽脆——你简直无法相信这玉米是自1986年12月以来就储存在军队仓库里的！

okd4o.description: Lowers the effects of radiation on the body.
okd4o.description_zh: 降低辐射对身体的影响。

3g12z.description: A classic dish from all kinds of mutants. Tastes better than it smells.

n4lg6.description: A simple and hearty porridge with favorite stew.

wj2jo.description: A food kit designed for situations when preparing a hot meal isnt an option.
wj2jo.description_zh: 一组设计用于在无法准备热餐的条件下食用的食品。

12dq.description: A fragmentation round for the M203 grenade launcher.

1r2l6.description: A medicinal drug developed to replace Hemostat. It comprehensively promotes blood thickening and clotting.
1r2l6.description_zh: 一种替代止血剂的药物，全面促进血液凝固和凝结。

okdpo.description: When life gives you lemons—make use of them.

qj9q6.description: A pill that reduces the effects of psy-emissions. Frequent use has a negative effect on brainpower.

29dm.description_zh: 反人员防御型破片手榴弹。

vjdqd.description: There are endless recipes for salad. But this ones the best!

zz1o2.description: Soup from which sprats are trying to escape

65r6.description: A fragmentation round for the GP-25 Kostyor grenade launcher.
65r6.description_zh: GP-25 Kostyor榴弹发射器的破片弹。

vjy5n.description: This champagne goes straight to your head... We advise downing it precisely when the clock strikes midnight!
vjy5n.description_zh: 这种香槟直接上头……我们建议在午夜钟声敲响时一饮而尽！

vjy3n.description: Adrenaline of synthetic origin. The main hormone of the adrenal medulla, as well as a neurotransmitter. Raises blood pressure, which increases both efficacy of healing treatments and the risk of serious bleeding if injured.
vjy3n.description_zh: 人工合成的肾上腺素。肾上腺髓质的主要激素，也是一种神经递质。升高血压，从而提高治疗效果，但如果受伤，也会增加严重出血的风险。

gl0g.description: A fragmentation round for the M203 grenade launcher. It bounces when it lands, increasing the area damaged by the fragments.
gl0g.description_zh: M203榴弹发射器的破片弹。它落地时会弹跳，增加破片造成的区域伤害。

94mw.description: A fragmentation round for the GP-25 Kostyor grenade launcher. It bounces when it lands, increasing the area damaged by the fragments.
94mw.description_zh: GP-25 Kostyor榴弹发射器的破片弹。它落地时会弹跳，增加破片造成的区域伤害。

dmk95.description: These peas havent spoiled even slightly! On the contrary, theyre completely saturated in the Zones energy, which has enhanced their beneficial properties... Well, except their taste. Thats clearly why theyre being sold as "last years."
dmk95.description_zh: 这些豌豆一点都没坏！相反，它们完全浸透了区域的能量，这增强了它们的有益特性……嗯，除了味道。这显然就是它们被当作"去年的"出售的原因。

n4vo6.description: Due to being exposed to the Zones anomalous activity, this mandarin has become even bigger, sweeter, juicier, and just overall tastier! True, you might get radiation poisoning by eating one of these fruits... but you definitely wont get scurvy!
n4vo6.description_zh: 由于暴露在区域的异常活动之下，这个橘子变得更大、更甜、更多汁，总体上更好吃了！真的，吃一个这样的水果可能会得辐射病……但你肯定不会得坏血病！

0rdld.description: A first-aid treatment used for burns of the larynx and lungs in high-temperature environments. Does not protect against the direct effects of open flame on the body.

p62o6.description: Youve never come across tastier ice cream! Theres a myth going around the Zone that these were produced only in limited quantities—just 500 were made—and that they were imported into the Zone on a military helicopter that was delivering this treat to local secret labs. Now, someones dug up these little gems and has started selling them—are they some kind of magician?
p62o6.description_zh: 你从未遇到过比这更好吃的冰棒！区域里流传着一个神话，说这些冰棒只限量生产了500个，并且是由一架军用直升机运入区域的，当时这架直升机正在为当地的秘密实验室运送这种美食。现在，有人挖出了这些珍宝并开始出售——他们是魔术师吗？

p62q6.description: A medicinal substance of synthetic origin intended to relieve pain. Side effects include drowsiness and difficulty paying attention. Frequent use can lead to addiction.
p62q6.description_zh: 用于缓解疼痛的人工合成药物。副作用包括嗜睡和注意力分散。频繁使用可能导致成瘾。

m0pyj.description: This bottle of champagne has been exposed to the Zones anomalous activity... However, it doesnt seem to have more bubbles.
m0pyj.description_zh: 这瓶香槟暴露在区域的异常活动之下……不过，它似乎没有更多气泡。

g4l10.description: A foreign anabolic steroid with effects similar to other substances that are popular among stalkers like Arnie and Jiden. Due to the high dose of the active ingredient, usage of more than one of these substances at the same time is not recommended.
g4l10.description_zh: 这款境外合成类固醇，效果与潜行者人手皆知的 “Arnie ”“Jiden” 如出一辙。

dmky5.description: A drug developed by foreign scientists using research into artifacts that block psy-emissions. The effects of the drug remained unknown until the decision was made to give it to a patient suffering from mental disorders. A little while later, his behavior began to resemble that of a mentally stable person. The drug affects recently damaged brain cells and restores them with unbelievable speed. Due to its effects and the materials required to create it, this drug spread quickly to the Zone, where it became popular among stalkers.
dmky5.description_zh: 这款药剂由国外科研人员研发，其核心技术源自对神器的逆向研究，效果是能够阻断精神辐射波。在其被用于治疗一名精神紊乱患者之前，该药剂的真实效用始终是个谜。用药不久后，该名患者的行为模式便逐步趋近于心智健全者的状态。此药剂可靶向作用于近期受损的脑细胞，并以超乎想象的速度完成细胞修复。得益于其逆天疗效，再加上制造原料的特殊获取渠道，它迅速流入特异区，成为潜行者群体中炙手可热的产品。

7l9l7.description: The name accurately conveys the difficulty of obtaining the ingredients.

z77k.description: Pulp, reeking of rot and alcohol, from a plant that grows in anomalous zones. The plant lives in symbiosis with anomalous yeast, which replaces its internal moisture with an alcoholic solution.

zzqn2.description: Significantly stimulates adrenal and pituitary function. It is said to even raise the dead, but it is not recommended to test this.
zzqn2.description_zh: 显著刺激肾上腺和垂体功能。据说甚至能让死人复活，但不建议验证这一点。

1r216.description: Stimulant causes an adrenaline rush and enhances cardiovascular durability.

dm165.description: The most common dish among the sailors of Pripyat.

964ow.description: Contrary to popular belief, it does not contain artifact particles, but it invigorates like no other!
964ow.description_zh: 与普遍看法相反，它不含神器微粒，但它提神醒脑的效果无与伦比！

p6256.description: Back from the dead in 3 seconds!

2o9g0.description: A glimmering purple liquid in a glass flask. Apparently, when consumed, you temporarily stop paying attention to scratches and other physical wounds.
2o9g0.description_zh: 玻璃烧瓶中闪烁着紫色光芒的液体。显然，服用后，你会暂时忽略擦伤和其他物理创伤。

n4vg6.description: As ancient as the Zone, a remedy for the consequences of a good evening.

ly6y1.description: A dish for true conquerors of the Zone. And it smells like...

vjy0n.description: Protection from reptiloids in every sip.

1r2yq.description: The components of the substance affect muscle fibers significantly increasing strength indicators.
1r2yq.description_zh: 该物质的成分显著影响肌肉纤维，增加力量指标。

1r246.description: This substance has a real kick... Eat at your own risk.
1r246.description_zh: 这种物质后劲十足……食用风险自负。

7lyd3.description: An experimental modification of the ATLAS anabolic, which arrived in the Zone in a fairly large shipment. Rumor has it that some loaded Frost Fighter ordered it specifically for the Blizzard.
7lyd3.description_zh: 大批量的实验性合成代谢类固醇改良版ATLAS已运抵区域。传言称，这是某个有钱的寒霜斗士专门为暴风雪订购的。

3g1zz.description: With the taste of the Lighter anomaly.

6w5lj.description: Whats the difference what the voices in your head say when you cant be stopped!

5ddo.description: Sweet watery pulp with no specific taste. Found in anomalous zones. Has a distinct watermelon aroma. Boosts metabolism in large quantities.

2o900.description: Vodka is the best way to warm up!
2o900.description_zh: 伏特加是取暖的最佳方式！

wj2zp.description: A good rich soup after which its advisable to wear a gas mask.

zzqn9.description: Inspires grate feats. After three bottles of this cocktail, you forget anything except its taste.
zzqn9.description_zh: 激励伟大功绩。三杯这种鸡尾酒下肚，除了它的味道，你会忘记一切。

zzqo2.description: An anabolic steroid altered by the Inside Out. Can come in very handy in a tight spot.
zzqo2.description_zh: 一种被内外世界改变了的合成代谢类固醇。在紧要关头可能非常有用。

p6056.description: The favorite dish of any dad!

y39yz.description: Known in bandit circles as "Musical Soup"

964k0.description: An enhanced medicine that provides increased skin protection against fire and chemical agents.

g4lz0.description: The complex composition significantly accelerates the factors of coagulation and cell division.
g4lz0.description_zh: 复合配方可强效加速凝血与细胞再生的进程。

4qd3p.description: A robust and thick fish soup. The fish smell has been masked with spices.

4qdqn.description: A food kit designed for situations when preparing a hot meal isnt an option.
4qdqn.description_zh: 一组设计用于在无法准备热餐的条件下食用的食品。

2o9w0.description: A brew prepared by an unknown craftsman from Kolos, for warming the soul and body. Theres just one problem—this drink has vodka instead of rum! Stalkers say that it not only warms you up, increasing your chances of survival during the Blizzard, but it also brings good luck! Provided that you are capable of staying on your feet after a nice bottle of grog...
2o9w0.description_zh: 科洛斯一位不知名匠人准备的调制酒，用于温暖身心。只有一个问题——这种饮料里用的是伏特加而不是朗姆酒！潜行者们说，它不仅能让你暖和，增加你在暴风雪中生存的机会，还能带来好运！前提是你在享用了一整瓶美味的格罗格酒之后还能站得住脚……

g4lzg.description: StalHealth warns: prolonged use causes an eruption.
g4lzg.description_zh: 斯塔健康警告：长期使用会导致风暴。

y3knz.description: Blocks pain receptors in the brain. Prolonged use causes suicidal overconfidence.
y3knz.description_zh: 阻断大脑中的痛觉感受器。长期使用会导致过度自信，甚至产生自杀倾向。

5l23g.description: Anything can become a solyanka when youre starving.

6w5jj.description: A home-brew lingonberry liqueur. Will keep you warm just like a heater! It also increases resistance to radiation.
6w5jj.description_zh: 自酿的越橘利口酒。能像加热器一样让你暖和起来！还能增加抗辐射能力。

y770.description: Pulp with a bright sour-bitter taste. Prolonged consumption in pure form can cause thrombosis. Has a minor mutation factor. Relatively harmless to humans. Found in anomalous zones.

yqq0.description: Reinforced version of the KZS-1 container with a partially upgraded component borrowed from sample No. 3-IA.
yqq0.description_zh: KZS-1容器的加固版本，部分升级了从3-EA样本借用的组件。

9yyq.description:
The first of the containers designed by Scientific Research Institute 7 based on the trophy sample No. 3-IA.
Thanks to the component copied from the Murmur container, it significantly increases the efficiency of artifact usage.
9yyq.description_zh:
第7科学研究所基于缴获样本3-EA设计的第一批容器。
得益于复制自低语者容器的组件，它显著提高了神器的使用效率。

v6y7.description:
A container with an alternative design, created to use a larger number of artifacts simultaneously.
Unfortunately, at the time of the containers creation, significant improvements to the component from sample No. 3-IA were not achieved, resulting in reduced efficiency and protective properties of the container.
v6y7.description_zh:
一种具有替代设计的容器，旨在同时使用更多数量的神器。
不幸的是，在容器创建时，未能实现对基于3-EA样本的组件的重大改进，导致容器的效率和防护性能降低。

w4wz.description: A widely-used artifact container model. Has weak shielding capabilities but is easy to produce, reliable, and lets you carry four artifacts. These factors had a strong influence on this models popularity.
w4wz.description_zh: 一种广泛使用的神器容器型号。屏蔽能力较弱，但易于生产、可靠，可携带四个神器。这些因素对该型号的普及产生了强烈影响。

9y4q.description:
When work began on the KZS and KZR series, the idea arose to design a more compact protective container to enhance gear usability.
KZK-1, nicknamed "Cocoon" by stalkers, became the first successful prototype in the series and the basis for all subsequent KZK containers.
9y4q.description_zh:
在开始KZS和KZR系列的工作后，产生了为增强设备可用性而创建更紧凑的保护容器设计的想法。
KZK-1，被潜行者因其特征表面图案昵称为“茧”，成为该系列的第一个成功原型，作为未来KZK类型容器开发的基础。

l332.description: A fairly spacious backpack that comes equipped with two average-sized artifact containers. It gets its name from its visual similarity to the character of the same name.
l332.description_zh: 一个相当宽敞的背包，配备了两个中等大小的神器容器。因其视觉上与同名角色的相似性而得名。

j33l.description:
A factory-produced set of two KZS containers.
Although the overall volume of the container has increased, technical limitations reduce the effectiveness of each artifact. This was addressed by incorporating additional protection against the harmful effects of artifacts.
j33l.description_zh:
工厂生产的一套两个KZS容器。
虽然容器的总体积增加了，但技术限制降低了每个神器的使用效率，这是通过提供额外的防护来抵御神器的有害影响而确定的。

n339.description: A fairly spacious black backpack that comes equipped with three average-sized artifact containers. It gets its name from its visual similarity to the character of the same name.
n339.description_zh: 一个相当宽敞的黑色背包，配备了两个中等大小的神器容器。因其视觉上与同名角色的相似性而得名。

p2k2.description: This item currently uses a TEMPORARY model that will be replaced.
p2k2.description_zh:
一个体面的工厂产腰包，集成了黑市工匠制作的KZS-2容器。

由于容器周围空间有限，第七研究局生产的组件效率会降低，这让男爵非常失望，因为这阻碍了集成容器发挥最大性能。

nv63.description: This item currently uses a TEMPORARY model that will be replaced.
nv63.description_zh:
一个小型腰包，设计更偏向旅游而非战斗行动。

虽然这样的产品在大陆上可以轻松便宜地买到，但"男爵""照顾"那些决定在进入区域前不在装备上花钱的潜行者，并因此理所当然地赚取他的利润。

d3kg.description:
Because Berloga-4 and Berloga-6 were so popular among stalkers, the five-artifact container in the same series remained forever in their shadow, never receiving the same love.
Some stalkers blamed gear suppliers, who were long hesitant to purchase the "intermediate solution," which they felt was "neither fish nor fowl."
d3kg.description_zh:
尽管兽穴-4和兽穴-6在潜行者中变得极其流行，但该系列中为五个神器设计的容器仍然被忽视，没有像其他两个“兽穴”那样受到喜爱。
一些潜行者认为，原因是装备供应商犹豫了很长时间才购买这个“中间解决方案”，他们觉得这“不伦不类”。

6g5n.description:
A reinforced version of the container popularly known as the "Canister."
Thanks to the work of scientists, the design was partially optimized, improving the technical properties of the KZR container.
6g5n.description_zh:
民间称为“油桶”的容器的加固版本。
得益于科学家的工作，设计得到了部分优化，改善了KZR容器的技术特性。

yqk0.description:
A reinforced version of the KZK-1 container, also known as Cocoon.
Following their old tradition, Research Institute 7 decided to continue the practice of creating reinforced and more expensive containers for their operatives in the Zone.
yqk0.description_zh:
KZK-1容器的加固版本，也称为茧。
遵循他们的旧传统，第7研究所决定继续为其在区域的特工创建加固且更昂贵的容器的做法。

l3n2.description: A reinforced model of an artifact container. It has weak shielding properties but is easy to produce, reliable, and allows carrying 4 artifacts. These factors significantly contributed to the popularity of this model.
l3n2.description_zh: 神器容器的加固型号。屏蔽性能较弱，但易于生产、可靠，可携带4个神器。这些因素极大地促进了该型号的普及。

zj1k.description:
Numerous attempts by the engineers at Research Institute 7 to increase capacity by expanding the internal volume through more compact assembly yielded no results, necessitating not only the enlargement of the container itself but also the layer of protective coating. 

The result was a bulky yet spacious container, nicknamed Kega by stalkers due to its external resemblance.
zj1k.description_zh:
第七研究局的工程师们曾多次尝试通过更紧凑的装配来扩大内部容积以提高容量，但均未取得成效，这不仅需要扩大容器本身，还需要加厚防护涂层。

结果是一个笨重但宽敞的容器，由于外观相似，被潜行者们戏称为"凯加"。

3d11.description: When Baron got his hands on the craftsman behind artisanal containers like the Fridge and the Shiver, the first thing he did was raise the issue of creating a more "budget-friendly" version of gear aimed at stalkers just starting to conquer the Zone. This is how the Cool appeared on the CEZ market.
3d11.description_zh: 当男爵控制了那些制作冰箱和寒颤等自制容器的工匠后，他做的第一件事就是提出为那些刚刚开始征服区域的潜行者创建更“经济实惠”的装备版本。这就是冰冷品出现在CEZ市场上的原因。

o335.description:
A factory-produced set of two KZS-U containers.
Despite reinforcing the original containers, Research Institute 7 engineers were unable to solve the issue of reduced overall effectiveness.
o335.description_zh:
工厂生产的一套两个KZS-U容器。
尽管加固了原始容器，但第7研究所的工程师未能解决整体效率降低的问题。

2vvv.description:
A factory-produced set of three KZS-M containers.
Research Institute 7 engineers struggled for a long time with achieving the most ergonomic container arrangement and efficiency improvement but did not succeed in the latter. Ultimately, it was decided to additionally reinforce the internal insulation layers, as was done on the KZS-2.
2vvv.description_zh:
工厂生产的一套三个KZS-M容器。
第7研究所的工程师花了很长时间努力实现最符合人体工程学的容器排列和提高效率，但后者没有成功。最终，决定额外加固内部绝缘层，就像在KZS-2上所做的那样。

k3oj.description:
A continuation of the KZK series, maintaining the idea of simultaneous ease of use and container capacity.
The distinctive pattern on the surface of the body played a large part in the nickname "Cell" becoming firmly attached to the container.
k3oj.description_zh:
KZK系列的延续，保持了同时使用的舒适性和容器容量的理念。
壳体表面的独特图案极大地促进了“蜂巢”这个绰号牢固地附加在该容器上。

k3kj.description: Despite the short time spent on the containers upgrade, the new version of Kega was equipped with additional shielding and improved efficiency over the original containers design.
k3kj.description_zh: 尽管容器升级所花费的时间很短，但新版本的凯加配备了额外的屏蔽层，并且其效率相比原始容器设计有所提高。

o3d5.description:
A reinforced version of the second container in the KZK series.
During the development of the reinforced version, Research Institute 7 intended to significantly modify the component based on sample No. 3-IA. However, the work was delayed, resulting in the KZK-2U being released without significant improvements.
o3d5.description_zh:
KZK系列第二个容器的加固版本。
在开发加固版本期间，第7研究所打算大幅修改基于3-EA样本的组件。然而，工作被延迟，导致KZK-2U在没有重大改进的情况下发布。

51zo.description: Cursed hunters artifact bag with three containers. The silhouette reveals a base from the KZS-M, but the layout has been altered, and some elements have been replaced with a filtering system.
51zo.description_zh: 被诅咒猎人的神器包，有三个容器。轮廓显示其基础来自KZS-M，但布局已经改变，一些元件已被过滤系统取代。

zjqk.description: A special bag that appeared during the filming of the show "Dead Mans Marathon" by order of sponsors. The bag has three containers and a filter system.
zjqk.description_zh: 一种特殊的包，在“亡者马拉松”节目拍摄期间按赞助商要求出现。该包有三个容器和一个过滤系统。

g3ln.description: A makeshift artifact container based on Berloga, created by a skilled digger. Originally, this container was made for personal use. However, when other stalkers noticed its unique properties that help utilize certain artifacts, some of them also wanted to order such a modification.
g3ln.description_zh: 基于兽穴的自制神器容器，由一位熟练的挖掘者创建。最初，这个容器是为个人使用而制作的。然而，当其他潜行者注意到它有助于利用某些神器的独特特性时，其中一些人也想订购这样的改装。

1p2r.description:
A factory-produced set of three KZS-U containers.
The reinforced version of the KZS-M was expected to be released before the KZR series containers; however, the work to increase overall volume took too long.
1p2r.description_zh:
工厂生产的一套三个KZS-U容器。
KZS-M的加固版本预计在KZR系列容器之前发布；然而，增加总体积的工作耗时太长。

2v9v.description: Taking on features of the Fridge container, the Shiver uses a special cooling agent that emits toxic gases for improved efficiency. Unfortunately, these jury-rigged systems are prone to leakages.
2v9v.description_zh: 具有冰箱容器的特点，寒颤使用一种特殊的冷却剂，会释放有毒气体以提高效率。不幸的是，这些临时系统容易泄漏。

p99d.description: An artifact container designed specifically for the Bear exoskeleton. Due to the outdated servomotors, the exoskeleton has very little space for containers, which limited the possible size of the IU-2. @@§6Compatible only with the Bear exoskeleton.

vyqd.description: This item currently uses a TEMPORARY model that will be replaced.
vyqd.description_zh: 国外制造的战术工具背心。良好的内部容积、便利的人体工学和优质的纺织品使其表现出色，使这款腰带在一些寻求提升战斗能力的潜行者中颇受欢迎。

q194.description: Black Market artisans claim that the container is entirely their own development. A couple of mechanics, deciding to test this claim, dismantled a Forager and found almost a complete set of parts from Research Institute 7, reassembled into a rather unconventional construction with additional casing made of anomalous materials.
q194.description_zh: 黑市工匠声称该容器完全是他们开发的。几位机械师决定检验这一说法，拆解了觅食者，发现几乎完整的第7研究所部件套件，使用异常材料制成的额外外壳重新组装成一个相当非常规的结构。

9ygq.description:
Like other reinforced containers in the series, it gained great popularity among the military and SSPP military stalkers.
According to rumors coming into the Zone from Ch-4 and the Perimeter, military stalkers receive the Berloga-5U for completing a dozen missions!
9ygq.description_zh:
与该系列中其他加固容器一样，它在军方和SSPP军用潜行者中获得了极大的欢迎。
根据来自Ch-4和边界的进入区域的传言，军用潜行者成功完成一打任务才能获得兽穴-5U！

g35n.description:
As one of the most popular containers in the Zone, Berloga-6 is the first that comes to mind when a stalker talks about artifact containers.
Berloga-6 gained wide distribution thanks to equipment suppliers who actively purchased the containers through their contacts in the SSPP.
g35n.description_zh:
作为区域中最受欢迎的容器之一，熊穴-6是当潜行者谈到神器容器时第一个想到的。
熊穴-6之所以能广泛流传，要归功于装备供应商们，他们通过SSPP内部的联系人积极采购这些容器。

w42z.description: Artifact container created by Murmur based on anomalous materials and bioengineering. Equipped with a synchronization field generator, allowing fighters to gain maximum benefit from using the artifact. Trials on ordinary people have not revealed the principles by which this field operates.
w42z.description_zh: 由"低语"基于异常材料和生物工程制造的神器容器。配备同步力场发生器，允许战斗人员从使用神器中获得最大收益。对普通人的试验尚未揭示该力场的运作原理。

0nok.description:
A unique container, found while studying the Trailblazers equipment warehouses in the lab under the Radar, nicknamed Sheaf by stalkers.

As the most experienced stalkers say, during the arrival of Knyazevs group in the Zone, Scientific Research Institute 7 produced only a few containers from the KZS and Canister series. It seems Sheaf is the result of the Trailblazers groups efforts, likely drawing certain knowledge from the lab where the group settled.
0nok.description_zh:
一种独特的容器，在研究雷达站下实验室的"开拓者"装备仓库时发现，被潜行者昵称为"禾捆"。

正如最有经验的潜行者所说，在克尼亚泽夫小组抵达区域期间，第七科学研究所只生产了少量KZS和"罐"系列容器。看来"禾捆"是"开拓者"小组努力的成果，可能从该小组定居的实验室汲取了某些知识。

512o.description: ZIVCAS ArcticSafe-6 — a container from the ArcticSafe line designed for transporting and using up to 6 artifacts. Equipped with the innovative GlacialFlow thermal regulation system, which facilitates additional heat exchange with the environment. Due to the unique patented GlacialFlow processes, the container emits psy-radiation, the influence of which does not exceed acceptable levels according to ZIVCAS specialists recommendations.
512o.description_zh: ZIVCAS ArcticSafe-6 — ArcticSafe系列容器，设计用于运输和使用最多6个神器。配备了创新的"GlacialFlow"热调节系统，便于与周围环境进行额外的热交换。由于独特的专利"GlacialFlow"过程，该容器会释放PSY辐射，根据ZIVCAS专家的建议，其影响不会超过可接受水平。

j3ml.description: A special multipurpose container, one of the latest models created by Zone craftsmen. Quality materials are combined with skillfully arranged boxes to hold 4 artifacts in the container whilst providing reliable inner protection.
j3ml.description_zh: 一种特殊的多用途容器，是区域工匠创建的最新型号之一。优质材料与巧妙排列的盒子相结合，可在容器中容纳4个神器，同时提供可靠的内部防护。

zq3n.description: This item currently uses a TEMPORARY model that will be replaced.
zq3n.description_zh: 尽管背包的容量和额外的神器容器不算差，但黑市无法使他们的作品特性与第七研究局的原始容器相匹配。尽管如此，这种格式的背包仍然吸引了一些有经验的潜行者，他们旨在从区域突袭中携带尽可能多的战利品。

p262.description: This item currently uses a TEMPORARY model that will be replaced.
p262.description_zh:
独特设计理念的发展，使得"地狱男孩"和"狩猎袋"得以诞生，同时也催生了由男爵工匠制作的相当不错的背包。

即使考虑到"棺材"很难被视为常规容器的完整替代品，许多有经验的潜行者还是更青睐它，而非第七科学研究所的装备。

p92d.description:
The Berloga series containers, although convenient, remained quite bulky, which led to the creation of a new KZK series container.
The engineers at the Research Institute 7 aimed to maintain compactness while expanding the containers capacity. The result of their work was the KZK-3 container, nicknamed "Hive" by stalkers.
p92d.description_zh:
兽穴系列容器虽然方便，但相当笨重，这导致了新的KZK系列容器的创建。
第7研究所的工程师旨在保持紧凑性的同时扩大容器的容量。他们工作的成果是KZK-3容器，被潜行者昵称为“蜂巢”。

vyjd.description_zh:
ZIVCAS 西西弗斯-6是一款实验型背包，专为长时间野外部署设计，适用于返回基地被认为经济上不可行的环境。该型号最多可携带6件神器，并采用UphillFrame负载分配系统，在保持高承载能力的同时降低脊柱的峰值压力。
根据ZIVCAS内部资料，Sisyphus-6通过增加有效载荷和减少被迫返回次数来提高野外人员效率。测试人员对“持续压力”和“太阳穴嗡嗡响”的投诉被归类为可接受的不适水平，不影响整体生产力。
该产品已获准用于具有足够纪律性、企业耐力和对指定目标忠诚度的人员。

j34l.description:
Although the Black Market resorts to less than refined methods to attract "new talent" into its ranks, it also provides them with resources and opportunities that cannot be obtained by being a lone Franklin.

Thanks to such "collaboration," a new container from the series of artisanal containers has emerged, just like others, having certain usage limitations but proving effective when used with certain artefacts.
j34l.description_zh:
尽管黑市采取不那么精致的方法来吸引“新人才”加入其大师行列，但它也向他们提供无法通过成为独行富兰克林获得的资源和机会。

得益于这种“合作”，出现了一种来自自制容器系列的新容器，就像其他容器一样，具有一定的使用限制，但在与某些神器一起使用时被证明是有效的。

l362.description:
Unique development by an engineering consortium working for the SSPP. The Container Reinforced for Artifacts (Wide), or simply "CRAW" (or Crawfish), was created thanks to relic technologies found in the Zone, most of which were obtained from "Murmur" trophies. 

Although the military keeps the containers operational principles more secret than those of ZIVCAS, many engineers attempt to decipher the secret of its design by dismantling the rare samples that fall into the hands of ordinary stalkers.
l362.description_zh:
为SSPP工作的工程联盟的独特开发成果。神器加固加宽容器，或简称"CRAW"（或"小龙虾"），其诞生得益于在区域中发现、且大部分从"低语"战利品中获得的遗物技术。

尽管军方对其运作原理的保密程度甚至超过ZIVCAS，许多工程师仍试图通过拆解落入普通潜行者手中的稀有样本来破译其设计秘密。

rgoz.description:
The newest container from the KZR series. It earned the nickname Barrel among stalkers due to its appearance.
Unlike other containers in this series, it features one of the advanced systems for enhancing effectiveness, which was also used in the production and development of Hive.
rgoz.description_zh:
KZR系列的最新型容器。因其外观，在潜行者中赢得了"木桶"的绰号。
与该系列其他容器不同，它采用了一种用于增强效力的先进系统，该系统也曾用于"蜂巢"的制造和开发。

dkln.description: This item currently uses a TEMPORARY model that will be replaced.
dkln.description_zh:
军队Warbelt型多功能背心，由SSPP使用。

其优良的品质和较大的内部容积自然引起了潜行者的兴趣，促使装备商们尝试通过各种走私渠道获取这类装备。

q1m4.description:
The newest container from the Berloga series, created specifically for Research Institute 7 operatives.
The modification of the component based on sample No. 3-EA, which began during the development of the KZK-2U, was successfully completed. This improvement significantly enhanced the containers effectiveness compared to others, making it highly valued among stalkers.
q1m4.description_zh:
熊穴系列的最新型容器，专为第七研究局的特工创建。
基于3-EA号样本的组件改进始于KZK-2U的开发阶段，并已成功完成。这一改进显著提升了该容器相对于其他容器的效力，使其在潜行者中备受推崇。

n3v9.description:
One of Research Institute 7s masterpieces, developed as a continuation of the KZK series, retaining the idea of combining compactness and volume.
Like the Berloga-6U, KZK-4 was equipped with a modified component based on sample No. 3-EA, which improved the containers efficiency.
Stalkers, not thinking long, decided to give the institutes development a name consistent with other containers in the series.
n3v9.description_zh:
第七研究局的杰作之一，作为KZK系列的延续而开发，保留了紧凑性与容量结合的理念。
与熊穴-6U一样，KZK-4配备了基于3-EA号样本改进的组件，提高了容器的效率。
潜行者们没多想，决定给研究局的开发成果取一个与该系列其他容器一致的名字。

yq90.description: The backpack combines organic shapes and technical elements. Containers fused with the fabric cover and frame of the bag form a single ecosystem. After prolonged wear, it seems that the backpack sometimes moves imperceptibly.
yq90.description_zh: 这款背包融合了有机形态与技术元素。与背包织物覆盖层和框架融合的容器形成了一个单一的生态系统。长时间佩戴后，似乎背包有时会不为人知地移动。

yw7k.description: Lower charge usage during active scanning compared to the standard model, but the scanning distance is also decreased
yw7k.description_zh: 与标准型号相比，主动扫描时的电荷使用量较少，但扫描距离也减少了。

z47y.description: Lower charge usage during active scanning compared to the standard model, but the scanning distance is also decreased
z47y.description_zh: 与标准型号相比，主动扫描时的电荷使用量较少，但扫描距离也减少了。

9j0l.description: A detector used to locate zones of anomalous activity. It is equipped with a basic tracking device. The wire glows brighter when aimed in the right direction, and it gives off an alarm when in close proximity to a source.
9j0l.description_zh: 用于定位异常活动区域的探测器。配备基本追踪装置。指向正确方向时电线会发出更亮的光，接近信号源时会发出警报。

9rkw.description_zh: 临时组装的异常信号扫描仪

z4v9.description:
First short range detector equipped with a screen that visualizes the signals location.

Like other devices working with the detection of anomalous signals, it uses a component based on No. 137-IA.

Despite its apparent simplicity, the task of integrating the component with the visualization system proved quite challenging even for the engineers at Research Institute 7. However, this innovation was warmly received not only by stalkers but also by the institutes operatives.
z4v9.description_zh:
第一款配备屏幕以可视化信号位置的短程探测器。

与其他用于检测异常信号的设备一样，它使用了基于 No. 137-VA 的组件。

尽管看似简单，但将该组件与可视化系统集成的任务即使对第7研究所的工程师来说也相当具有挑战性。然而，这项创新不仅受到潜行者的热烈欢迎，也受到了研究所特工的欢迎。

1gmg.description: A detector used to locate zones of anomalous activity. It is equipped with a screen that can show the source of the signals.
1gmg.description_zh: 用于定位异常活动区域的探测器。配备可显示信号源位置的屏幕。

gdj6.description: A detector used to locate zones of anomalous activity. It is equipped with a screen that can show the source of the signals.
gdj6.description_zh: 用于定位异常活动区域的探测器。配备可显示信号源位置的屏幕。

rz6ZNaDw.description: The ZIVCAS Pioneer series scanners are based on the legendary SAC scanners. The Pioneer-3 model is a significant improvement over the popular SAC-2 model. Engineers at the ZIVCAS corporation utilized the latest polymers and components, which allowed for a significant increase in the durability of the casing. Thanks to the innovative developments of the engineers, the Pioneer-3 combines high accuracy and an expanded frequency range, providing ultra-fast detection and analysis of signals. In addition to technological enhancements, the corporation updated the device interface to make it more intuitive. This scanner was created for internal use by ZIVCAS corporation employees, and any use by third parties will be subject to sanctions.
rz6ZNaDw.description_zh: ZIVCAS先锋系列扫描仪基于传奇的SAC扫描仪。先锋-3型号是对流行的SAC-2型号的重大改进。ZIVCAS公司的工程师使用了最新的聚合物和组件，显著提高了外壳的耐用性。得益于工程师的创新开发，先锋-3结合了高精度和扩展的频率范围，提供超快的信号检测和分析。除了技术增强外，公司还更新了设备界面，使其更加直观。此扫描仪是为ZIVCAS公司员工内部使用而创建的，任何第三方使用都将受到制裁。

qOGG3q1d.description:
§rA small backpack stuffed with scientific
§requipment. Should be delivered to the
§rleader of the research group.

v667.description:
A Research Institute 7 development based on captured Trailblazer gear.

The container section uses an assembly layout typical of the KZK series, allowing the Sheaf’s design to be optimized into a more ergonomic form and turned into a full-fledged bag capable of carrying more than just artifacts. However, this came at the cost of reduced container capacity.

The engineers who worked on the new product note that some of the Sheaf’s technical solutions are similar to those found in other relic technologies discovered in the Zone.
v667.description_zh:
7号研究所基于缴获的开拓者装备研发的产物。

其容器部分采用了KZK系列典型的组件布局，这让“束”的设计得以优化为更符合人体工学的形态，并改造成一款不仅能装神器的完整背包。不过代价是容器容量有所下降。

参与该新产品研发的工程师指出，“束”的某些技术方案与特异区中发现的其他遗物技术有相似之处。

1pyq.description: A module is a technology based on an anomalous core. A tesseract containing a core susceptible to hypothetical psions. When a specific configuration is input into the core, it generates a field that rearranges the framework into something serving the function of information.
1pyq.description_zh: 基于异常核心技术的模块。一个包含对假设灵子敏感核心的立方体。当特定配置输入核心时，它会生成一个重组框架的场，使其成为服务于信息功能的东西。

9yow.description: Anomalous formation encased in a movable, ferromagnetic frame. Once information is received, the frame transforms into a module.
9yow.description_zh: 封装在可移动铁磁框架中的异常构造体。一旦接收到信息，框架就会变形为一个模块。

g3zg.description:
A device with structure and operating principle not fully understood. It generates a field within which all states of quantum particles are restored to their original, erasing information about fundamental interactions.

The only device capable of detaching a modified and stabilized module from a weapon.
g3zg.description_zh:
结构和运行原理尚未完全理解的设备。它产生一个场，在该场内所有量子粒子的状态都恢复到原始状态，抹除关于基本相互作用的信息。

唯一能够将已修改和稳定的模块从武器上分离的设备。

0rmgd.description: A stalker’s life is like an artifact container: the pricier the build, the easier the journey!
0rmgd.description_zh: 潜行者的日子就像神器容器：配装越贵，路越好走！

1rdrg.description: Although the mysterious and uncharted Zone lies beneath stalkers’ feet, some of them still look skyward, eager to conquer not only the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone, but the vast reaches of space as well.
1rdrg.description_zh: 尽管潜行者脚下就是那片神秘未测的特异区，有些人依然仰望天空，渴望征服的不只是切尔诺贝利隔离区，还有浩瀚的太空。

5ldl1.description:
They say this armor was taken from a Covenant member who had received it personally from the Metropolite for his loyalty to the Lord.

Who could have known that his next assignment would be to prove the sincerity of his faith?
5ldl1.description_zh:
据说这套护甲是从一名“契约”成员身上扒下来的，他因对主忠心，由都主教亲自授予。

谁能想到，他接下来的任务，就是去证明自己信仰的真诚。

5lndo.description:
Heavy is good. Heavy is reliable. Especially when some local tinkerer has overhauled the entire loading system, turning an already deadly relic from a bygone era into a bona fide hand cannon—the kind that can restore order with the sheer roar of a single shot.

Exactly how this revolver manages to chamber and fire 9mm rounds remains a mystery.
5lndo.description_zh:
沉重是好事，沉重意味着可靠。尤其是当当地工匠把整个装填系统都翻新改造后，这把本就致命的古旧武器被彻底变成了一把名副其实的火枪，光是枪声的轰鸣就足以维持秩序。

至于这把左轮手枪是如何奇迹般发射9毫米弹药的——至今仍是个谜。

6wrwp.description: Rumor has it that a well-known mechanic at the Bar made this Scythian modification as a gift for a medic living in the Dorms. But it looks like he didn't really liked the gift...
6wrwp.description_zh: 据说酒吧里的一位名匠把"斯基泰"改成这样，是送给住在宿舍区的一位医生的礼物。不过看样子，医生并不太喜欢这份礼物……

7lrl6.description: Despite the harsh realities of the Zone, many stalkers still believe in mythical Klondikes: safe havens for humans, brimming with artifacts. Grim statistics show that most of these romantics either die searching for them or eventually give up hope of finding their coveted Klondike. But as the old-timers at the Drunken Geiger say, no one ever found Pathfinder—the most famous Klondike seeker of them all—dead.
7lrl6.description_zh: 尽管特异区的现实如此残酷，许多潜行者依然相信传说中的人间乐土——那些埋满神器的安全避难所。冰冷的统计数字显示，这些浪漫派大多要么死在寻找的路上，要么最终放弃了找到自己那片"克朗代克"的希望。但正如"醉锗"酒吧的老家伙们所说：谁也没见过"寻路者"——那位最著名的乐土追寻者——的尸体。

96m6l.description: A customized set of hunting armor, reworked for use by Frontier radio operators. Judging by the explanation from the craftsman who put the lot up for auction, the armor came into his possession in pretty rough shape. To hide the cosmetic damage, the mechanic painted it in a fairly basic Toad camouflage pattern—but he couldn’t resist a creative impulse...
96m6l.description_zh: 一套改装的猎人护甲，重新调整后供纪律的无线电操作员使用。按把它挂上拍卖的那位工匠的说法，这套护甲到他手上时品相相当糟糕。为了遮住外观损伤，他刷了一层相当朴素的"蟾蜍"迷彩——但终究没忍住创作冲动……

g4046.description:
A personal customization commissioned to match the rest of the squad’s suits—a squad that was clearly trying to emulate the knights of the Round Table.

And while no one has heard from those stalkers in a long time, certain enthusiasts of Zone folklore still occasionally place orders for all kinds of replicas.
g4046.description_zh:
一份私人订制的改装，为的是跟队里其他成员的套装配套——那支小队显然是想模仿圆桌骑士。

虽然已经很久没有那些潜行者的消息了，特异区民间传说的某些爱好者至今仍偶尔下单订做各种仿制品。

g4v2p.description: A ritual knife that has become a popular weapon in the Zone this season. It can be used not only against real enemies but also to confront inner fears—many stalkers use it in rituals to draw protective circles.
g4v2p.description_zh: 一把仪式用刀，本季在特异区成了热门武器。它不仅能用来对付真正的敌人，也能用来面对内心的恐惧——许多潜行者在仪式中用它在身边画下护身的圆圈。

j053g.description: Can be converted into 2000 trade coins

krn3p.description: Can be converted into 2000 trade coins

m09oj.description:
A unique and rather extravagant customization of Berloga, put up for auction by a loan shark known for being willing to strip debtors down to their underwear just to collect what he’s owed.

Rumor has it that it once belonged to a bandit famed for his romantic escapades beyond the Perimeter.
m09oj.description_zh:
一款相当浮夸的"熊穴"专属改装，被一个放贷的挂上了拍卖——此人出了名地愿意把欠债人扒到只剩内裤，只为了把债收回来。

据传它原本属于一名以"隔离区外的风流韵事"闻名的强盗。

ojmm.description: Special dart round loaded with a tranquilizer for the PTRD-M.
ojmm.description_zh: 装有麻醉剂的专用飞镖弹，供 PTRD-M 使用。

pjqvd.description:
fragment of a composite material frequently found in various Murmur devices.

Although the material resists traditional methods of structural and compositional analysis, scientists remain hopeful that its nature can eventually be determined.

rwy5g.description: Just a Sheaf. Just repainted in watermelon colors.
rwy5g.description_zh: 就是一捆"禾捆"。只是重新刷成了西瓜配色。

w3j43.description: Can be converted into 2000 trade coins

zz7zy.description:
Old-timers at the Bar say that even before Typhoon appeared in the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone, visitors from the East had already shown up on this side of the Perimeter.

All of them either blended in with the Zone’s other inhabitants or vanished into it, leaving behind only a few tall tales and some examples of customized gear.

And while even the auctioneer didn’t dare call this modification of the classic ZIVCAS one of those “relics,” the craftsman behind the suit was clearly inspired by the surviving stories about those stalkers.
zz7zy.description_zh:
酒吧的老家伙们说，早在"台风"出现在切尔诺贝利隔离区之前，来自东方的访客就已经到过隔离区这一侧。

他们要么融入了特异区的其他居民，要么就此消失在其中，只留下几段夸张的传闻和几件改装装备的样本。

虽然连拍卖师都不敢把这款经典 ZIVCAS 的改装称作那些"遗物"之一，但做出这套装备的工匠，显然是被那些关于这些潜行者的流传故事启发了。

kn9mp.description: An extended-capacity magazine. There’s a story going around the Zone: the snarling ghoul-face design appeared after a stalker who unexpectedly encountered them swore that next time, he’d have more rounds than there were creatures in the pack.
kn9mp.description_zh: 一个扩容弹匣。特异区里流传着一个说法：弹匣上那张龇牙的食尸鬼脸，出自一名潜行者——他意外撞见一群食尸鬼后发誓，下次他的子弹一定要比那群里头的怪物更多。
